verses.science: और उनके भक्षको को, परमात्मा ने ही रचा है! यश के निमित्त से मांसभक्षण हैवी विभि कहलाती है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: दधि भक्ष्यं च शुक्तेषु सर्वं च दधिसम्भवम् । दधिसम्भवम् यानि चैवाभिषूयन्ते पुष्पमूलफलैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: dadhi bhakṣyaṃ ca śukteṣu sarvaṃ ca dadhisambhavam | dadhisambhavam yāni caivābhiṣūyante puṣpamūlaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: Among (things turned) sour, sour milk, and all (food) prepared of it may be eaten, likewise what is extracted from pure flowers, roots, and fruit.
verses.hindi: सारलं रञ्जञवालं च दात्यूहं शुकसारिके
verses.commentary: Sense: Among (things turned) sour, sour milk, and all (food) prepared of it may be eaten, likewise what is extracted from pure flowers, roots, and fruit.
verses.science: सारलं रञ्जञवालं च दात्यूहं शुकसारिके। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादान् शकुनान् सर्वान्तथा ग्रामनिवासिनः । क्रव्यादः शकुनीन् अनिर्दिष्टांश्चेकशफान् टिट्टिभं च विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: kravyādān śakunān sarvāntathā grāmanivāsinaḥ | kravyādaḥ śakunīn anirdiṣṭāṃścekaśaphān ṭiṭṭibhaṃ ca vivarjayet
verses.translation: Let him avoid all carnivorous birds and those living in villages, and one-hoofed animals which are not specially permitted (to be eaten), and the Tittibha (Parra Jacana),
verses.hindi: ' जो पुरुष मणियो को बांधने या मारने का दुःख. नहीं देना भ्वाहता, वह सवका हित चाहनेवाला पुरुष अनन्त सुख पाता है। ऐसा पुरुष जो कुछ शोचता है, जो कुछ करता है और जिसमें अभिलाषा रखता है वह सब सहज में ही उसको घा होजाता है।
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him avoid all carnivorous birds and those living in villages, and one-hoofed animals which are not specially permitted (to be eaten), and the Tittibha (Parra Jacana),
verses.science: ' जो पुरुष मणियो को बांधने या मारने का दुःख. नहीं देना भ्वाहता, वह सवका हित चाहनेवाला पुरुष अनन्त सुख पाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कलविङ्कं प्लवं हंसं चक्राह्वं ग्रामकुक्कुटम् । सारसं रज्जुवालं च दात्यूहं शुकसारिके
verses.transliteration: kalaviṅkaṃ plavaṃ haṃsaṃ cakrāhvaṃ grāmakukkuṭam | sārasaṃ rajjuvālaṃ ca dātyūhaṃ śukasārike
verses.translation: The sparrow, the Plava, the Hamsa, the Brahmani duck, the village-cock, the Sarasa crane, the Raggudala, the woodpecker, the parrot, and the starling,
verses.hindi: य दिन यदे पर हल छ, तो तीनदिन का आशौच होता अपने समानोदक का मरण और पुत्र का जन्म सुनकर सचेल स्नान से शुद्धि होती है । सगोत्र बालक का आर असपिरड मामा, साला आदि का विदेश मै मत्यु सुनकर, सचेल स्नान से शादि
verses.commentary: Sense: The sparrow, the Plava, the Hamsa, the Brahmani duck, the village-cock, the Sarasa crane, the Raggudala, the woodpecker, the parrot, and the starling,
verses.science: य दिन यदे पर हल छ, तो तीनदिन का आशौच होता अपने समानोदक का मरण और पुत्र का जन्म सुनकर सचेल स्नान से शुद्धि होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: रज्जुदालं प्रतुदाञ्जालपादांश्च कोयष्टिनखविष्किरान् । प्रतुदान् निमज्जतश्च मत्स्यादान् सौनं वल्लूरमेव च
verses.transliteration: rajjudālaṃ pratudāñjālapādāṃśca koyaṣṭinakhaviṣkirān | pratudān nimajjataśca matsyādān saunaṃ vallūrameva ca
verses.translation: Those which feed striking with their beaks, web-footed birds, the Koyashti, those which scratch with their toes, those which dive and live on fish, meat from a slaughter-house and dried meat,
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो !.यह सपिरडो की मरणाशौच विधि कही गई हैं । अंब असपिरडों को विधि सुनो, । अखपिएड द्विज की मत्यु दोने.पर उसको बन्धु के तरह उठाना, दाइ देना और माता. के समीप.क 'भाई वहन. आदि. का भी उसी तरह कर्म करना. इसमें तीन: दिन:
verses.commentary: Sense: Those which feed striking with their beaks, web-footed birds, the Koyashti, those which scratch with their toes, those which dive and live on fish, meat from a slaughter-house and dried meat,
verses.science: हे द्विजो !.यह सपिरडो की मरणाशौच विधि कही गई हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: बकं चैव बलाकां च काकोलं खञ्जरीटकम् । मत्स्यादान् विड्वराहांश्च मत्स्यानेव च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: bakaṃ caiva balākāṃ ca kākolaṃ khañjarīṭakam | matsyādān viḍvarāhāṃśca matsyāneva ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The Baka and the Balaka crane, the raven, the Khangaritaka, (animals) that eat fish, village-pigs, and all kinds of fishes.
verses.hindi: सल ऑऔर'सूच को त्याग करने पर लिङ्ग और योनिं की' एक चार, गुदा को तीन बार, बाम हाथ को दशवार, -फिर दोनों: हाथों को खातबार मिट्टी से. धोना, चाहिए । यह आचार-शौच शहरस्थों के लिए है । ब्रह्मचारिया को इंसंसे'दूचा शोच करना चा हिए.। धान
verses.commentary: Sense: The Baka and the Balaka crane, the raven, the Khangaritaka, (animals) that eat fish, village-pigs, and all kinds of fishes.
verses.science: सल ऑऔर'सूच को त्याग करने पर लिङ्ग और योनिं की' एक चार, गुदा को तीन बार, बाम हाथ को दशवार, -फिर दोनों: हाथों को खातबार मिट्टी से. धोना, चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यो यस्य मांसमश्नाति स तन्मांसाद उच्यते । मत्स्यादः सर्वमांसादस्तस्मान् मत्स्यान् विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: yo yasya māṃsamaśnāti sa tanmāṃsāda ucyate | matsyādaḥ sarvamāṃsādastasmān matsyān vivarjayet
verses.translation: He who eats the flesh of any (animal) is called the eater of the flesh of that (particular creature), he who eats fish is an eater of every (kind of) flesh; let him therefore avoid fish.
verses.hindi: मुन्यज्नेविविधेमेध्येः शाकंसूलफलेनं को ।
verses.commentary: Sense: He who eats the flesh of any (animal) is called the eater of the flesh of that (particular creature), he who eats fish is an eater of every (kind of) flesh; let him therefore avoid fish.
verses.science: मुन्यज्नेविविधेमेध्येः शाकंसूलफलेनं को। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पाठीनरोहितावाद्यौ नियुक्तौ हव्यकव्ययोः । राजीवान् सिंहतुण्डाश्च सशल्काश्चैव सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: pāṭhīnarohitāvādyau niyuktau havyakavyayoḥ | rājīvān siṃhatuṇḍāśca saśalkāścaiva sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: (But the fish called) Pathina and (that called) Rohita may be eaten, if used for offerings to the gods or to the manes; (one may eat) likewise Ragivas, Simhatundas, and Sasalkas on all (occasions).
verses.commentary: Sense: (But the fish called) Pathina and (that called) Rohita may be eaten, if used for offerings to the gods or to the manes; (one may eat) likewise Ragivas, Simhatundas, and Sasalkas on all (occasions).
verses.hindi: सपिण्डता तु पुरुषे समे विनिवर्तते ।
verses.science: सपिण्डता तु पुरुषे समे विनिवर्तते। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: राजीवाः न भक्षयेदेकचरानज्ञातांश्च मृगद्विजान् । भक्ष्येष्वपि समुद्दिष्टान् सर्वान् पञ्चनखांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: rājīvāḥ na bhakṣayedekacarānajñātāṃśca mṛgadvijān | bhakṣyeṣvapi samuddiṣṭān sarvān pañcanakhāṃstathā
verses.translation: Let him not eat solitary or unknown beasts and birds, though they may fall under (the categories of) eatable (creatures), nor any five-toed (animals).
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him not eat solitary or unknown beasts and birds, though they may fall under (the categories of) eatable (creatures), nor any five-toed (animals).
verses.hindi: अव चारों बरों की सूतक व्यवस्था और धातु पात्रों की शादे को क्रम से कहते हैं। दांत निकल आये हाया दांत निकलने के बाद और चूड़ा कमे होजाने पर सृत्यु होने से सव वान्धवा को अशुद्धि दश दिन तक रहता है। किसी को अस्थि संचयन के पूबै ॥७-६०्
verses.science: अव चारों बरों की सूतक व्यवस्था और धातु पात्रों की शादे को क्रम से कहते हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्वाविधं शल्यकं गोधां खड्गकूर्मशशांस्तथा । भक्ष्यान् पञ्चनखेष्वाहुरनुष्ट्रांश्चैकतोदतः
verses.transliteration: śvāvidhaṃ śalyakaṃ godhāṃ khaḍgakūrmaśaśāṃstathā | bhakṣyān pañcanakheṣvāhuranuṣṭrāṃścaikatodataḥ
verses.translation: The porcupine, the hedgehog, the iguana, the rhinoceros, the tortoise, and the hare they declare to be eatable; likewise those (domestic animals) that have teeth in one jaw only, excepting camels.
verses.commentary: Sense: The porcupine, the hedgehog, the iguana, the rhinoceros, the tortoise, and the hare they declare to be eatable; likewise those (domestic animals) that have teeth in one jaw only, excepting camels.
verses.hindi: अहा चकेन राज्या च तिरात्रेरेव च त्रिभिः
verses.science: अहा चकेन राज्या च तिरात्रेरेव च त्रिभिः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: छत्राकं विड्वराहं च लशुनं ग्रामकुक्कुटम् । पलाण्डुं गृञ्जनं चैव मत्या जग्ध्वा पतेद्द्विजः
verses.transliteration: chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca laśunaṃ grāmakukkuṭam | palāṇḍuṃ gṛñjanaṃ caiva matyā jagdhvā pateddvijaḥ
verses.translation: A twice-born man who knowingly eats mushrooms, a village-pig, garlic, a village-cock, onions, or leeks, will become an outcast.
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who knowingly eats mushrooms, a village-pig, garlic, a village-cock, onions, or leeks, will become an outcast.
verses.hindi: असा मरने पर सपिण्डो को यह थाशौच कहा है, वैसा ही पुग्न आशोच होता है। मरण श्राशीच सव सपिण्डौ को और जन्मा शोच माता पिता फो ही होता है। उसमे भी पिता स्नान करने से शुद्ध दांता ८ । माता पो हो सूतक रहता है । पुरुप जानकर घीयैः
verses.science: असा मरने पर सपिण्डो को यह थाशौच कहा है, वैसा ही पुग्न आशोच होता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अमत्यैतानि षड्जग्ध्वा कृच्छ्रं सान्तपनं चरेत् । यतिचान्द्रायाणं वाऽपि शेषेषूपवसेदहः
verses.transliteration: amatyaitāni ṣaḍjagdhvā kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret | yaticāndrāyāṇaṃ vā'pi śeṣeṣūpavasedahaḥ
verses.translation: He who unwittingly partakes of (any of) these six, shall perform a Samtapana (Krikkhra) or the lunar penance (Kandrayana) of ascetics; in case (he who has eaten) any other (kind of forbidden food) he shall fast for one day (and a night ).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who unwittingly partakes of (any of) these six, shall perform a Samtapana (Krikkhra) or the lunar penance (Kandrayana) of ascetics; in case (he who has eaten) any other (kind of forbidden food) he shall fast for one day (and a night ).
verses.hindi: तृणामझतचडानो विशाद्धनीशाका स्पृता ।
verses.science: तृणामझतचडानो विशाद्धनीशाका स्पृता। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरस्यैकमपि चरेत्कृच्छ्रं द्विजोत्तमः । अज्ञातभुक्तशुद्ध्यर्थं ज्ञातस्य तु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarasyaikamapi caretkṛcchraṃ dvijottamaḥ | ajñātabhuktaśuddhyarthaṃ jñātasya tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Once a year a Brahmana must perform a Krikkhra penance, in order to atone for unintentionally eating (forbidden food) but for intentionally (eating forbidden food he must perform the penances prescribed) specially.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once a year a Brahmana must perform a Krikkhra penance, in order to atone for unintentionally eating (forbidden food) but for intentionally (eating forbidden food he must perform the penances prescribed) specially.
verses.hindi: टि करता हुआ, शव उठाने घाला के साथ दशै दिन शुद्ध होता है। जितने मास का गर्भपात हो उतनी रात्रि में खी शुद्ध होती है  ऑर र्जर जू समान करके शुद्ध होती है । जिन वालको का चूड़ाकर्म नहीं हुआ
verses.science: टि करता हुआ, शव उठाने घाला के साथ दशै दिन शुद्ध होता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञार्थं ब्राह्मणैर्वध्याः प्रशस्ता मृगपक्षिणः । भृत्यानां चैव वृत्त्यर्थमगस्त्यो ह्याचरत्पुरा
verses.transliteration: yajñārthaṃ brāhmaṇairvadhyāḥ praśastā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ | bhṛtyānāṃ caiva vṛttyarthamagastyo hyācaratpurā
verses.translation: Beasts and birds recommended (for consumption) may be slain by Brahmanas for sacrifices, and in order to feed those whom they are bound to maintain; for Agastya did this of old.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beasts and birds recommended (for consumption) may be slain by Brahmanas for sacrifices, and in order to feed those whom they are bound to maintain; for Agastya did this of old.
verses.hindi: और इस वालक का अग्नि संस्कार, जलदान आदि कुछ न करना  सिर्फ़ जंगल मे, काउ की भांति गढे में, छोड़ कर तीन, दिन सूतक मानना चाहिए । तीन वर्षे खे कम अवस्था का वालक होने पर; सपिएडों को जलदाब न करना चाहिए। अथवा, दाँत निकले
verses.science: और इस वालक का अग्नि संस्कार, जलदान आदि कुछ न करना सिर्फ़ जंगल मे, काउ की भांति गढे में, छोड़ कर तीन, दिन सूतक मानना चाहिए। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: बभूवुर्हि पुरोडाशा भक्ष्याणां मृगपक्षिणाम् । पुराणेष्वपि यज्ञेषु ब्रह्मक्षत्रसवेषु च
verses.transliteration: babhūvurhi puroḍāśā bhakṣyāṇāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām | purāṇeṣvapi yajñeṣu brahmakṣatrasaveṣu ca
verses.translation: For in ancient (times) the sacrificial cakes were (made of the flesh) of eatable beasts and birds at the sacrifices offered by Brahmanas and Kshatriyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: For in ancient (times) the sacrificial cakes were (made of the flesh) of eatable beasts and birds at the sacrifices offered by Brahmanas and Kshatriyas.
verses.hindi: संनिधावेष वेकल्पः शावाशौचस्य कीर्तितः ।  जिस कन्या का विवाह न भया दो;सगाई भई हो, उसके निघत में ससुराल वाले और पिठूकुल के तीन रात में शद्ध. होते हैं। सृत्यु सूतक घाले को क्षार, अलोना सोजव करना चाहिए । तीन
verses.science: संनिधावेष वेकल्पः शावाशौचस्य कीर्तितः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुराणेष्वृषियज्ञेषु यत्किं चित्स्नेहसंयुक्तं भक्ष्यं भोज्यमगर्हितम् । तत्पर्युषितमप्याद्यं हविःशेषं च यद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: purāṇeṣvṛṣiyajñeṣu yatkiṃ citsnehasaṃyuktaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyamagarhitam | tatparyuṣitamapyādyaṃ haviḥśeṣaṃ ca yadbhavet
verses.translation: All lawful hard or soft food may be eaten, though stale, (after having been) mixed with fatty (substances), and so may the remains of sacrificial viands.
verses.commentary: Sense: All lawful hard or soft food may be eaten, though stale, (after having been) mixed with fatty (substances), and so may the remains of sacrificial viands.
verses.hindi: य दिन यदे पर हल छ, तो तीनदिन का आशौच होता अपने समानोदक का मरण और पुत्र का जन्म सुनकर सचेल स्नान से शुद्धि होती है । सगोत्र बालक का आर असपिरड मामा, साला आदि का विदेश मै मत्यु सुनकर, सचेल स्नान से शादि
verses.science: य दिन यदे पर हल छ, तो तीनदिन का आशौच होता अपने समानोदक का मरण और पुत्र का जन्म सुनकर सचेल स्नान से शुद्धि होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चिरस्थितमपि त्वाद्यमस्नेहाक्तं द्विजातिभिः । यवगोधूमजं सर्वं पयसश्चैव विक्रिया
verses.transliteration: cirasthitamapi tvādyamasnehāktaṃ dvijātibhiḥ | yavagodhūmajaṃ sarvaṃ payasaścaiva vikriyā
verses.translation: But all preparations of barley and wheat, as well as preparations of milk, may be eaten by twice-born men without being mixed with fatty (substances), though they may have stood for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: But all preparations of barley and wheat, as well as preparations of milk, may be eaten by twice-born men without being mixed with fatty (substances), though they may have stood for a long time.
verses.hindi: देश मै निवास हो उसकी सत्यु, दिन में होने पर सूर्यास्त तक और रात मै रातभर, खूतक रहता है । अश्रोत्रिय राहण, येदपाठी आर गुरु के मरण में, एक दिन का, आशौच होता है। ब्राह्मण दश॑ मास म शुद्ध होता है ॥ ८१-८४॥
verses.science: देश मै निवास हो उसकी सत्यु, दिन में होने पर सूर्यास्त तक और रात मै रातभर, खूतक रहता है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: एतदुक्तं द्विजातीनां भक्ष्याभक्ष्यमशेषतः । मांसस्यातः प्रवक्ष्यामि विधिं भक्षणवर्जने
verses.transliteration: etaduktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ bhakṣyābhakṣyamaśeṣataḥ | māṃsasyātaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ bhakṣaṇavarjane
verses.translation: Thus has the food, allowed and forbidden to twice-born men, been fully described; I will now propound the rules for eating and avoiding meat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus has the food, allowed and forbidden to twice-born men, been fully described; I will now propound the rules for eating and avoiding meat.
verses.hindi: दिवाकीतिसुदक्यां च पतितं संतिकां तथा ।
verses.science: दिवाकीतिसुदक्यां च पतितं संतिकां तथा। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्षितं भक्षयेन् मांसं ब्राह्मणानां च काम्यया । यथाविधि नियुक्तस्तु प्राणानामेव चात्यये
verses.transliteration: prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayen māṃsaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmyayā | yathāvidhi niyuktastu prāṇānāmeva cātyaye
verses.translation: One may eat meat when it has been sprinkled with water, while Mantras were recited, when Brahmanas desire (one's doing it), when one is engaged (in the performance of a rite) according to the law, and when one's life is in danger.
verses.commentary: Sense: One may eat meat when it has been sprinkled with water, while Mantras were recited, when Brahmanas desire (one's doing it), when one is engaged (in the performance of a rite) according to the law, and when one's life is in danger.
verses.hindi: समाते तूदके कतवा त्रिरात्रेणेव शुष्यति
verses.science: समाते तूदके कतवा त्रिरात्रेणेव शुष्यति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राणस्यान्नमिदं सर्वं प्रजापतिरकल्पयत् । स्थावरं जङ्गमं चैव सर्वं प्राणस्य भोजनम्
verses.transliteration: prāṇasyānnamidaṃ sarvaṃ prajāpatirakalpayat | sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam
verses.translation: The Lord of creatures (Pragapati) created this whole (world to be) the sustenance of the vital spirit; both the immovable and the movable (creation is) the food of the vital spirit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord of creatures (Pragapati) created this whole (world to be) the sustenance of the vital spirit; both the immovable and the movable (creation is) the food of the vital spirit.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए । अग्निहोत्री सपिरड होने पर भी सूतकी नहीँ होता । चारडाल, रजस्वला, पतित, प्रसूता, सुरदा और सुरदे घेदसम-? और पचमान मन्तो का जप करना चाहिए । मनुष्य की गीली इड्डी छूने पर स्वान करके और सूखी हो तो आचमन
verses.science: करना चाहिए। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: चराणामन्नमचरा दंष्ट्रिणामप्यदंष्ट्रिणः । अहस्ताश्च सहस्तानां शूराणां चैव भीरवः
verses.transliteration: carāṇāmannamacarā daṃṣṭriṇāmapyadaṃṣṭriṇaḥ | ahastāśca sahastānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ caiva bhīravaḥ
verses.translation: What is destitute of motion is the food of those endowed with locomotion; (animals) without fangs (are the food) of those with fangs, those without hands of those who possess hands, and the timid of the bold.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is destitute of motion is the food of those endowed with locomotion; (animals) without fangs (are the food) of those with fangs, those without hands of those who possess hands, and the timid of the bold.
verses.hindi: पासण्डमाश्नितानां च चरन्तीनां च कामतः ।
verses.science: पासण्डमाश्नितानां च चरन्तीनां च कामतः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नात्ता दुष्यत्यदन्नाद्यान् प्राणिनोऽहन्य्ऽहन्यपि । धात्रैव सृष्टा ह्याद्याश्च प्राणिनोऽत्तार एव च
verses.transliteration: nāttā duṣyatyadannādyān prāṇino'hany'hanyapi | dhātraiva sṛṣṭā hyādyāśca prāṇino'ttāra eva ca
verses.translation: The eater who daily even devours those destined to be his food, commits no sin; for the creator himself created both the eaters and those who are to be eaten (for those special purposes).
verses.commentary: Sense: The eater who daily even devours those destined to be his food, commits no sin; for the creator himself created both the eaters and those who are to be eaten (for those special purposes).
verses.hindi: बरीसकर, संभ्यासी ओर आत्मघाती को जलदान को ज़रूरत नहीं है। पाखण्डी, दुराचारी खरी, गर्स ओर पति का घात करने चाली और मच पीनेदाली खी को जलदान न करना। अपने शा" चाये, उपाध्याय, पिता, माता और गुरू के शव को उठाने और
verses.science: बरीसकर, संभ्यासी ओर आत्मघाती को जलदान को ज़रूरत नहीं है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञाय जग्धिर्मांसस्येत्येष दैवो विधिः स्मृतः । अतोऽन्यथा प्रवृत्तिस्तु राक्षसो विधिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yajñāya jagdhirmāṃsasyetyeṣa daivo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | ato'nyathā pravṛttistu rākṣaso vidhirucyate
verses.translation: 'The consumption of meat (is befitting) for sacrifices,' that is declared to be a rule made by the gods; but to persist (in using it) on other (occasions) is said to be a proceeding worthy of Rakshasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'The consumption of meat (is befitting) for sacrifices,' that is declared to be a rule made by the gods; but to persist (in using it) on other (occasions) is said to be a proceeding worthy of Rakshasas.
verses.hindi: राज्ञो साहात्सिके स्थाने सथः शोचं विधीयते । जानो पाररक्षाथसासनञ्चात्र कारणुस
verses.science: राज्ञो साहात्सिके स्थाने सथः शोचं विधीयते। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रीत्वा स्वयं वाऽप्युत्पाद्य परोपकृतमेव वा । देवान् पितॄंश्चार्चयित्वा खादन् मांसं न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: krītvā svayaṃ vā'pyutpādya paropakṛtameva vā | devān pitṝṃścārcayitvā khādan māṃsaṃ na duṣyati
verses.translation: He who eats meat, when he honours the gods and manes, commits no sin, whether he has bought it, or himself has killed (the animal), or has received it as a present from others.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who eats meat, when he honours the gods and manes, commits no sin, whether he has bought it, or himself has killed (the animal), or has received it as a present from others.
verses.hindi: डिम्बाइवहतानां च विद्युता पार्थिवेन च। -
verses.science: डिम्बाइवहतानां च विद्युता पार्थिवेन च। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाद्यादविधिना मांसं विधिज्ञोऽनापदि द्विजः । जग्ध्वा ह्यविधिना मांसं प्रेतस्तैरद्यतेऽवशः
verses.transliteration: nādyādavidhinā māṃsaṃ vidhijño'nāpadi dvijaḥ | jagdhvā hyavidhinā māṃsaṃ pretastairadyate'vaśaḥ
verses.translation: A twice-born man who knows the law, must not eat meat except in conformity with the law; for if he has eaten it unlawfully, he will, unable to save himself, be eaten after death by his (victims).
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who knows the law, must not eat meat except in conformity with the law; for if he has eaten it unlawfully, he will, unable to save himself, be eaten after death by his (victims).
verses.hindi: न्यायासन,पर बेठना ही इसमें कारण है । चिना राजा को लड़ाई में, विजली से, राजाशा फाँसी ले और गौ-ब्राह्मण के रक्षा के लिए मरे हुए का और जिसको राजा अपने. कार्य के लिए चाहे, उसकी तत्काल शुद्धि होती है ॥ ६२-६४ ॥
verses.science: न्यायासन,पर बेठना ही इसमें कारण है। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: न तादृशं भवत्येनो मृगहन्तुर्धनार्थिनः । यादृशं भवति प्रेत्य वृथामांसानि खादतः
verses.transliteration: na tādṛśaṃ bhavatyeno mṛgahanturdhanārthinaḥ | yādṛśaṃ bhavati pretya vṛthāmāṃsāni khādataḥ
verses.translation: After death the guilt of one who slays deer for gain is not as (great) as that of him who eats meat for no (sacred) purpose.
verses.commentary: Sense: After death the guilt of one who slays deer for gain is not as (great) as that of him who eats meat for no (sacred) purpose.
verses.hindi: गोठयात के शरीर को राजा चारण करता है। लोकपाला का राजा के परीर में विधास होने से उसको सूतक नहीं लगता । आ शेष्य ता मरप्या के लिए ६। राजा ता लोकपालो के अश से पेट दा र जो याज्ञा शखो स धर्मचुद्ध करक मरता है उसको
verses.science: गोठयात के शरीर को राजा चारण करता है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: नियुक्तस्तु यथान्यायं यो मांसं नात्ति मानवः । स प्रेत्य पशुतां याति सम्भवानेकविंशतिम्
verses.transliteration: niyuktastu yathānyāyaṃ yo māṃsaṃ nātti mānavaḥ | sa pretya paśutāṃ yāti sambhavānekaviṃśatim
verses.translation: But a man who, being duly engaged (to officiate or to dine at a sacred rite), refuses to eat meat, becomes after death an animal during twenty-one existences.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a man who, being duly engaged (to officiate or to dine at a sacred rite), refuses to eat meat, becomes after death an animal during twenty-one existences.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो !.यह सपिरडो की मरणाशौच विधि कही गई हैं । अंब असपिरडों को विधि सुनो, । अखपिएड द्विज की मत्यु दोने.पर उसको बन्धु के तरह उठाना, दाइ देना और माता. के समीप.क 'भाई वहन. आदि. का भी उसी तरह कर्म करना. इसमें तीन: दिन:
verses.science: हे द्विजो !.यह सपिरडो की मरणाशौच विधि कही गई हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: असंस्कृतान् पशून् मन्त्रैर्नाद्याद्विप्रः कदा चन । मन्त्रैस्तु संस्कृतानद्यात्शाश्वतं विधिमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: asaṃskṛtān paśūn mantrairnādyādvipraḥ kadā cana | mantraistu saṃskṛtānadyātśāśvataṃ vidhimāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana must never eat (the flesh of animals unhallowed by Mantras; but, obedient to the primeval law, he may eat it, consecrated with Vedic texts.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana must never eat (the flesh of animals unhallowed by Mantras; but, obedient to the primeval law, he may eat it, consecrated with Vedic texts.
verses.hindi: कर्म, सूर्ये और 'काल ये सच" घाशियां:. को शुद्धि करनेंबाले दे! यए आदि न करनेवाले दान से, पापी जप से और वेदविशारद ' तप से पवित्र होते हैं ॥ १०४-.१०७ ॥  रजसा खरी मनोदुश संन्यासेन द्विजोत्तमः
verses.science: कर्म, सूर्ये और 'काल ये सच" घाशियां:. को शुद्धि करनेंबाले दे! यए आदि न करनेवाले दान से, पापी जप से और वेदविशारद ' तप से पवित्र होते हैं ॥ १०४-.१०७ ॥ रजसा खरी…। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: कुर्याद्घृतपशुं सङ्गे कुर्यात्पिष्टपशुं तथा । न त्वेव तु वृथा हन्तुं पशुमिच्छेत्कदा चन
verses.transliteration: kuryādghṛtapaśuṃ saṅge kuryātpiṣṭapaśuṃ tathā | na tveva tu vṛthā hantuṃ paśumicchetkadā cana
verses.translation: If he has a strong desire (for meat) he may make an animal of clarified butter or one of flour, (and eat that); but let him never seek to destroy an animal without a (lawful) reason.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he has a strong desire (for meat) he may make an animal of clarified butter or one of flour, (and eat that); but let him never seek to destroy an animal without a (lawful) reason.
verses.hindi: शुद्ध होती है! मन से दूषित खी रजस्वला होने, से शुद्ध होती दे ,
verses.science: शुद्ध होती है! मन से दूषित खी रजस्वला होने, से शुद्ध होती दे ,। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यावन्ति पशुरोमाणि तावत्कृत्वो ह मारणम् । वृथापशुघ्नः प्राप्नोति प्रेत्य जन्मनि जन्मनि
verses.transliteration: yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvatkṛtvo ha māraṇam | vṛthāpaśughnaḥ prāpnoti pretya janmani janmani
verses.translation: As many hairs as the slain beast has, so often indeed will he who killed it without a (lawful) reason suffer a violent death in future births.
verses.commentary: Sense: As many hairs as the slain beast has, so often indeed will he who killed it without a (lawful) reason suffer a violent death in future births.
verses.hindi: शोचे यथाई कर्तव्य कषाराम्लोदकवारिभिः
verses.science: शोचे यथाई कर्तव्य कषाराम्लोदकवारिभिः। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञार्थं पशवः सृष्टाः स्वयमेव स्वयम्भुवा । यज्ञोऽस्य भूत्यै सर्वस्य तस्माद्यज्ञे वधोऽवधः
verses.transliteration: yajñārthaṃ paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā | yajño'sya bhūtyai sarvasya tasmādyajñe vadho'vadhaḥ
verses.translation: Svayambhu (the Self-existent) himself created animals for the sake of sacrifices; sacrifices (have been instituted) for the good of this whole (world); hence the slaughtering (of beasts) for sacrifices is not slaughtering (in the ordinary sense of the word).
verses.commentary: Sense: Svayambhu (the Self-existent) himself created animals for the sake of sacrifices; sacrifices (have been instituted) for the good of this whole (world); hence the slaughtering (of beasts) for sacrifices is not slaughtering (in the ordinary sense of the word).
verses.hindi: सुवण आदि तेजस पदार्थ, मणि और सव पत्थर दो पदाथों को शुद्धि राख, जल ओर मिट्टी खे होती दे। शिख मे किसी भांति को लेप न.हो ऐसा सोना का पात्र,शंख,पत्थर और चाँदी का पात्र जल से ही शुद्ध होता है। सोचा और चांदी अग्नि और जल के संयोग
verses.science: सुवण आदि तेजस पदार्थ, मणि और सव पत्थर दो पदाथों को शुद्धि राख, जल ओर मिट्टी खे होती दे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: ओषध्यः पशवो वृक्षास्तिर्यञ्चः पक्षिणस्तथा । यज्ञार्थं निधनं प्राप्ताः प्राप्नुवन्त्युत्सृतीः पुनः
verses.transliteration: oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣāstiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇastathā | yajñārthaṃ nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ prāpnuvantyutsṛtīḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Herbs, trees, cattle, birds, and (other) animals that have been destroyed for sacrifices, receive (being reborn) higher existences.
verses.commentary: Sense: Herbs, trees, cattle, birds, and (other) animals that have been destroyed for sacrifices, receive (being reborn) higher existences.
verses.hindi: काशयावंकयारूपे: कुतपानासारेणसेः
verses.science: काशयावंकयारूपे: कुतपानासारेणसेः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: उच्छ्रितीः मधुपर्के च यज्ञे च पितृदैवतकर्मणि । अत्रैव पशवो हिंस्या नान्यत्रैत्यब्रवीन् मनुः
verses.transliteration: ucchritīḥ madhuparke ca yajñe ca pitṛdaivatakarmaṇi | atraiva paśavo hiṃsyā nānyatraityabravīn manuḥ
verses.translation: On offering the honey-mixture (to a guest), at a sacrifice and at the rites in honour of the manes, but on these occasions only, may an animal be slain; that (rule) Manu proclaimed.
verses.commentary: Sense: On offering the honey-mixture (to a guest), at a sacrifice and at the rites in honour of the manes, but on these occasions only, may an animal be slain; that (rule) Manu proclaimed.
verses.hindi: मा्जेनोपाऽजनेवेश्म पुनः पाकेन मून्मयम्
verses.science: मा्जेनोपाऽजनेवेश्म पुनः पाकेन मून्मयम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एष्वर्थेषु पशून् हिंसन् वेदतत्त्वार्थविद्द्विजः । आत्मानं च पशुं चैव गमयत्युत्तमं गतिम्
verses.transliteration: eṣvartheṣu paśūn hiṃsan vedatattvārthaviddvijaḥ | ātmānaṃ ca paśuṃ caiva gamayatyuttamaṃ gatim
verses.translation: A twice-born man who, knowing the true meaning of the Veda, slays an animal for these purposes, causes both himself and the animal to enter a most blessed state.
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man who, knowing the true meaning of the Veda, slays an animal for these purposes, causes both himself and the animal to enter a most blessed state.
verses.hindi: चमस और प्रहपात्र चरैरह गरम. जल. से धोने से. पवित्र होते हे) चरु, खच, खवा, स्फ्य, सूप, शकर, सूलल और .उलूखल परम जल से शुद्ध होते हैं। अन्न और वस्न 'का बहुत ढेर हो तो जल . छिडकने से पवित्र होता है और थोडा होतो. जल से, धोने पर
verses.science: चमस और प्रहपात्र चरैरह गरम. जल. से धोने से. पवित्र होते हे) चरु, खच, खवा, स्फ्य, सूप, शकर, सूलल और .उलूखल परम जल से शुद्ध होते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: गृहे गुरावरण्ये वा निवसन्नात्मवान् द्विजः । नावेदविहितां हिंसामापद्यपि समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: gṛhe gurāvaraṇye vā nivasannātmavān dvijaḥ | nāvedavihitāṃ hiṃsāmāpadyapi samācaret
verses.translation: A twice-born man of virtuous disposition, whether he dwells in (his own) house, with a teacher, or in the forest, must never, even in times of distress, cause an injury (to any creature) which is not sanctioned by the Veda.
verses.commentary: Sense: A twice-born man of virtuous disposition, whether he dwells in (his own) house, with a teacher, or in the forest, must never, even in times of distress, cause an injury (to any creature) which is not sanctioned by the Veda.
verses.hindi: दूषित केशकोट च मृत्यक्षेपेण शुध्यति ॥ १२४) "नित्यमास्यं शाचिः स्रीणां शुकानेः फलपातने । उसका पुनः अग्निसंस्कार करने पर भी वह शुद्ध नंही होता! झाडू देना, लीपचा, जल छिड़कना, खोंदना ओर गो. का निवासे,
verses.science: दूषित केशकोट च मृत्यक्षेपेण शुध्यति ॥ १२४) "नित्यमास्यं शाचिः स्रीणां शुकानेः फलपातने। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: या वेदविहिता हिंसा नियताऽस्मिंश्चराचरे । अहिंसामेव तां विद्याद्वेदाद्धर्मो हि निर्बभौ
verses.transliteration: yā vedavihitā hiṃsā niyatā'smiṃścarācare | ahiṃsāmeva tāṃ vidyādvedāddharmo hi nirbabhau
verses.translation: Know that the injury to moving creatures and to those destitute of motion, which the Veda has prescribed for certain occasions, is no injury at all; for the sacred law shone forth from the Veda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know that the injury to moving creatures and to those destitute of motion, which the Veda has prescribed for certain occasions, is no injury at all; for the sacred law shone forth from the Veda.
verses.hindi: देहिकार्ना मलानां च शुजिषु दादशस्वपि
verses.science: देहिकार्ना मलानां च शुजिषु दादशस्वपि। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: योऽहिंसकानि भूतानि हिनस्त्यात्मसुखैच्छया । स जीवांश्च मृतश्चैव न क्व चित्सुखमेधते
verses.transliteration: yo'hiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinastyātmasukhaicchayā | sa jīvāṃśca mṛtaścaiva na kva citsukhamedhate
verses.translation: He who injures innoxious beings from a wish to (give) himself pleasure, never finds happiness, neither living nor dead.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who injures innoxious beings from a wish to (give) himself pleasure, never finds happiness, neither living nor dead.
verses.hindi: जो इन्द्रियां नामि के ऊपर हैं घे सव पितर हैं और जो नाभि के नाचे हैँ वे सव अशुद्ध हैँ। देह से निकला मल सब अपवित्र हैं मक्खी, सुख से निकली जल की छीट, छाया, गो, घोडा, सूर्य की किरण, धूलि, भूमि, वायु और अग्नि इन सब का, स्पश पवित्र
verses.science: जो इन्द्रियां नामि के ऊपर हैं घे सव पितर हैं और जो नाभि के नाचे हैँ वे सव अशुद्ध हैँ। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: यो बन्धनवधक्लेशान् प्राणिनां न चिकीर्षति । स सर्वस्य हितप्रेप्सुः सुखमत्यन्तमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: yo bandhanavadhakleśān prāṇināṃ na cikīrṣati | sa sarvasya hitaprepsuḥ sukhamatyantamaśnute
verses.translation: He who does not seek to cause the sufferings of bonds and death to living creatures, (but) desires the good of all (beings), obtains endless bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who does not seek to cause the sufferings of bonds and death to living creatures, (but) desires the good of all (beings), obtains endless bliss.
verses.hindi: सल ऑऔर'सूच को त्याग करने पर लिङ्ग और योनिं की' एक चार, गुदा को तीन बार, बाम हाथ को दशवार, -फिर दोनों: हाथों को खातबार मिट्टी से. धोना, चाहिए । यह आचार-शौच शहरस्थों के लिए है । ब्रह्मचारिया को इंसंसे'दूचा शोच करना चा हिए.। धान
verses.science: सल ऑऔर'सूच को त्याग करने पर लिङ्ग और योनिं की' एक चार, गुदा को तीन बार, बाम हाथ को दशवार, -फिर दोनों: हाथों को खातबार मिट्टी से. धोना, चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्ध्यायति यत्कुरुते रतिं बध्नाति यत्र च । तदवाप्नोत्ययत्नेन यो हिनस्ति न किं चन
verses.transliteration: yaddhyāyati yatkurute ratiṃ badhnāti yatra ca | tadavāpnotyayatnena yo hinasti na kiṃ cana
verses.translation: He who does not injure any (creature), attains without an effort what he thinks of, what he undertakes, and what he fixes his mind on.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who does not injure any (creature), attains without an effort what he thinks of, what he undertakes, and what he fixes his mind on.
verses.hindi: आचामदवसुकतवानन स्नानं सेथृनिनः स्वता १४४
verses.science: आचामदवसुकतवानन स्नानं सेथृनिनः स्वता १४४। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: नाकृत्वा प्राणिनां हिंसां मांसमुत्पद्यते क्व चित् । न च प्राणिवधः स्वर्ग्यस्तस्मान् मांसं विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: nākṛtvā prāṇināṃ hiṃsāṃ māṃsamutpadyate kva cit | na ca prāṇivadhaḥ svargyastasmān māṃsaṃ vivarjayet
verses.translation: Meat can never be obtained without injury to living creatures, and injury to sentient beings is detrimental to (the attainment of) heavenly bliss; let him therefore shun (the use of) meat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Meat can never be obtained without injury to living creatures, and injury to sentient beings is detrimental to (the attainment of) heavenly bliss; let him therefore shun (the use of) meat.
verses.hindi: न्यायाघुसार चलनेबाला शद्ग महीना में घाल को घनवावे, सृत्यु: सूनक और जन्मसूतक में वैश्य के समान व्यवहार फरे और महाण का जूठा श्रन्न खाचे  सुख से शरीर पर जो डोरें पड़ती हैं वे शरीर को जूँठा नहीं करतीं । मुख में गया मूड का बाल और
verses.science: न्यायाघुसार चलनेबाला शद्ग महीना में घाल को घनवावे, सृत्यु: सूनक और जन्मसूतक में वैश्य के समान व्यवहार फरे और महाण का जूठा श्रन्न खाचे सुख से शरीर पर जो डोरें…। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: समुत्पत्तिं च मांसस्य वधबन्धौ च देहिनाम् । प्रसमीक्ष्य निवर्तेत सर्वमांसस्य भक्षणात्
verses.transliteration: samutpattiṃ ca māṃsasya vadhabandhau ca dehinām | prasamīkṣya nivarteta sarvamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Having well considered the (disgusting) origin of flesh and the (cruelty of) fettering and slaying corporeal beings, let him entirely abstain from eating flesh.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having well considered the (disgusting) origin of flesh and the (cruelty of) fettering and slaying corporeal beings, let him entirely abstain from eating flesh.
verses.hindi: खी, चालक, युवती या डद हो, पर उसको घर में कोई काम स्वतन्त्रता से न करना चाहिप। खी वालकपन में पिता की आशा में, जवानी में पति की आशा में और पति के वाद पुत्रों को आशा पति चा पुत्रां से जुदा रहने की इच्छा न करे। अलग रहने से
verses.science: खी, चालक, युवती या डद हो, पर उसको घर में कोई काम स्वतन्त्रता से न करना चाहिप। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न भक्षयति यो मांसं विधिं हित्वा पिशाचवत् । न लोके प्रियतां याति व्याधिभिश्च न पीड्यते
verses.transliteration: na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ vidhiṃ hitvā piśācavat | na loke priyatāṃ yāti vyādhibhiśca na pīḍyate
verses.translation: He who, disregarding the rule (given above), does not eat meat like a Pisaka, becomes dear to men, and will not be tormented by diseases.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who, disregarding the rule (given above), does not eat meat like a Pisaka, becomes dear to men, and will not be tormented by diseases.
verses.hindi: अनृतावृतुकाले च मन्त्रसंस्कारकुरपतिः सुखस्य नित्य दातेह परलोके च योषितः
verses.science: अनृतावृतुकाले च मन्त्रसंस्कारकुरपतिः सुखस्य नित्य दातेह परलोके च योषितः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: अनुमन्ता विशसिता निहन्ता क्रयविक्रयी । संस्कर्ता चोपहर्ता च खादकश्चेति घातकाः
verses.transliteration: anumantā viśasitā nihantā krayavikrayī | saṃskartā copahartā ca khādakaśceti ghātakāḥ
verses.translation: He who permits (the slaughter of an animal), he who cuts it up, he who kills it, he who buys or sells (meat), he who cooks it, he who serves it up, and he who eats it, (must all be considered as) the slayers (of the animal).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who permits (the slaughter of an animal), he who cuts it up, he who kills it, he who buys or sells (meat), he who cooks it, he who serves it up, and he who eats it, (must all be considered as) the slayers (of the animal).
verses.hindi: विशीलः कासइत्तो वा गशेवो परिवर्जितः ।
verses.science: विशीलः कासइत्तो वा गशेवो परिवर्जितः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वमांसं परमांसेन यो वर्धयितुमिच्छति । अनभ्यर्च्य पितॄन् देवांस्ततोऽन्यो नास्त्यपुण्यकृत्
verses.transliteration: svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayitumicchati | anabhyarcya pitṝn devāṃstato'nyo nāstyapuṇyakṛt
verses.translation: There is no greater sinner than that (man) who, though not worshipping the gods or the manes, seeks to increase (the bulk of) his own flesh by the flesh of other (beings).
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no greater sinner than that (man) who, though not worshipping the gods or the manes, seeks to increase (the bulk of) his own flesh by the flesh of other (beings).
verses.hindi: 'चेचाइ म जो भजापतियज्ञ किया जाता है वह ख्रियां के मड लाथ हैं  आर पात होने में वाग्दान ही कारण ह । मन्त्रा सं काल म खदा खी को सुख देनेवाला है । पति लोक-परलोक दोनों में खुखदाता है । पति चाहे कुशील हो, मन माना हो, अच्छे
verses.science: 'चेचाइ म जो भजापतियज्ञ किया जाता है वह ख्रियां के मड लाथ हैं आर पात होने में वाग्दान ही कारण ह। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्षे वर्षेऽश्वमेधेन यो यजेत शतं समाः । मांसानि च न खादेद्यस्तयोः पुण्यफलं समम्
verses.transliteration: varṣe varṣe'śvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ | māṃsāni ca na khādedyastayoḥ puṇyaphalaṃ samam
verses.translation: He who during a hundred years annually offers a horse-sacrifice, and he who entirely abstains from meat, obtain the same reward for their meritorious (conduct).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who during a hundred years annually offers a horse-sacrifice, and he who entirely abstains from meat, obtain the same reward for their meritorious (conduct).
verses.hindi: कामं तु क्षपयेदेह पुष्पसूलफलेः शुभेः ।
verses.science: कामं तु क्षपयेदेह पुष्पसूलफलेः शुभेः। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: फलमूलाशनैर्मेध्यैर्मुन्यन्नानां च भोजनैः । न तत्फलमवाप्नोति यत्मांसपरिवर्जनात्
verses.transliteration: phalamūlāśanairmedhyairmunyannānāṃ ca bhojanaiḥ | na tatphalamavāpnoti yatmāṃsaparivarjanāt
verses.translation: By subsisting on pure fruit and roots, and by eating food fit for ascetics (in the forest), one does not gain (so great) a reward as by entirely avoiding (the use of) flesh.
verses.commentary: Sense: By subsisting on pure fruit and roots, and by eating food fit for ascetics (in the forest), one does not gain (so great) a reward as by entirely avoiding (the use of) flesh.
verses.hindi: सियो के लिए अलग यश, अत वा उपचास कुछ भी नहीं हैं, उनके लिए पति की सेवा ही. स्वगे देनेवाली है। जी पतित्रता खी पमे पतिलोक की इच्छा करे, यह पति के जीवन में, या मरण से उसके विरुद्ध कोई आचरण न करे । विधवा खी को फूल) फल
verses.science: सियो के लिए अलग यश, अत वा उपचास कुछ भी नहीं हैं, उनके लिए पति की सेवा ही. स्वगे देनेवाली है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: मां स भक्षयिताऽमुत्र यस्य मांसमिहाद्म्यहम् । एतत्मांसस्य मांसत्वं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: māṃ sa bhakṣayitā'mutra yasya māṃsamihādmyaham | etatmāṃsasya māṃsatvaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: 'Me he (mam sah)' will devour in the next (world), whose flesh I eat in this (life); the wise declare this (to be) the real meaning of the word 'flesh' (mamsah).
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Me he (mam sah)' will devour in the next (world), whose flesh I eat in this (life); the wise declare this (to be) the real meaning of the word 'flesh' (mamsah).
verses.hindi: जा स्त्री रूप, घन आदि से रहित अपने पति को छोड़कर. दूसरे. पुरुष की सेवा करती है वह संसार में निन्दा पाती है और इसका. अशुक पाते पहला है अमुक दूसरा है इस घकार लोग. कहतें हैं। जा छा पति को छोड़कर व्यभिचार करती है चह जगत् मे. निन्दां -
verses.science: जा स्त्री रूप, घन आदि से रहित अपने पति को छोड़कर. दूसरे. पुरुष की सेवा करती है वह संसार में निन्दा पाती है और इसका. अशुक पाते पहला है अमुक दूसरा है इस घकार ल…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न मांसभक्षणे दोषो न मद्ये न च मैथुने । प्रवृत्तिरेषा भूतानां निवृत्तिस्तु महाफला
verses.transliteration: na māṃsabhakṣaṇe doṣo na madye na ca maithune | pravṛttireṣā bhūtānāṃ nivṛttistu mahāphalā
verses.translation: There is no sin in eating meat, in (drinking) spirituous liquor, and in carnal intercourse, for that is the natural way of created beings, but abstention brings great rewards.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no sin in eating meat, in (drinking) spirituous liquor, and in carnal intercourse, for that is the natural way of created beings, but abstention brings great rewards.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए  द्विजातियाँ को उह विधि के, अनुसार, नित्य पञ्चमहायज्ञ करना !और विवाह करके आयु का दूसरा भाग शुहस्थाअ्रम मे पिताना चाहिए ॥ १६७-१६९ ॥
verses.science: करना चाहिए द्विजातियाँ को उह विधि के, अनुसार, नित्य पञ्चमहायज्ञ करना !और विवाह करके आयु का दूसरा भाग शुहस्थाअ्रम मे पिताना चाहिए ॥ १६७-१६९ ॥। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रेतशुद्धिं प्रवक्ष्यामि द्रव्यशुद्धिं तथैव च । चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां यथावदनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: pretaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi dravyaśuddhiṃ tathaiva ca | caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ
verses.translation: I will now in due order explain the purification for the dead and the purification of things as they are prescribed for the four castes (varna).
verses.commentary: Sense: I will now in due order explain the purification for the dead and the purification of things as they are prescribed for the four castes (varna).
verses.hindi: मुन्यज्नेविविधेमेध्येः शाकंसूलफलेनं को ।
verses.science: मुन्यज्नेविविधेमेध्येः शाकंसूलफलेनं को। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: दन्तजातेऽनुजाते च कृतचूडे च संस्थिते । अशुद्धा बान्धवाः सर्वे सूतके च तथौच्यते
verses.transliteration: dantajāte'nujāte ca kṛtacūḍe ca saṃsthite | aśuddhā bāndhavāḥ sarve sūtake ca tathaucyate
verses.translation: When (a child) dies that has teethed, or that before teething has received (the sacrament of) the tonsure (Kudakarana) or (of the initiation), all relatives (become) impure, and on the birth (of a child) the same (rule) is prescribed.
verses.commentary: Sense: When (a child) dies that has teethed, or that before teething has received (the sacrament of) the tonsure (Kudakarana) or (of the initiation), all relatives (become) impure, and on the birth (of a child) the same (rule) is prescribed.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक
verses.science: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के. आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े. साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: दशाहं शावमाशौचं सपिण्डेषु विधीयते । अर्वाक्सञ्चयनादस्थ्नां त्र्यहमेकाहमेव वा
verses.transliteration: daśāhaṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate | arvāksañcayanādasthnāṃ tryahamekāhameva vā
verses.translation: It is ordained (that) among Sapindas the impurity on account of a death (shall last) ten days, (or) until the bones have been collected, (or) three days or one day only.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is ordained (that) among Sapindas the impurity on account of a death (shall last) ten days, (or) until the bones have been collected, (or) three days or one day only.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक
verses.science: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के. आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े. साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: सपिण्डता तु पुरुषे सप्तमे विनिवर्तते । समानोदकभावस्तु जन्मनाम्नोरवेदने
verses.transliteration: sapiṇḍatā tu puruṣe saptame vinivartate | samānodakabhāvastu janmanāmnoravedane
verses.translation: But the Sapinda-relationship ceases with the seventh person (in the ascending and descending lines), the Samanodaka-relationship when the (common) origin and the (existence of a common family)-name are no (longer) known.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the Sapinda-relationship ceases with the seventh person (in the ascending and descending lines), the Samanodaka-relationship when the (common) origin and the (existence of a common family)-name are no (longer) known.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: यथैदं शावमाशौचं सपिण्डेषु विधीयते । जननेऽप्येवमेव स्यात्निपुणं शुद्धिमिच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: yathaidaṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate | janane'pyevameva syātnipuṇaṃ śuddhimicchatām
verses.translation: As this impurity on account of a death is prescribed for (all) Sapindas, even so it shall be (held) on a birth by those who desire to be absolutely pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: As this impurity on account of a death is prescribed for (all) Sapindas, even so it shall be (held) on a birth by those who desire to be absolutely pure.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां शावमाशौचं मातापित्रोस्तु सूतकम् । (जननेऽप्येवमेव स्यान् मातापित्रोस्तु सूतकम् ।) सूतकं मातुरेव स्यादुपस्पृश्य पिता शुचिः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ mātāpitrostu sūtakam | (janane'pyevameva syān mātāpitrostu sūtakam |) sūtakaṃ mātureva syādupaspṛśya pitā śuciḥ
verses.translation: (Or while) the impurity on account of a death is common to all (Sapindas), that caused by a birth (falls) on the parents alone; (or) it shall fall on the mother alone, and the father shall become pure by bathing;
verses.commentary: Sense: (Or while) the impurity on account of a death is common to all (Sapindas), that caused by a birth (falls) on the parents alone; (or) it shall fall on the mother alone, and the father shall become pure by bathing;

verses.sanskrit: निरस्य तु पुमांशुक्रमुपस्पृस्यैव शुध्यति । बैजिकादभिसम्बन्धादनुरुन्ध्यादघं त्र्यहम्
verses.transliteration: nirasya tu pumāṃśukramupaspṛsyaiva śudhyati | baijikādabhisambandhādanurundhyādaghaṃ tryaham
verses.translation: But a man, having spent his strength, is purified merely by bathing; after begetting a child (on a remarried female), he shall retain the impurity during three days.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a man, having spent his strength, is purified merely by bathing; after begetting a child (on a remarried female), he shall retain the impurity during three days.

verses.sanskrit: अह्ना चैकेन रात्र्या च त्रिरात्रैरेव च त्रिभिः । शवस्पृशो विशुध्यन्ति त्र्यहादुदकदायिनः
verses.transliteration: ahnā caikena rātryā ca trirātraireva ca tribhiḥ | śavaspṛśo viśudhyanti tryahādudakadāyinaḥ
verses.translation: Those who have touched a corpse are purified after one day and night (added to) three periods of three days; those who give libations of water, after three days.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have touched a corpse are purified after one day and night (added to) three periods of three days; those who give libations of water, after three days.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोः प्रेतस्य शिष्यस्तु पितृमेधं समाचरन् । प्रेतहारैः समं तत्र दशरात्रेण शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: guroḥ pretasya śiṣyastu pitṛmedhaṃ samācaran | pretahāraiḥ samaṃ tatra daśarātreṇa śudhyati
verses.translation: A pupil who performs the Pitrimedha for his deceased teacher, becomes also pure after ten days, just like those who carry the corpse out (to the burial-ground).
verses.commentary: Sense: A pupil who performs the Pitrimedha for his deceased teacher, becomes also pure after ten days, just like those who carry the corpse out (to the burial-ground).

verses.sanskrit: प्रेताहारैः रात्रिभिर्मासतुल्याभिर्गर्भस्रावे विशुध्यति । रजस्युपरते साध्वी स्नानेन स्त्री रजस्वला
verses.transliteration: pretāhāraiḥ rātribhirmāsatulyābhirgarbhasrāve viśudhyati | rajasyuparate sādhvī snānena strī rajasvalā
verses.translation: (A woman) is purified on a miscarriage in as many (days and) nights as months (elapsed after conception), and a menstruating female becomes pure by bathing after the menstrual secretion has ceased (to flow).
verses.commentary: Sense: (A woman) is purified on a miscarriage in as many (days and) nights as months (elapsed after conception), and a menstruating female becomes pure by bathing after the menstrual secretion has ceased (to flow).

verses.sanskrit: नृणामकृतचूडानां विशुद्धिर्नैशिकी स्मृता । निर्वृत्तचूडकानां तु त्रिरात्रात्शुद्धिरिष्यते
verses.transliteration: nṛṇāmakṛtacūḍānāṃ viśuddhirnaiśikī smṛtā | nirvṛttacūḍakānāṃ tu trirātrātśuddhiriṣyate
verses.translation: (On the death) of children whose tonsure (Kudakarman) has not been performed, the (Sapindas) are declared to become pure in one (day and) night; (on the death) of those who have received the tonsure (but not the initiation, the law) ordains (that) the purification (takes place) after three days.

verses.sanskrit: निर्वृत्तमुण्डकानां ऊनद्विवार्षिकं प्रेतं निदध्युर्बान्धवा बहिः । अलङ्कृत्य शुचौ भूमावस्थिसञ्चयनादृते
verses.transliteration: nirvṛttamuṇḍakānāṃ ūnadvivārṣikaṃ pretaṃ nidadhyurbāndhavā bahiḥ | alaṅkṛtya śucau bhūmāvasthisañcayanādṛte
verses.translation: A child that has died before the completion of its second year, the relatives shall carry out (of the village), decked (with flowers, and bury it) in pure ground, without collecting the bones (afterwards).
verses.commentary: Sense: A child that has died before the completion of its second year, the relatives shall carry out (of the village), decked (with flowers, and bury it) in pure ground, without collecting the bones (afterwards).
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: नास्य कार्योऽग्निसंस्कारो न च कार्यौदकक्रिया । अरण्ये काष्ठवत्त्यक्त्वा क्षपेयुस्त्र्यहमेव तु
verses.transliteration: nāsya kāryo'gnisaṃskāro na ca kāryaudakakriyā | araṇye kāṣṭhavattyaktvā kṣapeyustryahameva tu
verses.translation: Such (a child) shall not be burnt with fire, and no libations of water shall be offered to it; leaving it like a (log of) wood in the forest, (the relatives) shall remain impure during three days only.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such (a child) shall not be burnt with fire, and no libations of water shall be offered to it; leaving it like a (log of) wood in the forest, (the relatives) shall remain impure during three days only.

verses.sanskrit: क्षपेत त्र्यहमेव च नात्रिवर्षस्य कर्तव्या बान्धवैरुदकक्रिया । जातदन्तस्य वा कुर्युर्नाम्नि वाऽपि कृते सति
verses.transliteration: kṣapeta tryahameva ca nātrivarṣasya kartavyā bāndhavairudakakriyā | jātadantasya vā kuryurnāmni vā'pi kṛte sati
verses.translation: The relatives shall not offer libations to (a child) that has not reached the third year; but if it had teeth, or the ceremony of naming it (Namakarman) had been performed, (the offering of water is) optional.
verses.commentary: Sense: The relatives shall not offer libations to (a child) that has not reached the third year; but if it had teeth, or the ceremony of naming it (Namakarman) had been performed, (the offering of water is) optional.

verses.sanskrit: सब्रह्मचारिण्येकाहमतीते क्षपणं स्मृतम् । जन्मन्येकौदकानां तु त्रिरात्रात्शुद्धिरिष्यते
verses.transliteration: sabrahmacāriṇyekāhamatīte kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam | janmanyekaudakānāṃ tu trirātrātśuddhiriṣyate
verses.translation: If a fellow-student has died, the Smriti prescribes an impurity of one day; on a birth the purification of the Samanodakas is declared (to take place) after three (days and) nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a fellow-student has died, the Smriti prescribes an impurity of one day; on a birth the purification of the Samanodakas is declared (to take place) after three (days and) nights.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीणामसंस्कृतानां तु त्र्यहात्शुध्यन्ति बान्धवाः । यथौक्तेनैव कल्पेन शुध्यन्ति तु सनाभयः
verses.transliteration: strīṇāmasaṃskṛtānāṃ tu tryahātśudhyanti bāndhavāḥ | yathauktenaiva kalpena śudhyanti tu sanābhayaḥ
verses.translation: (On the death) of females (betrothed but) not married (the bridegroom and his) relatives are purified after three days, and the paternal relatives become pure according to the same rule.
verses.commentary: Sense: (On the death) of females (betrothed but) not married (the bridegroom and his) relatives are purified after three days, and the paternal relatives become pure according to the same rule.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षारलवणान्नाः स्युर्निमज्जेयुश्च ते त्र्यहम् । मांसाशनं च नाश्नीयुः शयीरंश्च पृथक्क्षितौ
verses.transliteration: akṣāralavaṇānnāḥ syurnimajjeyuśca te tryaham | māṃsāśanaṃ ca nāśnīyuḥ śayīraṃśca pṛthakkṣitau
verses.translation: Let (mourners) eat food without factitious salt, bathe during three days, abstain from meat, and sleep separate on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let (mourners) eat food without factitious salt, bathe during three days, abstain from meat, and sleep separate on the ground.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: संनिधावेष वै कल्पः शावाशौचस्य कीर्तितः । असंनिधावयं ज्ञेयो विधिः सम्बन्धिबान्धवैः
verses.transliteration: saṃnidhāveṣa vai kalpaḥ śāvāśaucasya kīrtitaḥ | asaṃnidhāvayaṃ jñeyo vidhiḥ sambandhibāndhavaiḥ
verses.translation: The above rule regarding impurity on account of a death has been prescribed (for cases where the kinsmen live) near (the deceased); (Sapinda) kinsmen and (Samanodaka) relatives must know the following rule (to refer to cases where deceased lived) at a distance (from them).
verses.commentary: Sense: The above rule regarding impurity on account of a death has been prescribed (for cases where the kinsmen live) near (the deceased); (Sapinda) kinsmen and (Samanodaka) relatives must know the following rule (to refer to cases where deceased lived) at a distance (from them).

verses.sanskrit: विगतं तु विदेशस्थं शृणुयाद्यो ह्यनिर्दशम् । यत्शेषं दशरात्रस्य तावदेवाशुचिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vigataṃ tu videśasthaṃ śṛṇuyādyo hyanirdaśam | yatśeṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvadevāśucirbhavet
verses.translation: He who may hear that (a relative) residing in a distant country has died, before ten (days after his death have elapsed), shall be impure for the remainder of the period of ten (days and) nights only.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who may hear that (a relative) residing in a distant country has died, before ten (days after his death have elapsed), shall be impure for the remainder of the period of ten (days and) nights only.

verses.sanskrit: अतिक्रान्ते दशाहे च त्रिरात्रमशुचिर्भवेत् । संवत्सरे व्यतीते तु स्पृष्ट्वैवापो विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: atikrānte daśāhe ca trirātramaśucirbhavet | saṃvatsare vyatīte tu spṛṣṭvaivāpo viśudhyati
verses.translation: If the ten days have passed, he shall be impure during three (days and) nights; but if a year has elapsed (since the occurrence of the death), he becomes pure merely by bathing.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the ten days have passed, he shall be impure during three (days and) nights; but if a year has elapsed (since the occurrence of the death), he becomes pure merely by bathing.

verses.sanskrit: निर्दशं ज्ञातिमरणं श्रुत्वा पुत्रस्य जन्म च । सवासा जलमाप्लुत्य शुद्धो भवति मानवः
verses.transliteration: nirdaśaṃ jñātimaraṇaṃ śrutvā putrasya janma ca | savāsā jalamāplutya śuddho bhavati mānavaḥ
verses.translation: A man who hears of a (Sapinda) relative's death, or of the birth of a son after the ten days (of impurity have passed), becomes pure by bathing, dressed in his garments.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who hears of a (Sapinda) relative's death, or of the birth of a son after the ten days (of impurity have passed), becomes pure by bathing, dressed in his garments.

verses.sanskrit: बाले देशान्तरस्थे च पृथक्पिण्डे च संस्थिते । सवासा जलमाप्लुत्य सद्य एव विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: bāle deśāntarasthe ca pṛthakpiṇḍe ca saṃsthite | savāsā jalamāplutya sadya eva viśudhyati
verses.translation: If an infant (that has not teethed), or a (grownup relative who is) not a Sapinda, die in a distant country, one becomes at once pure after bathing in one's clothes.
verses.commentary: Sense: If an infant (that has not teethed), or a (grownup relative who is) not a Sapinda, die in a distant country, one becomes at once pure after bathing in one's clothes.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्दशाहे स्यातां चेत्पुनर्मरणजन्मनी । चेत्स्यातां तावत्स्यादशुचिर्विप्रो यावत्तत्स्यादनिर्दशम्
verses.transliteration: antardaśāhe syātāṃ cetpunarmaraṇajanmanī | cetsyātāṃ tāvatsyādaśucirvipro yāvattatsyādanirdaśam
verses.translation: If within the ten days (of impurity) another birth or death happens, a Brahmana shall remain impure only until the (first) period of ten days has expired.
verses.commentary: Sense: If within the ten days (of impurity) another birth or death happens, a Brahmana shall remain impure only until the (first) period of ten days has expired.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरात्रमाहुराशौचमाचार्ये संस्थिते सति । तस्य पुत्रे च पत्न्यां च दिवारात्रमिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: trirātramāhurāśaucamācārye saṃsthite sati | tasya putre ca patnyāṃ ca divārātramiti sthitiḥ
verses.translation: They declare that, when the teacher (akarya) has died, the impurity (lasts) three days; if the (teacher's) son or wife (is dead, it lasts) a day and a night; that is a settled (rule).
verses.commentary: Sense: They declare that, when the teacher (akarya) has died, the impurity (lasts) three days; if the (teacher's) son or wife (is dead, it lasts) a day and a night; that is a settled (rule).

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रिये तूपसम्पन्ने त्रिरात्रमशुचिर्भवेत् । मातुले पक्षिणीं रात्रिं शिष्यर्त्विग्बान्धवेषु च
verses.transliteration: śrotriye tūpasampanne trirātramaśucirbhavet | mātule pakṣiṇīṃ rātriṃ śiṣyartvigbāndhaveṣu ca
verses.translation: For a Srotriya who resides with (him out of affection), a man shall be impure for three days; for a maternal uncle, a pupil, an officiating priest, or a maternal relative, for one night together with the preceding and following days.
verses.commentary: Sense: For a Srotriya who resides with (him out of affection), a man shall be impure for three days; for a maternal uncle, a pupil, an officiating priest, or a maternal relative, for one night together with the preceding and following days.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेते राजनि सज्योतिर्यस्य स्याद्विषये स्थितः । अश्रोत्रिये त्वहः कृत्स्नमनूचाने तथा गुरौ
verses.transliteration: prete rājani sajyotiryasya syādviṣaye sthitaḥ | aśrotriye tvahaḥ kṛtsnamanūcāne tathā gurau
verses.translation: If the king in whose realm he resides is dead, (he shall be impure) as long as the light (of the sun or stars shines), but for (an intimate friend) who is not a Srotriya (the impurity lasts) for a whole day, likewise for a Guru who knows the Veda and the Angas.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the king in whose realm he resides is dead, (he shall be impure) as long as the light (of the sun or stars shines), but for (an intimate friend) who is not a Srotriya (the impurity lasts) for a whole day, likewise for a Guru who knows the Veda and the Angas.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्स्नां शुद्ध्येद्विप्रो दशाहेन द्वादशाहेन भूमिपः । वैश्यः पञ्चदशाहेन शूद्रो मासेन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: kṛtsnāṃ śuddhyedvipro daśāhena dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ | vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śudhyati
verses.translation: A Brahmana shall be pure after ten days, a Kshatriya after twelve, a Vaisya after fifteen, and a Sudra is purified after a month.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana shall be pure after ten days, a Kshatriya after twelve, a Vaisya after fifteen, and a Sudra is purified after a month.

verses.science: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के. आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े. साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: न वर्धयेदघाहानि प्रत्यूहेन्नाग्निषु क्रियाः । न च तत्कर्म कुर्वाणः सनाभ्योऽप्यशुचिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: na vardhayedaghāhāni pratyūhennāgniṣu kriyāḥ | na ca tatkarma kurvāṇaḥ sanābhyo'pyaśucirbhavet
verses.translation: Let him not (unnecessarily) lengthen the period of impurity, nor interrupt the rites to be performed with the sacred fires; for he who performs that (Agnihotra) rite will not be impure, though (he be) a (Sapinda) relative.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him not (unnecessarily) lengthen the period of impurity, nor interrupt the rites to be performed with the sacred fires; for he who performs that (Agnihotra) rite will not be impure, though (he be) a (Sapinda) relative.

verses.sanskrit: दिवाकीर्तिमुदक्यां च पतितं सूतिकां तथा । शवं तत्स्पृष्टिनं चैव स्पृष्ट्वा स्नानेन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: divākīrtimudakyāṃ ca patitaṃ sūtikāṃ tathā | śavaṃ tatspṛṣṭinaṃ caiva spṛṣṭvā snānena śudhyati
verses.translation: When he has touched a Kandala, a menstruating woman, an outcast, a woman in childbed, a corpse, or one who has touched a (corpse), he becomes pure by bathing.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he has touched a Kandala, a menstruating woman, an outcast, a woman in childbed, a corpse, or one who has touched a (corpse), he becomes pure by bathing.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: आचम्य प्रयतो नित्यं जपेदशुचिदर्शने । सौरान् मन्त्रान् यथोत्साहं पावमानीश्च शक्तितः
verses.transliteration: ācamya prayato nityaṃ japedaśucidarśane | saurān mantrān yathotsāhaṃ pāvamānīśca śaktitaḥ
verses.translation: He who has purified himself by sipping water shall, on seeing any impure (thing or person), always mutter the sacred texts, addressed to Surya, and the Pavamani (verses).
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has purified himself by sipping water shall, on seeing any impure (thing or person), always mutter the sacred texts, addressed to Surya, and the Pavamani (verses).

verses.sanskrit: नारं स्पृष्ट्वाऽस्थि सस्नेहं स्नात्वा विप्रो विशुध्यति । आचम्यैव तु निःस्नेहं गामालभ्यार्कमीक्ष्य वा
verses.transliteration: nāraṃ spṛṣṭvā'sthi sasnehaṃ snātvā vipro viśudhyati | ācamyaiva tu niḥsnehaṃ gāmālabhyārkamīkṣya vā
verses.translation: A Brahmana who has touched a human bone to which fat adheres, becomes pure by bathing; if it be free from fat, by sipping water and by touching (afterwards) a cow or looking at the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who has touched a human bone to which fat adheres, becomes pure by bathing; if it be free from fat, by sipping water and by touching (afterwards) a cow or looking at the sun.

verses.sanskrit: आदिष्टी नोदकं कुर्यादा व्रतस्य समापनात् । समाप्ते तूदकं कृत्वा त्रिरात्रेणैव शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: ādiṣṭī nodakaṃ kuryādā vratasya samāpanāt | samāpte tūdakaṃ kṛtvā trirātreṇaiva śudhyati
verses.translation: He who has undertaken the performance of a vow shall not pour out libations (to the dead) until the vow has been completed; but when he has offered water after its completion, he becomes pure in three days only.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has undertaken the performance of a vow shall not pour out libations (to the dead) until the vow has been completed; but when he has offered water after its completion, he becomes pure in three days only.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: वृथासङ्करजातानां प्रव्रज्यासु च तिष्ठताम् ॥ आत्मनस्त्यागिनां चैव निवर्तेतोदकक्रिया
verses.transliteration: vṛthāsaṅkarajātānāṃ pravrajyāsu ca tiṣṭhatām || ātmanastyāgināṃ caiva nivartetodakakriyā
verses.translation: Libations of water shall not be offered to those who (neglect the prescribed rites and may be said to) have been born in vain, to those born in consequence of an illegal mixture of the castes, to those who are ascetics (of heretical sects), and to those who have committed suicide,
verses.wordMeaning: Libations of water shall not be offered to those who (neglect the prescribed rites and may be said to) have been born in vain, to those born in consequence of an illegal mixture of the castes, to those who are ascetics (of heretical sects),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Libations of water shall not be offered to those who (neglect the prescribed rites and may be said to) have been born in vain, to those born in consequence of an illegal mixture of the castes, to those who are ascetics (of heretical sects),…

verses.sanskrit: पाषण्डमाश्रितानां च चरन्तीनां च कामतः । गर्भभर्तृद्रुहां चैव सुरापीनां च योषिताम्
verses.transliteration: pāṣaṇḍamāśritānāṃ ca carantīnāṃ ca kāmataḥ | garbhabhartṛdruhāṃ caiva surāpīnāṃ ca yoṣitām
verses.translation: To women who have joined a heretical sect, who through lust live (with many men), who have caused an abortion, have killed their husbands, or drink spirituous liquor.
verses.commentary: Sense: To women who have joined a heretical sect, who through lust live (with many men), who have caused an abortion, have killed their husbands, or drink spirituous liquor.

verses.sanskrit: आचार्यं स्वमुपाध्यायं पितरं मातरं गुरुम् । निर्हृत्य तु व्रती प्रेतान्न व्रतेन वियुज्यते
verses.transliteration: ācāryaṃ svamupādhyāyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum | nirhṛtya tu vratī pretānna vratena viyujyate
verses.translation: A student does not break his vow by carrying out (to the place of cremation) his own dead teacher (akarya), sub-teacher (upadhyaya), father, mother, or Guru.
verses.commentary: Sense: A student does not break his vow by carrying out (to the place of cremation) his own dead teacher (akarya), sub-teacher (upadhyaya), father, mother, or Guru.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणेन मृतं शूद्रं पुरद्वारेण निर्हरेत् । पश्चिमौत्तरपूर्वैस्तु यथायोगं द्विजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇena mṛtaṃ śūdraṃ puradvāreṇa nirharet | paścimauttarapūrvaistu yathāyogaṃ dvijanmanaḥ
verses.translation: Let him carry out a dead Sudra by the southern gate of the town, but (the corpses of) twice-born men, as is proper, by the western, northern, or eastern (gates).
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him carry out a dead Sudra by the southern gate of the town, but (the corpses of) twice-born men, as is proper, by the western, northern, or eastern (gates).

verses.sanskrit: न राज्ञामघदोषोऽस्ति व्रतिनां न च सत्त्रिणाम् । ऐन्द्रं स्थानमुपासीना ब्रह्मभूता हि ते सदा
verses.transliteration: na rājñāmaghadoṣo'sti vratināṃ na ca sattriṇām | aindraṃ sthānamupāsīnā brahmabhūtā hi te sadā
verses.translation: The taint of impurity does not fall on kings, and those engaged in the performance of a vow, or of a Sattra; for the (first are) seated on the throne of Indra, and the (last two are) ever pure like Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The taint of impurity does not fall on kings, and those engaged in the performance of a vow, or of a Sattra; for the (first are) seated on the throne of Indra, and the (last two are) ever pure like Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञो महात्मिके स्थाने सद्यःशौचं विधीयते । प्रजानां परिरक्षार्थमासनं चात्र कारणम्
verses.transliteration: rājño mahātmike sthāne sadyaḥśaucaṃ vidhīyate | prajānāṃ parirakṣārthamāsanaṃ cātra kāraṇam
verses.translation: For a king, on the throne of magnanimity, immediate purification is prescribed, and the reason for that is that he is seated (there) for the protection of (his) subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: For a king, on the throne of magnanimity, immediate purification is prescribed, and the reason for that is that he is seated (there) for the protection of (his) subjects.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक
verses.science: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के. आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े. साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: डिम्भाहवहतानां च विद्युता पार्थिवेन च । डिम्बाहवहतानां गोब्राह्मणस्य चेवार्थे यस्य चैच्छति पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: ḍimbhāhavahatānāṃ ca vidyutā pārthivena ca | ḍimbāhavahatānāṃ gobrāhmaṇasya cevārthe yasya caicchati pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: (The same rule applies to the kinsmen) of those who have fallen in a riot or a battle, (of those who have been killed) by lightning or by the king, and (of those who perished fighting) for cows and Brahmanas, and to those whom the king wishes (to be pure).
verses.commentary: Sense: (The same rule applies to the kinsmen) of those who have fallen in a riot or a battle, (of those who have been killed) by lightning or by the king, and (of those who perished fighting) for cows and Brahmanas, and to those whom the king wishes (to be pure).

verses.sanskrit: सोमाग्न्यर्कानिलेन्द्राणां वित्ताप्पत्योर्यमस्य च । अष्टानां लोकपालानां वपुर्धारयते नृपः
verses.transliteration: somāgnyarkānilendrāṇāṃ vittāppatyoryamasya ca | aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ vapurdhārayate nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: A king is an incarnation of the eight guardian deities of the world, the Moon, the Fire, the Sun, the Wind, Indra, the Lords of wealth and water (Kubera and Varuna), and Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king is an incarnation of the eight guardian deities of the world, the Moon, the Fire, the Sun, the Wind, Indra, the Lords of wealth and water (Kubera and Varuna), and Yama.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: लोकेशाधिष्ठितो राजा नास्याशौचं विधीयते । शौचाशौचं हि मर्त्यानां लोकेभ्यः प्रभवाप्ययौ
verses.transliteration: lokeśādhiṣṭhito rājā nāsyāśaucaṃ vidhīyate | śaucāśaucaṃ hi martyānāṃ lokebhyaḥ prabhavāpyayau
verses.translation: Because the king is pervaded by those lords of the world, no impurity is ordained for him; for purity and impurity of mortals is caused and removed by (those) lords of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because the king is pervaded by those lords of the world, no impurity is ordained for him; for purity and impurity of mortals is caused and removed by (those) lords of the world.
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक

verses.sanskrit: उद्यतैराहवे शस्त्रैः क्षत्रधर्महतस्य च । सद्यः संतिष्ठते यज्ञस्तथाऽशौचमिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: udyatairāhave śastraiḥ kṣatradharmahatasya ca | sadyaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate yajñastathā'śaucamiti sthitiḥ
verses.translation: By him who is slain in battle with brandished weapons according to the law of the Kshatriyas, a (Srauta) sacrifice is instantly completed, and so is the period of impurity (caused by his death); that is a settled rule.
verses.commentary: Sense: By him who is slain in battle with brandished weapons according to the law of the Kshatriyas, a (Srauta) sacrifice is instantly completed, and so is the period of impurity (caused by his death); that is a settled rule.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रः शुध्यत्यपः स्पृष्ट्वा क्षत्रियो वाहनायुधम् । वैश्यः प्रतोदं रश्मीन् वा यष्टिं शूद्रः कृतक्रियः
verses.transliteration: vipraḥ śudhyatyapaḥ spṛṣṭvā kṣatriyo vāhanāyudham | vaiśyaḥ pratodaṃ raśmīn vā yaṣṭiṃ śūdraḥ kṛtakriyaḥ
verses.translation: (At the end of the period of impurity) a Brahmana who has performed the necessary rites, becomes pure by touching water, a Kshatriya by touching the animal on which he rides, and his weapons, a Vaisya by touching his goad or the nose-string (of his oxen), a Sudra by touching his staff.
verses.wordMeaning: (At the end of the period of impurity) a Brahmana who has performed the necessary rites, becomes pure by touching water, a Kshatriya by touching the animal on which he rides, and his weapons, a Vaisya by touching his goad or the nose-string (of his oxen),…
verses.commentary: Sense: (At the end of the period of impurity) a Brahmana who has performed the necessary rites, becomes pure by touching water, a Kshatriya by touching the animal on which he rides, and his weapons, a Vaisya by touching his goad or the nose-string (of his oxen),…
verses.hindi: जव गहरु्थ अपने शरीर की खाल ढीली, चाल पका, और पुत्र. के.  आहार और घर का. सामान: छोड़कर, स्री को. पुत्रों के. पास छोड़े.   साथ रके और जितेन्द्रिय होकर निवास करे। नानाभाँति के. - किया करे ॥ ६-शक
