verses.commentary: Sense: If (a child) be born in a man's house and his father be not known, he is a son born secretly in the house (Gudhotpanna), and shall belong to him of whose wife he was born.
verses.science: समेहि विषमं यस्तु चरेहै सुल्यतोऽपि वा। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: मातापितृभ्यामुत्सृष्टं तयोरन्यतरेण वा । यं पुत्रं परिगृह्णीयादपविद्धः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: mātāpitṛbhyāmutsṛṣṭaṃ tayoranyatareṇa vā | yaṃ putraṃ parigṛhṇīyādapaviddhaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: He whom (a man) receives as his son, (after he has been) deserted by his parents or by either of them, is called a son cast off (Apaviddha).
verses.hindi: चिकित्सा करनेवाले उलडी चिकित्सा करें तो पशु. आदि के 0 , विषय में ढाई खो पण और मखुप्यो के विषयमे पांच सौ पण दण्ड ” करे "नदी के पुलका काठ, राजपताका का ठण्डा और मूर्तियों" - को तोडनेचाला)'उन सबको फिर चनबाढे और पांच सौ पण दरू
verses.commentary: Sense: He whom (a man) receives as his son, (after he has been) deserted by his parents or by either of them, is called a son cast off (Apaviddha).
verses.science: चिकित्सा करनेवाले उलडी चिकित्सा करें तो पशु. आदि के 0 , विषय में ढाई खो पण और मखुप्यो के विषयमे पांच सौ पण दण्ड ” करे "नदी के पुलका काठ, राजपताका का ठण्डा और…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पितृवेश्मनि कन्या तु यं पुत्रं जनयेद्रहः । तं कानीनं वदेन्नाम्ना वोढुः कन्यासमुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: pitṛveśmani kanyā tu yaṃ putraṃ janayedrahaḥ | taṃ kānīnaṃ vadennāmnā voḍhuḥ kanyāsamudbhavam
verses.translation: A son whom a damsel secretly bears in the house of her father, one shall name the son of an unmarried damsel (Kanina, and declare) such offspring of an unmarried girl (to belong) to him who weds her (afterwards).
verses.hindi: सव चोरों में महापापी खुनार यदि फोर दुराचार करे तो  “उसको चाकू से दकडे इकडे करवादे । खेती के हल, कुदाल
verses.commentary: Sense: A son whom a damsel secretly bears in the house of her father, one shall name the son of an unmarried damsel (Kanina, and declare) such offspring of an unmarried girl (to belong) to him who weds her (afterwards).
verses.science: सव चोरों में महापापी खुनार यदि फोर दुराचार करे तो “उसको चाकू से दकडे इकडे करवादे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: या गर्भिणी संस्क्रियते ज्ञाताऽज्ञाताऽपि वा सती । वोढुः स गर्भो भवति सहोढ इति चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: yā garbhiṇī saṃskriyate jñātā'jñātā'pi vā satī | voḍhuḥ sa garbho bhavati sahoḍha iti cocyate
verses.translation: If one marries, either knowingly or unknowingly, a pregnant (bride), the child in her womb belongs to him who weds her, and is called (a son) received with the bride (Sahodha).
verses.hindi: अङ्ग की हात्ति होने से आगे के अङ्ग पर बड़ा दुःख आपड़ता है। - जैसे तीन दरड, एक दूखरे के आधार पर रुके रहते हें, वेले सात..: प्रत्येक अङ्ग अपनी बिशेषता से समानहै। जिससे जो काम सघताहि जाना करे । सब प्रकार की पीड़ा और व्यसनो का गोरव-लाघव :
verses.commentary: Sense: If one marries, either knowingly or unknowingly, a pregnant (bride), the child in her womb belongs to him who weds her, and is called (a son) received with the bride (Sahodha).
verses.science: अङ्ग की हात्ति होने से आगे के अङ्ग पर बड़ा दुःख आपड़ता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रीणीयाद्यस्त्वपत्यार्थं मातापित्रोर्यमन्तिकात् । स क्रीतकः सुतस्तस्य सदृशोऽसदृशोऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: krīṇīyādyastvapatyārthaṃ mātāpitroryamantikāt | sa krītakaḥ sutastasya sadṛśo'sadṛśo'pi vā
verses.translation: If a man buys a (boy), whether equal or unequal (in good qualities), from his father and mother for the sake of having a son, that (child) is called a (son) bought (Kritaka).
verses.hindi: कमे करनेवाले को दी लक्ष्मी. पापं होती है । खत्ययुम, जेताथुग,. -' छापरयुग और कलियुग, सब राज्ञा के कार्यों परही आधार रखते: - हैं क्‍योंकि राजाही भले-्डुरे समय, का कारण: है-युगस्वरूप...  हे! जव राजा आलस्य, निद्रा में खमय वितावे तो कलियुग, जव:
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man buys a (boy), whether equal or unequal (in good qualities), from his father and mother for the sake of having a son, that (child) is called a (son) bought (Kritaka).
verses.science: कमे करनेवाले को दी लक्ष्मी. पापं होती है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: या पत्या वा परित्यक्ता विधवा वा स्वयेच्छया । उत्पादयेत्पुनर्भूत्वा स पौनर्भव उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yā patyā vā parityaktā vidhavā vā svayecchayā | utpādayetpunarbhūtvā sa paunarbhava ucyate
verses.translation: If a woman abandoned by her husband, or a widow, of her own accord contracts a second marriage and bears (a son), he is called the son of a re-married woman (Paunarbhava).
verses.hindi: करता है चैते राजा-इनद के आचरण से अपने देशकी प्रजा को सन्तुए करे। जैसे आठ मास सूर्य अपने तेजसे पृथ्वीका जन खींच लेता है, वैसे राजा सूर्य फी भांति आचरण करके प्रज्ञा को दुःख न देकर राउय-फरलेवे । जसं वायु भाणरूप से सय प्राणियों में
verses.commentary: Sense: If a woman abandoned by her husband, or a widow, of her own accord contracts a second marriage and bears (a son), he is called the son of a re-married woman (Paunarbhava).
verses.science: करता है चैते राजा-इनद के आचरण से अपने देशकी प्रजा को सन्तुए करे। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: सा चेदक्षतयोनिः स्याद्गतप्रत्यागताऽपि वा । पौनर्भवेन भर्त्रा सा पुनः संस्कारमर्हति
verses.transliteration: sā cedakṣatayoniḥ syādgatapratyāgatā'pi vā | paunarbhavena bhartrā sā punaḥ saṃskāramarhati
verses.translation: If she be (still) a virgin, or one who returned (to her first husband) after leaving him, she is worthy to again perform with her second (or first deserted) husband the (nuptial) ceremony.
verses.hindi: "३७७   . मनुरुदंति। जैसे वरूण अपराधियों को अपने पाशो से वॉधता हे, चेले राजा को देखकर खुश होते हँ, वैसे प्रजामएडल जिस सजा को देख कर खुश हो वह राजा चन्द्रबतघारी है । पापियों' पर अग्नि के
verses.commentary: Sense: If she be (still) a virgin, or one who returned (to her first husband) after leaving him, she is worthy to again perform with her second (or first deserted) husband the (nuptial) ceremony.
verses.science: "३७७ . मनुरुदंति। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: मातापितृविहीनो यस्त्यक्तो वा स्यादकारणात् । आत्मानमर्पयेद्यस्मै स्वयंदत्तस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: mātāpitṛvihīno yastyakto vā syādakāraṇāt | ātmānamarpayedyasmai svayaṃdattastu sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He who, having lost his parents or being abandoned (by them) without (just) cause, gives himself to a (man), is called a son self-given (Svayamdatta).
verses.hindi: स्वर्गादि लोक और देवता, जिनके आश्रय खे टिके रहते है और वेददी जिन फा धन है उन ब्राह्मणो को कौन मारना चाहेगा! देवता है, वैसे माण विद्वान् या सूखे हो महान देवता है । ते सब तिदित कामा फे करने पर भी सर्वथा पूज्य हे, मदान,
verses.commentary: Sense: He who, having lost his parents or being abandoned (by them) without (just) cause, gives himself to a (man), is called a son self-given (Svayamdatta).
verses.science: स्वर्गादि लोक और देवता, जिनके आश्रय खे टिके रहते है और वेददी जिन फा धन है उन ब्राह्मणो को कौन मारना चाहेगा! देवता है, वैसे माण विद्वान् या सूखे हो महान देवता है। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यं ब्राह्मणस्तु शूद्रायां कामादुत्पादयेत्सुतम् । स पारयन्नेव शवस्तस्मात्पारशवः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yaṃ brāhmaṇastu śūdrāyāṃ kāmādutpādayetsutam | sa pārayanneva śavastasmātpāraśavaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The son whom a Brahmana begets through lust on a Sudra female is, (though) alive (parayan), a corpse (sava), and hence called a Parasava (a living corpse).
verses.hindi: हुआ है । इनको पैदा करनेवाला व्यापक तेज अपने कारण में लिये दोनों मिलकर रहें तभी लोक-परलोक में बृद्धि पाते ईं, समर्पण करके रण मै भाणत्याग करे॥ ३२०-३२३॥
verses.commentary: Sense: The son whom a Brahmana begets through lust on a Sudra female is, (though) alive (parayan), a corpse (sava), and hence called a Parasava (a living corpse).
verses.science: हुआ है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: दास्यां वा दासदास्यां वा यः शूद्रस्य सुतो भवेत् । सोऽनुज्ञातो हरेदंशमिति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: dāsyāṃ vā dāsadāsyāṃ vā yaḥ śūdrasya suto bhavet | so'nujñāto haredaṃśamiti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: A son who is (begotten) by a Sudra on a female slave, or on the female slave of his slave, may, if permitted (by his father), take a share (of the inheritance); thus the law is settled.
verses.hindi: एषोऽखिलः कर्मविधिरुक्ो राज्ञः सनातनः। :
verses.commentary: Sense: A son who is (begotten) by a Sudra on a female slave, or on the female slave of his slave, may, if permitted (by his father), take a share (of the inheritance); thus the law is settled.
verses.science: एषोऽखिलः कर्मविधिरुक्ो राज्ञः सनातनः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रजादीन् सुतानेतानेकादश यथोदितान् । पुत्रप्रतिनिधीनाहुः क्रियालोपान् मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: kṣetrajādīn sutānetānekādaśa yathoditān | putrapratinidhīnāhuḥ kriyālopān manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: These eleven, the son begotten on the wife and the rest as enumerated (above), the wise call substitutes for a son, (taken) in order (to prevent) a failure of the (funeral) ceremonies.
verses.hindi: इसलिए पशुपालन न करने की इच्छा वैश्य न करे, जवतक वैश्य पालन करे, दूसरे वर्ण को कभी न चाहिए । माणि, मोती, सूँगा, लोहा, सूत फी वस्तु, कपूर और मीठा, घी आदि स्सपदाथौ का भाव वैश्य सदा विचार में रक्खे । सव बीजों के बोने की विधि,
verses.commentary: Sense: These eleven, the son begotten on the wife and the rest as enumerated (above), the wise call substitutes for a son, (taken) in order (to prevent) a failure of the (funeral) ceremonies.
verses.science: इसलिए पशुपालन न करने की इच्छा वैश्य न करे, जवतक वैश्य पालन करे, दूसरे वर्ण को कभी न चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: य एतेऽभिहिताः पुत्राः प्रसङ्गादन्यबीजजाः । यस्य ते बीजतो जातास्तस्य ते नैतरस्य तु
verses.transliteration: ya ete'bhihitāḥ putrāḥ prasaṅgādanyabījajāḥ | yasya te bījato jātāstasya te naitarasya tu
verses.translation: Those sons, who have been mentioned in connection with (the legitimate son of the body), being begotten by strangers, belong (in reality) to him from whose seed they sprang, but not to the other (man who took them).
verses.hindi: एयोउनापदि वर्णानामुक्कः कर्मविधिः शुभः। ..
verses.commentary: Sense: Those sons, who have been mentioned in connection with (the legitimate son of the body), being begotten by strangers, belong (in reality) to him from whose seed they sprang, but not to the other (man who took them).
verses.science: एयोउनापदि वर्णानामुक्कः कर्मविधिः शुभः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातॄणामेकजातानामेकश्चेत्पुत्रवान् भवेत् । सर्वांस्तांस्तेन पुत्रेण पुत्रिणो मनुरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: bhrātṝṇāmekajātānāmekaścetputravān bhavet | sarvāṃstāṃstena putreṇa putriṇo manurabravīt
verses.translation: If among brothers, sprung from one (father), one have a son, Manu has declared them all to have male offspring through that son.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग
verses.commentary: Sense: If among brothers, sprung from one (father), one have a son, Manu has declared them all to have male offspring through that son.
verses.science: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासामेकपत्नीनामेका चेत्पुत्रिणी भवेत् । सर्वास्तास्तेन पुत्रेण प्राह पुत्रवतीर्मनुः
verses.transliteration: sarvāsāmekapatnīnāmekā cetputriṇī bhavet | sarvāstāstena putreṇa prāha putravatīrmanuḥ
verses.translation: If among all the wives of one husband one have a son, Manu declares them all (to be) mothers of male children through that son.
verses.commentary: Sense: If among all the wives of one husband one have a son, Manu declares them all (to be) mothers of male children through that son.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग
verses.science: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयसः श्रेयसोऽलाभे पापीयान् रिक्थमर्हति । बहवश्चेत्तु सदृशाः सर्वे रिक्थस्य भागिनः
verses.transliteration: śreyasaḥ śreyaso'lābhe pāpīyān rikthamarhati | bahavaścettu sadṛśāḥ sarve rikthasya bhāginaḥ
verses.translation: On failure of each better (son), each next inferior (one) is worthy of the inheritance; but if there be many (of) equal (rank), they shall all share the estate.
verses.commentary: Sense: On failure of each better (son), each next inferior (one) is worthy of the inheritance; but if there be many (of) equal (rank), they shall all share the estate.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग
verses.science: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न भ्रातरो न पितरः पुत्रा रिक्थहराः पितुः । पिता हरेदपुत्रस्य रिक्थं भ्रातर एव च
verses.transliteration: na bhrātaro na pitaraḥ putrā rikthaharāḥ pituḥ | pitā haredaputrasya rikthaṃ bhrātara eva ca
verses.translation: Not brothers, nor fathers, (but) sons take the paternal estate; but the father shall take the inheritance of (a son) who leaves no male issue, and his brothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not brothers, nor fathers, (but) sons take the paternal estate; but the father shall take the inheritance of (a son) who leaves no male issue, and his brothers.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणामुदकं कार्यं त्रिषु पिण्डः प्रवर्तते । चतुर्थः सम्प्रदातैषां पञ्चमो नोपपद्यते
verses.transliteration: trayāṇāmudakaṃ kāryaṃ triṣu piṇḍaḥ pravartate | caturthaḥ sampradātaiṣāṃ pañcamo nopapadyate
verses.translation: To three (ancestors) water must be offered, to three the funeral cake is given, the fourth (descendant is) the giver of these (oblations), the fifth has no connection (with them).
verses.commentary: Sense: To three (ancestors) water must be offered, to three the funeral cake is given, the fourth (descendant is) the giver of these (oblations), the fifth has no connection (with them).
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तरः सपिण्डाद्यस्तस्य तस्य धनं भवेत् । अत ऊर्ध्वं सकुल्यः स्यादाचार्यः शिष्य एव वा
verses.transliteration: anantaraḥ sapiṇḍādyastasya tasya dhanaṃ bhavet | ata ūrdhvaṃ sakulyaḥ syādācāryaḥ śiṣya eva vā
verses.translation: Always to that (relative within three degrees) who is nearest to the (deceased) Sapinda the estate shall belong; afterwards a Sakulya shall be (the heir, then) the spiritual teacher or the pupil.
verses.commentary: Sense: Always to that (relative within three degrees) who is nearest to the (deceased) Sapinda the estate shall belong; afterwards a Sakulya shall be (the heir, then) the spiritual teacher or the pupil.

verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmapyabhāve tu brāhmaṇā rikthabhāginaḥ | traividyāḥ śucayo dāntāstathā dharmo na hīyate
verses.translation: But on failure of all (heirs) Brahmanas (shall) share the estate, (who are) versed the in the three Vedas, pure and self-controlled; thus the law is not violated.

verses.sanskrit: अहार्यं ब्राह्मणद्रव्यं राज्ञा नित्यमिति स्थितिः । इतरेषां तु वर्णानां सर्वाभावे हरेन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: ahāryaṃ brāhmaṇadravyaṃ rājñā nityamiti sthitiḥ | itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ sarvābhāve harennṛpaḥ
verses.translation: The property of a Brahmana must never be taken by the king, that is a settled rule; but (the property of men) of other castes the king may take on failure of all (heirs).
verses.commentary: Sense: The property of a Brahmana must never be taken by the king, that is a settled rule; but (the property of men) of other castes the king may take on failure of all (heirs).

verses.sanskrit: संस्थितस्यानपत्यस्य सगोत्रात्पुत्रमाहरेत् ॥ तत्र यद्रिक्थजातं स्यात्तत्तस्मिन् प्रतिपादयेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃsthitasyānapatyasya sagotrātputramāharet || tatra yadrikthajātaṃ syāttattasmin pratipādayet
verses.translation: (If the widow) of (a man) who died without leaving issue, raises up to him a son by a member of the family (Sagotra), she shall deliver to that (son) the whole property which belonged to the (deceased).
verses.commentary: Sense: (If the widow) of (a man) who died without leaving issue, raises up to him a son by a member of the family (Sagotra), she shall deliver to that (son) the whole property which belonged to the (deceased).

verses.sanskrit: द्वौ तु यौ विवदेयातां द्वाभ्यां जातौ स्त्रिया धने । तयोर्यद्यस्य पित्र्यं स्यात्तत्स गृह्णीत नैतरः
verses.transliteration: dvau tu yau vivadeyātāṃ dvābhyāṃ jātau striyā dhane | tayoryadyasya pitryaṃ syāttatsa gṛhṇīta naitaraḥ
verses.translation: But if two (sons), begotten by two (different men), contend for the property (in the hands) of their mother, each shall take, to the exclusion of the other, what belonged to his father.
verses.commentary: Sense: But if two (sons), begotten by two (different men), contend for the property (in the hands) of their mother, each shall take, to the exclusion of the other, what belonged to his father.

verses.sanskrit: जनन्यां संस्थितायां तु समं सर्वे सहोदराः । भजेरन् मातृकं रिक्थं भगिन्यश्च सनाभयः
verses.transliteration: jananyāṃ saṃsthitāyāṃ tu samaṃ sarve sahodarāḥ | bhajeran mātṛkaṃ rikthaṃ bhaginyaśca sanābhayaḥ
verses.translation: But when the mother has died, all the uterine brothers and the uterine sisters shall equally divide the mother's estate.
verses.commentary: Sense: But when the mother has died, all the uterine brothers and the uterine sisters shall equally divide the mother's estate.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: यास्तासां स्युर्दुहितरस्तासामपि यथार्हतः । मातामह्या धनात्किं चित्प्रदेयं प्रीतिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: yāstāsāṃ syurduhitarastāsāmapi yathārhataḥ | mātāmahyā dhanātkiṃ citpradeyaṃ prītipūrvakam
verses.translation: Even to the daughters of those (daughters) something should be given, as is seemly, out of the estate of their maternal grandmother, on the score of affection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even to the daughters of those (daughters) something should be given, as is seemly, out of the estate of their maternal grandmother, on the score of affection.

verses.sanskrit: अध्यग्न्यध्यावाहनिकं दत्तं च प्रीतिकर्मणि । भ्रातृमातृपितृप्राप्तं षड् विधं स्त्रीधनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: adhyagnyadhyāvāhanikaṃ dattaṃ ca prītikarmaṇi | bhrātṛmātṛpitṛprāptaṃ ṣaḍ vidhaṃ strīdhanaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: What (was given) before the (nuptial) fire, what (was given) on the bridal procession, what was given in token of love, and what was received from her brother, mother, or father, that is called the sixfold property of a woman.
verses.commentary: Sense: What (was given) before the (nuptial) fire, what (was given) on the bridal procession, what was given in token of love, and what was received from her brother, mother, or father, that is called the sixfold property of a woman.

verses.sanskrit: अन्वाधेयं च यद्दत्तं पत्या प्रीतेन चैव यत् । पत्यौ जीवति वृत्तायाः प्रजायास्तद्धनं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: anvādheyaṃ ca yaddattaṃ patyā prītena caiva yat | patyau jīvati vṛttāyāḥ prajāyāstaddhanaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: (Such property), as well as a gift subsequent and what was given (to her) by her affectionate husband, shall go to her offspring, (even) if she dies in the lifetime of her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Such property), as well as a gift subsequent and what was given (to her) by her affectionate husband, shall go to her offspring, (even) if she dies in the lifetime of her husband.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मदैवार्षगान्धर्वप्राजापत्येषु यद्वसु । अप्रजायामतीतायां भर्तुरेव तदिष्यते
verses.transliteration: brāhmadaivārṣagāndharvaprājāpatyeṣu yadvasu | aprajāyāmatītāyāṃ bhartureva tadiṣyate
verses.translation: It is ordained that the property (of a woman married) according to the Brahma, the Daiva, the Arsha, the Gandharva, or the Pragapatya rite (shall belong) to her husband alone, if she dies without issue.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is ordained that the property (of a woman married) according to the Brahma, the Daiva, the Arsha, the Gandharva, or the Pragapatya rite (shall belong) to her husband alone, if she dies without issue.

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वस्याः स्याद्धनं दत्तं विवाहेष्वासुरादिषु । अप्रजायामतीतायां मातापित्रोस्तदिष्यते
verses.transliteration: yattvasyāḥ syāddhanaṃ dattaṃ vivāheṣvāsurādiṣu | aprajāyāmatītāyāṃ mātāpitrostadiṣyate
verses.translation: But it is prescribed that the property which may have been given to a (wife) on an Asura marriage or (one of the) other (blamable marriages, shall go) to her mother and to her father, if she dies without issue.
verses.commentary: Sense: But it is prescribed that the property which may have been given to a (wife) on an Asura marriage or (one of the) other (blamable marriages, shall go) to her mother and to her father, if she dies without issue.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियां तु यद्भवेद्वित्तं पित्रा दत्तं कथं चन । ब्राह्मणी तधरेत्कन्या तदपत्यस्य वा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: striyāṃ tu yadbhavedvittaṃ pitrā dattaṃ kathaṃ cana | brāhmaṇī tadharetkanyā tadapatyasya vā bhavet
verses.translation: Whatever property may have been given by her father to a wife (who has co-wives of different castes), that the daughter (of the) Brahmani (wife) shall take, or that (daughter's) issue.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever property may have been given by her father to a wife (who has co-wives of different castes), that the daughter (of the) Brahmani (wife) shall take, or that (daughter's) issue.

verses.sanskrit: न निर्हारं स्त्रियः कुर्युः कुटुम्बाद्बहुमध्यगात् । स्वकादपि च वित्ताधि स्वस्य भर्तुरनाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: na nirhāraṃ striyaḥ kuryuḥ kuṭumbādbahumadhyagāt | svakādapi ca vittādhi svasya bharturanājñayā
verses.translation: Women should never make a hoard from (the property of) their families which is common to many, nor from their own (husbands' particular) property without permission.
verses.commentary: Sense: Women should never make a hoard from (the property of) their families which is common to many, nor from their own (husbands' particular) property without permission.

verses.sanskrit: पत्यौ जीवति यः स्त्रीभिरलङ्कारो धृतो भवेत् । न तं भजेरन् दायादा भजमानाः पतन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: patyau jīvati yaḥ strībhiralaṅkāro dhṛto bhavet | na taṃ bhajeran dāyādā bhajamānāḥ patanti te
verses.translation: The ornaments which may have been worn by women during their husbands' lifetime, his heirs shall not divide; those who divide them become outcasts.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ornaments which may have been worn by women during their husbands' lifetime, his heirs shall not divide; those who divide them become outcasts.

verses.sanskrit: अनंशौ क्लीबपतितौ जात्यन्धबधिरौ तथा । उन्मत्तजडमूकाश्च ये च के चिन्निरिन्द्रियाः
verses.transliteration: anaṃśau klībapatitau jātyandhabadhirau tathā | unmattajaḍamūkāśca ye ca ke cinnirindriyāḥ
verses.translation: Eunuchs and outcasts, (persons) born blind or deaf, the insane, idiots and the dumb, as well as those deficient in any organ (of action or sensation), receive no share.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eunuchs and outcasts, (persons) born blind or deaf, the insane, idiots and the dumb, as well as those deficient in any organ (of action or sensation), receive no share.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामपि तु न्याय्यं दातुं शक्त्या मनीषिणा । ग्रासाच्छादनमत्यन्तं पतितो ह्यददद्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmapi tu nyāyyaṃ dātuṃ śaktyā manīṣiṇā | grāsācchādanamatyantaṃ patito hyadadadbhavet
verses.translation: But it is just that (a man) who knows (the law) should give even to all of them food and raiment without stint, according to his ability; he who gives it not will become all outcast.
verses.commentary: Sense: But it is just that (a man) who knows (the law) should give even to all of them food and raiment without stint, according to his ability; he who gives it not will become all outcast.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यर्थिता तु दारैः स्यात्क्लीबादीनां कथं चन । तेषामुत्पन्नतन्तूनामपत्यं दायमर्हति
verses.transliteration: yadyarthitā tu dāraiḥ syātklībādīnāṃ kathaṃ cana | teṣāmutpannatantūnāmapatyaṃ dāyamarhati
verses.translation: If the eunuch and the rest should somehow or other desire to (take) wives, the offspring of such among them as have children is worthy of a share.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the eunuch and the rest should somehow or other desire to (take) wives, the offspring of such among them as have children is worthy of a share.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: यत्किं चित्पितरि प्रेते धनं ज्येष्ठोऽधिगच्छति । भागो यवीयसां तत्र यदि विद्यानुपालिनः
verses.transliteration: yatkiṃ citpitari prete dhanaṃ jyeṣṭho'dhigacchati | bhāgo yavīyasāṃ tatra yadi vidyānupālinaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever property the eldest (son) acquires (by his own exertion) after the father's death, a share of that (shall belong) to his younger (brothers), provided they have made a due progress in learning.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever property the eldest (son) acquires (by his own exertion) after the father's death, a share of that (shall belong) to his younger (brothers), provided they have made a due progress in learning.

verses.sanskrit: अविद्यानां तु सर्वेषामीहातश्चेद्धनं भवेत् । समस्तत्र विभागः स्यादपित्र्य इति धारणा
verses.transliteration: avidyānāṃ tu sarveṣāmīhātaśceddhanaṃ bhavet | samastatra vibhāgaḥ syādapitrya iti dhāraṇā
verses.translation: But if all of them, being unlearned, acquire property by their labour, the division of that shall be equal, (as it is) not property acquired by the father; that is a settled rule.
verses.commentary: Sense: But if all of them, being unlearned, acquire property by their labour, the division of that shall be equal, (as it is) not property acquired by the father; that is a settled rule.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: विद्याधनं तु यद्यस्य तत्तस्यैव धनं भवेत् । मैत्र्यमोद्वाहिकं चैव माधुपर्किकमेव च
verses.transliteration: vidyādhanaṃ tu yadyasya tattasyaiva dhanaṃ bhavet | maitryamodvāhikaṃ caiva mādhuparkikameva ca
verses.translation: Property (acquired) by learning belongs solely to him to whom (it was given), likewise the gift of a friend, a present received on marriage or with the honey-mixture.
verses.commentary: Sense: Property (acquired) by learning belongs solely to him to whom (it was given), likewise the gift of a friend, a present received on marriage or with the honey-mixture.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातॄणां यस्तु नैहेत धनं शक्तः स्वकर्मणा । स निर्भाज्यः स्वकादंशात्किं चिद्दत्त्वोपजीवनम्
verses.transliteration: bhrātṝṇāṃ yastu naiheta dhanaṃ śaktaḥ svakarmaṇā | sa nirbhājyaḥ svakādaṃśātkiṃ ciddattvopajīvanam
verses.translation: But if one of the brothers, being able (to maintain himself) by his own occupation, does not desire (a share of the family) property, he may be made separate (by the others) receiving a trifle out of his share to live upon.
verses.commentary: Sense: But if one of the brothers, being able (to maintain himself) by his own occupation, does not desire (a share of the family) property, he may be made separate (by the others) receiving a trifle out of his share to live upon.

verses.sanskrit: अनुपघ्नन् पितृद्रव्यं श्रमेण यदुपार्जितम् । स्वयमीहितलब्धं तन्नाकामो दातुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: anupaghnan pitṛdravyaṃ śrameṇa yadupārjitam | svayamīhitalabdhaṃ tannākāmo dātumarhati
verses.translation: What one (brother) may acquire by his labour without using the patrimony, that acquisition, (made solely) by his own effort, he shall not share unless by his own will (with his brothers).
verses.commentary: Sense: What one (brother) may acquire by his labour without using the patrimony, that acquisition, (made solely) by his own effort, he shall not share unless by his own will (with his brothers).

verses.sanskrit: पैतृकं तु पिता द्रव्यमनवाप्तं यदाप्नुयात् । न तत्पुत्रैर्भजेत्सार्धमकामः स्वयमर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: paitṛkaṃ tu pitā dravyamanavāptaṃ yadāpnuyāt | na tatputrairbhajetsārdhamakāmaḥ svayamarjitam
verses.translation: But if a father recovers lost ancestral property, he shall not divide it, unless by his own will, with his sons, (for it is) self-acquired (property).
verses.commentary: Sense: But if a father recovers lost ancestral property, he shall not divide it, unless by his own will, with his sons, (for it is) self-acquired (property).

verses.sanskrit: विभक्ताः सह जीवन्तो विभजेरन् पुनर्यदि । समस्तत्र विभागः स्याज्ज्यैष्ठ्यं तत्र न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: vibhaktāḥ saha jīvanto vibhajeran punaryadi | samastatra vibhāgaḥ syājjyaiṣṭhyaṃ tatra na vidyate
verses.translation: If brothers, (once) divided and living (again) together (as coparceners), make a second partition, the division shall in that case be equal; in such a case there is no right of primogeniture.
verses.commentary: Sense: If brothers, (once) divided and living (again) together (as coparceners), make a second partition, the division shall in that case be equal; in such a case there is no right of primogeniture.

verses.sanskrit: येषां ज्येष्ठः कनिष्ठो वा हीयेतांशप्रदानतः । म्रियेतान्यतरो वाऽपि तस्य भागो न लुप्यते
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ kaniṣṭho vā hīyetāṃśapradānataḥ | mriyetānyataro vā'pi tasya bhāgo na lupyate
verses.translation: If the eldest or the youngest (brother) is deprived of his share, or if either of them dies, his share is not lost (to his immediate heirs).
verses.commentary: Sense: If the eldest or the youngest (brother) is deprived of his share, or if either of them dies, his share is not lost (to his immediate heirs).

verses.sanskrit: सोदर्या विभजेरंस्तं समेत्य सहिताः समम् । भ्रातरो ये च संसृष्टा भगिन्यश्च सनाभयः
verses.transliteration: sodaryā vibhajeraṃstaṃ sametya sahitāḥ samam | bhrātaro ye ca saṃsṛṣṭā bhaginyaśca sanābhayaḥ
verses.translation: His uterine brothers, having assembled together, shall equally divide it, and those brothers who were reunited (with him) and the uterine sisters.
verses.commentary: Sense: His uterine brothers, having assembled together, shall equally divide it, and those brothers who were reunited (with him) and the uterine sisters.

verses.sanskrit: यो ज्येष्ठो विनिकुर्वीत लोभाद्भ्रातॄन् यवीयसः । सोऽज्येष्ठः स्यादभागश्च नियन्तव्यश्च राजभिः
verses.transliteration: yo jyeṣṭho vinikurvīta lobhādbhrātṝn yavīyasaḥ | so'jyeṣṭhaḥ syādabhāgaśca niyantavyaśca rājabhiḥ
verses.translation: An eldest brother who through avarice may defraud the younger ones, shall no (longer hold the position of) the eldest, shall not receive an (eldest son's additional) share, and shall be punished by the king.

verses.sanskrit: सर्व एव विकर्मस्था नार्हन्ति भ्रातरो धनम् । न चादत्त्वा कनिष्ठेभ्यो ज्येष्ठः कुर्वीत योतकम्
verses.transliteration: sarva eva vikarmasthā nārhanti bhrātaro dhanam | na cādattvā kaniṣṭhebhyo jyeṣṭhaḥ kurvīta yotakam
verses.translation: All brothers who habitually commit forbidden acts, are unworthy of (a share of) the property, and the eldest shall not make (anything his) separate property without giving (an equivalent) to his younger brothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: All brothers who habitually commit forbidden acts, are unworthy of (a share of) the property, and the eldest shall not make (anything his) separate property without giving (an equivalent) to his younger brothers.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातॄणामविभक्तानां यद्युत्थानं भवेत्सह । न पुत्रभागं विषमं पिता दद्यात्कथं चन
verses.transliteration: bhrātṝṇāmavibhaktānāṃ yadyutthānaṃ bhavetsaha | na putrabhāgaṃ viṣamaṃ pitā dadyātkathaṃ cana
verses.translation: If undivided brethren, (living with their father,) together make an exertion (for gain), the father shall on no account give to them unequal shares (on a division of the estate).
verses.commentary: Sense: If undivided brethren, (living with their father,) together make an exertion (for gain), the father shall on no account give to them unequal shares (on a division of the estate).

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं विभागात्जातस्तु पित्र्यमेव हरेद्धनम् । संसृष्टास्तेन वा ये स्युर्विभजेत स तैः सह
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ vibhāgātjātastu pitryameva hareddhanam | saṃsṛṣṭāstena vā ye syurvibhajeta sa taiḥ saha
verses.translation: But a son, born after partition, shall alone take the property of his father, or if any (of the other sons) be reunited with the (father), he shall share with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a son, born after partition, shall alone take the property of his father, or if any (of the other sons) be reunited with the (father), he shall share with them.

verses.sanskrit: अनपत्यस्य पुत्रस्य माता दायमवाप्नुयात् । मातर्यपि च वृत्तायां पितुर्माता हरेद्धनम्
verses.transliteration: anapatyasya putrasya mātā dāyamavāpnuyāt | mātaryapi ca vṛttāyāṃ piturmātā hareddhanam
verses.translation: A mother shall obtain the inheritance of a son (who dies) without leaving issue, and, if the mother be dead, the paternal grandmother shall take the estate.
verses.commentary: Sense: A mother shall obtain the inheritance of a son (who dies) without leaving issue, and, if the mother be dead, the paternal grandmother shall take the estate.

verses.sanskrit: ऋणे धने च सर्वस्मिन् प्रविभक्ते यथाविधि । पश्चाद्दृश्येत यत्किं चित्तत्सर्वं समतां नयेत्
verses.transliteration: ṛṇe dhane ca sarvasmin pravibhakte yathāvidhi | paścāddṛśyeta yatkiṃ cittatsarvaṃ samatāṃ nayet
verses.translation: And if, after all the debts and assets have been duly distributed according to the rule, any (property) be afterwards discovered, one must divide it equally.
verses.commentary: Sense: And if, after all the debts and assets have been duly distributed according to the rule, any (property) be afterwards discovered, one must divide it equally.

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्रं पत्रमलङ्कारं कृतान्नमुदकं स्त्रियः । योगक्षेमं प्रचारं च न विभाज्यं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: vastraṃ patramalaṅkāraṃ kṛtānnamudakaṃ striyaḥ | yogakṣemaṃ pracāraṃ ca na vibhājyaṃ pracakṣate
verses.translation: A dress, a vehicle, ornaments, cooked food, water, and female (slaves), property destined for pious uses or sacrifices, and a pasture-ground, they declare to be indivisible.
verses.commentary: Sense: A dress, a vehicle, ornaments, cooked food, water, and female (slaves), property destined for pious uses or sacrifices, and a pasture-ground, they declare to be indivisible.

verses.sanskrit: अयमुक्तो विभागो वः पुत्राणां च क्रियाविधिः । क्रमशः क्षेत्रजादीनां द्यूतधर्मं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: ayamukto vibhāgo vaḥ putrāṇāṃ ca kriyāvidhiḥ | kramaśaḥ kṣetrajādīnāṃ dyūtadharmaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: The division (of the property) and the rules for allotting (shares) to the (several) sons, those begotten on a wife and the rest, in (due) order, have been thus declared to you; hear (now) the laws concerning gambling.
verses.commentary: Sense: The division (of the property) and the rules for allotting (shares) to the (several) sons, those begotten on a wife and the rest, in (due) order, have been thus declared to you; hear (now) the laws concerning gambling.

verses.sanskrit: द्यूतं समाह्वयं चैव राजा राष्ट्रात्निवारयेत् । राजान्तकरणावेतौ द्वौ दोषौ पृथिवीक्षिताम्
verses.transliteration: dyūtaṃ samāhvayaṃ caiva rājā rāṣṭrātnivārayet | rājāntakaraṇāvetau dvau doṣau pṛthivīkṣitām
verses.translation: Gambling and betting let the king exclude from his realm; those two vices cause the destruction of the kingdoms of princes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gambling and betting let the king exclude from his realm; those two vices cause the destruction of the kingdoms of princes.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशमेतत्तास्कर्यं यद्देवनसमाह्वयौ । तयोर्नित्यं प्रतीघाते नृपतिर्यत्नवान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: prakāśametattāskaryaṃ yaddevanasamāhvayau | tayornityaṃ pratīghāte nṛpatiryatnavān bhavet
verses.translation: Gambling and betting amount to open theft; the king shall always exert himself in suppressing both (of them).
verses.commentary: Sense: Gambling and betting amount to open theft; the king shall always exert himself in suppressing both (of them).
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: अप्राणिभिर्यत्क्रियते तत्लोके द्यूतमुच्यते । प्राणिभिः क्रियते यस्तु स विज्ञेयः समाह्वयः
verses.transliteration: aprāṇibhiryatkriyate tatloke dyūtamucyate | prāṇibhiḥ kriyate yastu sa vijñeyaḥ samāhvayaḥ
verses.translation: When inanimate (things) are used (for staking money on them), that is called among men gambling (dyuta), when animate beings are used (for the same purpose), one must know that to be betting (samahvaya).
verses.commentary: Sense: When inanimate (things) are used (for staking money on them), that is called among men gambling (dyuta), when animate beings are used (for the same purpose), one must know that to be betting (samahvaya).

verses.sanskrit: द्यूतं समाह्वयं चैव यः कुर्यात्कारयेत वा । तान् सर्वान् घातयेद्राजा शूद्रांश्च द्विजलिङ्गिनः
verses.transliteration: dyūtaṃ samāhvayaṃ caiva yaḥ kuryātkārayeta vā | tān sarvān ghātayedrājā śūdrāṃśca dvijaliṅginaḥ
verses.translation: Let the king corporally punish all those (persons) who either gamble and bet or afford (an opportunity for it), likewise Sudras who assume the distinctive marks of twice-born (men).
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the king corporally punish all those (persons) who either gamble and bet or afford (an opportunity for it), likewise Sudras who assume the distinctive marks of twice-born (men).

verses.sanskrit: कितवान् कुशीलवान् क्रूरान् पाषण्डस्थांश्च मानवान् । विकर्मस्थान् शौण्डिकांश्च क्षिप्रं निर्वासयेत्पुरात्
verses.transliteration: kitavān kuśīlavān krūrān pāṣaṇḍasthāṃśca mānavān | vikarmasthān śauṇḍikāṃśca kṣipraṃ nirvāsayetpurāt
verses.translation: Gamblers, dancers and singers, cruel men, men belonging to an heretical sect, those following forbidden occupations, and sellers of spirituous liquor, let him instantly banish from his town.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gamblers, dancers and singers, cruel men, men belonging to an heretical sect, those following forbidden occupations, and sellers of spirituous liquor, let him instantly banish from his town.

verses.sanskrit: एते राष्ट्रे वर्तमाना राज्ञः प्रच्छन्नतस्कराः । विकर्मक्रियया नित्यं बाधन्ते भद्रिकाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: ete rāṣṭre vartamānā rājñaḥ pracchannataskarāḥ | vikarmakriyayā nityaṃ bādhante bhadrikāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: If such (persons who are) secret thieves, dwell in the realm of a king, they constantly harass his good subjects by their forbidden practices.
verses.commentary: Sense: If such (persons who are) secret thieves, dwell in the realm of a king, they constantly harass his good subjects by their forbidden practices.

verses.sanskrit: द्यूतमेतत्पुरा कल्पे दृष्टं वैरकरं महत् । तस्माद्द्यूतं न सेवेत हास्यार्थमपि बुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: dyūtametatpurā kalpe dṛṣṭaṃ vairakaraṃ mahat | tasmāddyūtaṃ na seveta hāsyārthamapi buddhimān
verses.translation: In a former Kalpa this (vice of) gambling has been seen to cause great enmity; a wise man, therefore, should not practise it even for amusement.
verses.commentary: Sense: In a former Kalpa this (vice of) gambling has been seen to cause great enmity; a wise man, therefore, should not practise it even for amusement.

verses.sanskrit: प्रच्छन्नं वा प्रकाशं वा तन्निषेवेत यो नरः । तस्य दण्डविकल्पः स्याद्यथेष्टं नृपतेस्तथा
verses.transliteration: pracchannaṃ vā prakāśaṃ vā tanniṣeveta yo naraḥ | tasya daṇḍavikalpaḥ syādyatheṣṭaṃ nṛpatestathā
verses.translation: On every man who addicts himself to that (vice) either secretly or openly, the king may inflict punishment according to his discretion.
verses.commentary: Sense: On every man who addicts himself to that (vice) either secretly or openly, the king may inflict punishment according to his discretion.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रविद्शूद्रयोनिस्तु दण्डं दातुमशक्नुवन् । आनृण्यं कर्मणा गच्छेद्विप्रो दद्यात्शनैः शनैः
verses.transliteration: kṣatravidśūdrayonistu daṇḍaṃ dātumaśaknuvan | ānṛṇyaṃ karmaṇā gacchedvipro dadyātśanaiḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: But a Kshatriya, a Vaisya, and a Sudra who are unable to pay a fine, shall discharge the debt by labour; a Brahmana shall pay it by installments.
verses.commentary: Sense: But a Kshatriya, a Vaisya, and a Sudra who are unable to pay a fine, shall discharge the debt by labour; a Brahmana shall pay it by installments.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीबालोन्मत्तवृद्धानां दरिद्राणां च रोगिणाम् । शिफाविदलरज्ज्वाद्यैर्विदध्यात्नृपतिर्दमम्
verses.transliteration: strībālonmattavṛddhānāṃ daridrāṇāṃ ca rogiṇām | śiphāvidalarajjvādyairvidadhyātnṛpatirdamam
verses.translation: On women, infants, men of disordered mind, the poor and the sick, the king shall inflict punishment with a whip, a cane, or a rope and the like.
verses.commentary: Sense: On women, infants, men of disordered mind, the poor and the sick, the king shall inflict punishment with a whip, a cane, or a rope and the like.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: ये नियुक्तास्तु कार्येषु हन्युः कार्याणि कार्यिणाम् । धनौष्मणा पच्यमानास्तान्निःस्वान् कारयेन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: ye niyuktāstu kāryeṣu hanyuḥ kāryāṇi kāryiṇām | dhanauṣmaṇā pacyamānāstānniḥsvān kārayennṛpaḥ
verses.translation: But those appointed (to administer public) affairs, who, baked by the fire of wealth, mar the business of suitors, the king shall deprive of their property.
verses.commentary: Sense: But those appointed (to administer public) affairs, who, baked by the fire of wealth, mar the business of suitors, the king shall deprive of their property.

verses.sanskrit: कूटशासनकर्तॄंश्च प्रकृतीनां च दूषकान् । स्त्रीबालब्राह्मणघ्नांश्च हन्याद्द्विट्सेविनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: kūṭaśāsanakartṝṃśca prakṛtīnāṃ ca dūṣakān | strībālabrāhmaṇaghnāṃśca hanyāddviṭsevinastathā
verses.translation: Forgers of royal edicts, those who corrupt his ministers, those who slay women, infants, or Brahmanas, and those who serve his enemies, the king shall put to death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgers of royal edicts, those who corrupt his ministers, those who slay women, infants, or Brahmanas, and those who serve his enemies, the king shall put to death.

verses.sanskrit: तीरितं चानुशिष्टं च यत्र क्व चन यद्भवेत् । कृतं तद्धर्मतो विद्यान्न तद्भूयो निवर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: tīritaṃ cānuśiṣṭaṃ ca yatra kva cana yadbhavet | kṛtaṃ taddharmato vidyānna tadbhūyo nivartayet
verses.translation: Whenever any (legal transaction) has been completed or (a punishment) been inflicted according to the law, he shall sanction it and not annul it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whenever any (legal transaction) has been completed or (a punishment) been inflicted according to the law, he shall sanction it and not annul it.

verses.sanskrit: अमात्यः प्राड्विवाको वा यत्कुर्युः कार्यमन्यथा । तत्स्वयं नृपतिः कुर्यात्तान् सहस्रं च दण्डयेत्
verses.transliteration: amātyaḥ prāḍvivāko vā yatkuryuḥ kāryamanyathā | tatsvayaṃ nṛpatiḥ kuryāttān sahasraṃ ca daṇḍayet
verses.translation: Whatever matter his ministers or the judge may settle improperly, that the king himself shall (re-) settle and fine (them) one thousand (panas).
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever matter his ministers or the judge may settle improperly, that the king himself shall (re-) settle and fine (them) one thousand (panas).

verses.sanskrit: तं ब्रह्महा च सुरापश्च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः । तस्करो गुरुतल्पगः एते सर्वे पृथग्ज्ञेया महापातकिनो नराः
verses.transliteration: taṃ brahmahā ca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ | taskaro gurutalpagaḥ ete sarve pṛthagjñeyā mahāpātakino narāḥ
verses.translation: The slayer of a Brahmana, (A twice-born man) who drinks (the spirituous liquor called) Sura, he who steals (the gold of a Brahmana), and he who violates a Guru's bed, must each and all be considered as men who committed mortal sins (mahapataka).
verses.commentary: Sense: The slayer of a Brahmana, (A twice-born man) who drinks (the spirituous liquor called) Sura, he who steals (the gold of a Brahmana), and he who violates a Guru's bed, must each and all be considered as men who committed mortal sins (mahapataka).

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्णामपि चैतेषां प्रायश्चित्तमकुर्वताम् । शारीरं धनसंयुक्तं दण्डं धर्म्यं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: caturṇāmapi caiteṣāṃ prāyaścittamakurvatām | śārīraṃ dhanasaṃyuktaṃ daṇḍaṃ dharmyaṃ prakalpayet
verses.translation: On those four even, if they do not perform a penance, let him inflict corporal punishment and fines in accordance with the law.
verses.commentary: Sense: On those four even, if they do not perform a penance, let him inflict corporal punishment and fines in accordance with the law.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: गुरुतल्पे भगः कार्यः सुरापाने सुराध्वजः । स्तेये च श्वपदं कार्यं ब्रह्महण्यशिराः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: gurutalpe bhagaḥ kāryaḥ surāpāne surādhvajaḥ | steye ca śvapadaṃ kāryaṃ brahmahaṇyaśirāḥ pumān
verses.translation: For violating a Guru's bed, (the mark of) a female part shall be (impressed on the forehead with a hot iron); for drinking (the spirituous liquor called) Sura, the sign of a tavern; for stealing (the gold of a Brahmana), a dog's foot; for murdering a Brahmana, a headless corpse.
verses.commentary: Sense: For violating a Guru's bed, (the mark of) a female part shall be (impressed on the forehead with a hot iron); for drinking (the spirituous liquor called) Sura, the sign of a tavern; for stealing (the gold of a Brahmana), a dog's foot; for murdering a Brahmana, a headless corpse.

verses.transliteration: taskare śvapadaṃ kāryaṃ asambhojyā hyasaṃyājyā asampāṭhyā'vivāhinaḥ | careyuḥ pṛthivīṃ dīnāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Excluded from all fellowship at meals, excluded from all sacrifices, excluded from instruction and from matrimonial alliances, abject and excluded from all religious duties, let them wander over (this) earth.

verses.transliteration: jñātisambandhibhistvete tyaktavyāḥ kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ | nirdayā nirnamaskārāstan manoranuśāsanam
verses.translation: Such (persons) who have been branded with (indelible) marks must be cast off by their paternal and maternal relations, and receive neither compassion nor a salutation; that is the teaching of Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such (persons) who have been branded with (indelible) marks must be cast off by their paternal and maternal relations, and receive neither compassion nor a salutation; that is the teaching of Manu.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तं तु कुर्वाणाः सर्ववर्णा यथोदितम् । पूर्वे वर्णा यथोदितम् नाङ्क्या राज्ञा ललाटे स्युर्दाप्यास्तूत्तमसाहसम्
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittaṃ tu kurvāṇāḥ sarvavarṇā yathoditam | pūrve varṇā yathoditam nāṅkyā rājñā lalāṭe syurdāpyāstūttamasāhasam
verses.translation: But (men of) all castes who perform the prescribed penances, must not be branded on the forehead by the king, but shall be made to pay the highest amercement.
verses.commentary: Sense: But (men of) all castes who perform the prescribed penances, must not be branded on the forehead by the king, but shall be made to pay the highest amercement.

verses.sanskrit: आगःसु ब्राह्मणस्यैव कार्यो मध्यमसाहसः । विवास्यो वा भवेद्राष्ट्रात्सद्रव्यः सपरिच्छदः
verses.transliteration: āgaḥsu brāhmaṇasyaiva kāryo madhyamasāhasaḥ | vivāsyo vā bhavedrāṣṭrātsadravyaḥ saparicchadaḥ
verses.translation: For (such) offences the middlemost amercement shall be inflicted on a Brahmana, or he may be banished from the realm, keeping his money and his chattels.
verses.commentary: Sense: For (such) offences the middlemost amercement shall be inflicted on a Brahmana, or he may be banished from the realm, keeping his money and his chattels.

verses.sanskrit: इतरे कृतवन्तस्तु पापान्येतान्यकामतः । सर्वस्वहारमर्हन्ति कामतस्तु प्रवासनम्
verses.transliteration: itare kṛtavantastu pāpānyetānyakāmataḥ | sarvasvahāramarhanti kāmatastu pravāsanam
verses.translation: But (men of) other (castes), who have unintentionally committed such crimes, ought to be deprived of their whole property; if (they committed them) intentionally, they shall be banished.
verses.commentary: Sense: But (men of) other (castes), who have unintentionally committed such crimes, ought to be deprived of their whole property; if (they committed them) intentionally, they shall be banished.

verses.sanskrit: नाददीत नृपः साधुर्महापातकिनो धनम् । आददानस्तु तत्लोभात्तेन दोषेण लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: nādadīta nṛpaḥ sādhurmahāpātakino dhanam | ādadānastu tatlobhāttena doṣeṇa lipyate
verses.translation: A virtuous king must not take for himself the property of a man guilty of mortal sin; but if he takes it out of greed, he is tainted by that guilt (of the offender).
verses.commentary: Sense: A virtuous king must not take for himself the property of a man guilty of mortal sin; but if he takes it out of greed, he is tainted by that guilt (of the offender).

verses.transliteration: apsu praveśya taṃ daṇḍaṃ varuṇāyopapādayet | śrutavṛttopapanne vā brāhmaṇe pratipādayet
verses.translation: Having thrown such a fine into the water, let him offer it to Varuna, or let him bestow it on a learned and virtuous Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having thrown such a fine into the water, let him offer it to Varuna, or let him bestow it on a learned and virtuous Brahmana.

verses.transliteration: īśo daṇḍasya varuṇo rājñāṃ daṇḍadharo hi saḥ | īśaḥ sarvasya jagato brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ
verses.translation: Varuna is the lord of punishment, for he holds the sceptre even over kings; a Brahmana who has learnt the whole Veda is the lord of the whole world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varuna is the lord of punishment, for he holds the sceptre even over kings; a Brahmana who has learnt the whole Veda is the lord of the whole world.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र वर्जयते राजा पापकृद्भ्यो धनागमम् । तत्र कालेन जायन्ते मानवा दीर्घजीविनः
verses.transliteration: yatra varjayate rājā pāpakṛdbhyo dhanāgamam | tatra kālena jāyante mānavā dīrghajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: In that (country), where the king avoids taking the property of (mortal) sinners, men are born in (due) time (and are) long-lived,
verses.commentary: Sense: In that (country), where the king avoids taking the property of (mortal) sinners, men are born in (due) time (and are) long-lived,

verses.sanskrit: निष्पद्यन्ते च सस्यानि यथोप्तानि विशां पृथक् । बालाश्च न प्रमीयन्ते विकृतं च न जायते
verses.transliteration: niṣpadyante ca sasyāni yathoptāni viśāṃ pṛthak | bālāśca na pramīyante vikṛtaṃ ca na jāyate
verses.translation: And the crops of the husbandmen spring up, each as it was sown, and the children die not, and no misshaped (offspring) is born.
verses.commentary: Sense: And the crops of the husbandmen spring up, each as it was sown, and the children die not, and no misshaped (offspring) is born.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् बाधमानं तु कामादवरवर्णजम् । हन्याच्चित्रैर्वधोपायैरुद्वेजनकरैर्नृपः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇān bādhamānaṃ tu kāmādavaravarṇajam | hanyāccitrairvadhopāyairudvejanakarairnṛpaḥ
verses.translation: But the king shall inflict on a base-born (Sudra), who intentionally gives pain to Brahmanas, various (kinds of) corporal punishment which cause terror.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the king shall inflict on a base-born (Sudra), who intentionally gives pain to Brahmanas, various (kinds of) corporal punishment which cause terror.

verses.sanskrit: यावानवध्यस्य वधे तावान् वध्यस्य मोक्षणे । अधर्मो नृपतेर्दृष्टो धर्मस्तु विनियच्छतः
verses.transliteration: yāvānavadhyasya vadhe tāvān vadhyasya mokṣaṇe | adharmo nṛpaterdṛṣṭo dharmastu viniyacchataḥ
verses.translation: When a king punishes an innocent (man), his guilt is considered as great as when he sets free a guilty man; but (he acquires) merit when he punishes (justly).
verses.commentary: Sense: When a king punishes an innocent (man), his guilt is considered as great as when he sets free a guilty man; but (he acquires) merit when he punishes (justly).

verses.sanskrit: उदितोऽयं विस्तरशो मिथो विवदमानयोः । अष्टादशसु मार्गेषु व्यवहारस्य निर्णयः
verses.transliteration: udito'yaṃ vistaraśo mitho vivadamānayoḥ | aṣṭādaśasu mārgeṣu vyavahārasya nirṇayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the (manner of) deciding suits (falling) under the eighteen titles, between two litigant parties, has been declared at length.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the (manner of) deciding suits (falling) under the eighteen titles, between two litigant parties, has been declared at length.

verses.sanskrit: एवं धर्म्याणि कार्याणि सम्यक्कुर्वन् महीपतिः । देशानलब्धान्लिप्सेत लब्धांश्च परिपालयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dharmyāṇi kāryāṇi samyakkurvan mahīpatiḥ | deśānalabdhānlipseta labdhāṃśca paripālayet
verses.translation: A king who thus duly fulfils his duties in accordance with justice, may seek to gain countries which he has not yet gained, and shall duly protect them when he has gained them.
verses.commentary: Sense: A king who thus duly fulfils his duties in accordance with justice, may seek to gain countries which he has not yet gained, and shall duly protect them when he has gained them.

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग्निविष्टदेशस्तु कृतदुर्गश्च शास्त्रतः । कण्टकोद्धरणे नित्यमातिष्ठेद्यत्नमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: samyagniviṣṭadeśastu kṛtadurgaśca śāstrataḥ | kaṇṭakoddharaṇe nityamātiṣṭhedyatnamuttamam
verses.translation: Having duly settled his country, and having built forts in accordance with the Institutes, he shall use his utmost exertions to remove (those men who are nocuous like) thorns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having duly settled his country, and having built forts in accordance with the Institutes, he shall use his utmost exertions to remove (those men who are nocuous like) thorns.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षनादार्यवृत्तानां कण्टकानां च शोधनात् । नरेन्द्रास्त्रिदिवं यान्ति प्रजापालनतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: rakṣanādāryavṛttānāṃ kaṇṭakānāṃ ca śodhanāt | narendrāstridivaṃ yānti prajāpālanatatparāḥ
verses.translation: By protecting those who live as (becomes) Aryans and by removing the thorns, kings, solely intent on guarding their subjects, reach heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: By protecting those who live as (becomes) Aryans and by removing the thorns, kings, solely intent on guarding their subjects, reach heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अशासंस्तस्करान् यस्तु बलिं गृह्णाति पार्थिवः । तस्य प्रक्षुभ्यते राष्ट्रं स्वर्गाच्च परिहीयते
verses.transliteration: aśāsaṃstaskarān yastu baliṃ gṛhṇāti pārthivaḥ | tasya prakṣubhyate rāṣṭraṃ svargācca parihīyate
verses.translation: The realm of that king who takes his share in kind, though he does not punish thieves, (will be) disturbed and he (will) lose heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The realm of that king who takes his share in kind, though he does not punish thieves, (will be) disturbed and he (will) lose heaven.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: निर्भयं तु भवेद्यस्य राष्ट्रं बाहुबलाश्रितम् । तस्य तद्वर्धते नित्यं सिच्यमान इव द्रुमः
verses.transliteration: nirbhayaṃ tu bhavedyasya rāṣṭraṃ bāhubalāśritam | tasya tadvardhate nityaṃ sicyamāna iva drumaḥ
verses.translation: But if his kingdom be secure, protected by the strength of his arm, it will constantly flourish like a (well)- watered tree.
verses.commentary: Sense: But if his kingdom be secure, protected by the strength of his arm, it will constantly flourish like a (well)- watered tree.

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधांस्तस्करान् विद्यात्परद्रव्यापहारकान् । प्रकाशांश्चाप्रकाशांश्च चारचक्षुर्महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: dvividhāṃstaskarān vidyātparadravyāpahārakān | prakāśāṃścāprakāśāṃśca cāracakṣurmahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: Let the king who sees (everything) through his spies, discover the two sorts of thieves who deprive others of their property, both those who (show themselves) openly and those who (lie) concealed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the king who sees (everything) through his spies, discover the two sorts of thieves who deprive others of their property, both those who (show themselves) openly and those who (lie) concealed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशवञ्चकास्तेषां नानापण्योपजीविनः । प्रच्छन्नवञ्चकास्त्वेते ये स्तेनाटविकादयः
verses.transliteration: prakāśavañcakāsteṣāṃ nānāpaṇyopajīvinaḥ | pracchannavañcakāstvete ye stenāṭavikādayaḥ
verses.translation: Among them, the open rogues (are those) who subsist by (cheating in the sale of) various marketable commodities, but the concealed rogues are burglars, robbers in forests, and so forth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among them, the open rogues (are those) who subsist by (cheating in the sale of) various marketable commodities, but the concealed rogues are burglars, robbers in forests, and so forth.

verses.sanskrit: उत्कोचकाश्चोपधिका वञ्चकाः कितवास्तथा । मङ्गलादेशवृत्ताश्च भद्राश्चैक्षणिकैः सह
verses.transliteration: utkocakāścopadhikā vañcakāḥ kitavāstathā | maṅgalādeśavṛttāśca bhadrāścaikṣaṇikaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Those who take bribes, cheats and rogues, gamblers, those who live by teaching (the performance of) auspicious ceremonies, sanctimonious hypocrites, and fortune-tellers,
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who take bribes, cheats and rogues, gamblers, those who live by teaching (the performance of) auspicious ceremonies, sanctimonious hypocrites, and fortune-tellers,

verses.sanskrit: भद्रप्रेक्षणिकैः सह असम्यक्कारिणश्चैव महामात्राश्चिकित्सकाः । शिल्पोपचारयुक्ताश्च निपुणाः पण्ययोषितः
verses.transliteration: bhadraprekṣaṇikaiḥ saha asamyakkāriṇaścaiva mahāmātrāścikitsakāḥ | śilpopacārayuktāśca nipuṇāḥ paṇyayoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Officials of high rank and physicians who act improperly, men living by showing their proficiency in arts, and clever harlots,
verses.commentary: Sense: Officials of high rank and physicians who act improperly, men living by showing their proficiency in arts, and clever harlots,

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीन् विजानीयात्प्रकाशांल्लोककण्टकान् । एवमाद्यान् निगूढचारिणश्चान्याननार्यानार्यलिङ्गिनः
verses.transliteration: evamādīn vijānīyātprakāśāṃllokakaṇṭakān | evamādyān nigūḍhacāriṇaścānyānanāryānāryaliṅginaḥ
verses.translation: These and the like who show themselves openly, as well as others who walk in disguise (such as) non-Aryans who wear the marks of Aryans, he should know to be thorns (in the side of his people).
verses.commentary: Sense: These and the like who show themselves openly, as well as others who walk in disguise (such as) non-Aryans who wear the marks of Aryans, he should know to be thorns (in the side of his people).

verses.sanskrit: तान् विदित्वा सुचरितैर्गूढैस्तत्कर्मकारिभिः । चारैश्चानेकसंस्थानैः प्रोत्साद्य वशमानयेत्
verses.transliteration: tān viditvā sucaritairgūḍhaistatkarmakāribhiḥ | cāraiścānekasaṃsthānaiḥ protsādya vaśamānayet
verses.translation: Having detected them by means of trustworthy persons, who, disguising themselves, (pretend) to follow the same occupations and by means of spies, wearing various disguises, he must cause them to be instigated (to commit offences), and bring them into his power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having detected them by means of trustworthy persons, who, disguising themselves, (pretend) to follow the same occupations and by means of spies, wearing various disguises, he must cause them to be instigated (to commit offences), and bring them into his power.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां दोषानभिख्याप्य स्वे स्वे कर्मणि तत्त्वतः । कुर्वीत शासनं राजा सम्यक्सारापराधतः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ doṣānabhikhyāpya sve sve karmaṇi tattvataḥ | kurvīta śāsanaṃ rājā samyaksārāparādhataḥ
verses.translation: Then having caused the crimes, which they committed by their several actions, to be proclaimed in accordance with the facts, the king shall duly punish them according to their strength and their crimes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then having caused the crimes, which they committed by their several actions, to be proclaimed in accordance with the facts, the king shall duly punish them according to their strength and their crimes.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग
verses.science: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न हि दण्डादृते शक्यः कर्तुं पापविनिग्रहः । स्तेनानां पापबुद्धीनां निभृतं चरतां क्षितौ
verses.transliteration: na hi daṇḍādṛte śakyaḥ kartuṃ pāpavinigrahaḥ | stenānāṃ pāpabuddhīnāṃ nibhṛtaṃ caratāṃ kṣitau
verses.translation: For the wickedness of evil-minded thieves, who secretly prowl over this earth, cannot be restrained except by punishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the wickedness of evil-minded thieves, who secretly prowl over this earth, cannot be restrained except by punishment.

verses.sanskrit: सभाप्रपाऽपूपशालावेशमद्यान्नविक्रयाः । चतुष्पथांश्चैत्यवृक्षाः समाजाः प्रेक्षणानि च
verses.transliteration: sabhāprapā'pūpaśālāveśamadyānnavikrayāḥ | catuṣpathāṃścaityavṛkṣāḥ samājāḥ prekṣaṇāni ca
verses.translation: Assembly-houses, houses where water is distributed or cakes are sold, brothels, taverns and victualler's shops, cross-roads, well-known trees, festive assemblies, and play-houses and concert-rooms,

verses.sanskrit: जीर्णोद्यानान्यरण्यानि कारुकावेशनानि च । शून्यानि चाप्यगाराणि वनान्युपवनानि च
verses.transliteration: jīrṇodyānānyaraṇyāni kārukāveśanāni ca | śūnyāni cāpyagārāṇi vanānyupavanāni ca
verses.translation: Old gardens, forests, the shops of artisans, empty dwellings, natural and artificial groves,
verses.commentary: Sense: Old gardens, forests, the shops of artisans, empty dwellings, natural and artificial groves,

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधान्नृपो देशान् गुल्मैः स्थावरजङ्गमैः । तस्करप्रतिषेधार्थं चारैश्चाप्यनुचारयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhānnṛpo deśān gulmaiḥ sthāvarajaṅgamaiḥ | taskarapratiṣedhārthaṃ cāraiścāpyanucārayet
verses.translation: These and the like places the king shall cause to be guarded by companies of soldiers, both stationary and patrolling, and by spies, in order to keep away thieves.
verses.commentary: Sense: These and the like places the king shall cause to be guarded by companies of soldiers, both stationary and patrolling, and by spies, in order to keep away thieves.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सहायैरनुगतैर्नानाकर्मप्रवेदिभिः । विद्यादुत्सादयेच्चैव निपुणैः पूर्वतस्करैः
verses.transliteration: tatsahāyairanugatairnānākarmapravedibhiḥ | vidyādutsādayeccaiva nipuṇaiḥ pūrvataskaraiḥ
verses.translation: By the means of clever reformed thieves, who associate with such (rogues), follow them and know their various machinations, he must detect and destroy them.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the means of clever reformed thieves, who associate with such (rogues), follow them and know their various machinations, he must detect and destroy them.

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोज्योपदेशैश्च ब्राह्मणानां च दर्शनैः । शौर्यकर्मापदेशैश्च कुर्युस्तेषां समागमम्
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyabhojyopadeśaiśca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca darśanaiḥ | śauryakarmāpadeśaiśca kuryusteṣāṃ samāgamam
verses.translation: Under the pretext of (offering them) various dainties, of introducing them to Brahmanas, and on the pretence of (showing them) feats of strength, the (spies) must make them meet (the officers of justice).
verses.commentary: Sense: Under the pretext of (offering them) various dainties, of introducing them to Brahmanas, and on the pretence of (showing them) feats of strength, the (spies) must make them meet (the officers of justice).

verses.sanskrit: ये तत्र नोपसर्पेयुर्मूलप्रणिहिताश्च ये । तान् प्रसह्य नृपो हन्यात्समित्रज्ञातिबान्धवान्
verses.transliteration: ye tatra nopasarpeyurmūlapraṇihitāśca ye | tān prasahya nṛpo hanyātsamitrajñātibāndhavān
verses.translation: Those among them who do not come, and those who suspect the old (thieves employed by the king), the king shall attack by force and slay together with their friends, blood relations, and connexions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those among them who do not come, and those who suspect the old (thieves employed by the king), the king shall attack by force and slay together with their friends, blood relations, and connexions.

verses.sanskrit: न होढेन विना चौरं घातयेद्धार्मिको नृपः । सहोढं सोपकरणं घातयेदविचारयन्
verses.transliteration: na hoḍhena vinā cauraṃ ghātayeddhārmiko nṛpaḥ | sahoḍhaṃ sopakaraṇaṃ ghātayedavicārayan
verses.translation: A just king shall not cause a thief to be put to death, (unless taken) with the stolen goods (in his possession); him who (is taken) with the stolen goods and the implements (of burglary), he may, without hesitation, cause to be slain.
verses.commentary: Sense: A just king shall not cause a thief to be put to death, (unless taken) with the stolen goods (in his possession); him who (is taken) with the stolen goods and the implements (of burglary), he may, without hesitation, cause to be slain.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामेष्वपि च ये के चिच्चौराणां भक्तदायकाः । भाण्डावकाशदाश्चैव सर्वांस्तानपि घातयेत्
verses.transliteration: grāmeṣvapi ca ye ke ciccaurāṇāṃ bhaktadāyakāḥ | bhāṇḍāvakāśadāścaiva sarvāṃstānapi ghātayet
verses.translation: All those also who in villages give food to thieves or grant them room for (concealing their implements), he shall cause to be put to death.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those also who in villages give food to thieves or grant them room for (concealing their implements), he shall cause to be put to death.

verses.sanskrit: राष्ट्रेषु रक्षाधिकृतान् सामन्तांश्चैव चोदितान् । अभ्याघातेषु मध्यस्थाञ् शिष्याच्चौरानिव द्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: rāṣṭreṣu rakṣādhikṛtān sāmantāṃścaiva coditān | abhyāghāteṣu madhyasthāñ śiṣyāccaurāniva drutam
verses.translation: Those who are appointed to guard provinces and his vassals who have been ordered (to help), he shall speedily punish like thieves, (if they remain) inactive in attacks (by robbers).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are appointed to guard provinces and his vassals who have been ordered (to help), he shall speedily punish like thieves, (if they remain) inactive in attacks (by robbers).

verses.sanskrit: यश्चापि धर्मसमयात्प्रच्युतो धर्मजीवनः । दण्डेनैव तमप्योषेत्स्वकाद्धर्माधि विच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: yaścāpi dharmasamayātpracyuto dharmajīvanaḥ | daṇḍenaiva tamapyoṣetsvakāddharmādhi vicyutam
verses.translation: Moreover if (a man), who subsists by (the fulfilment of) the law, departs from the established rule of the law, the (king) shall severely punish him by a fine, (because he) violated his duty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover if (a man), who subsists by (the fulfilment of) the law, departs from the established rule of the law, the (king) shall severely punish him by a fine, (because he) violated his duty.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामघाते हिताभङ्गे पथि मोषाभिदर्शने । शक्तितो नाभिधावन्तो निर्वास्याः सपरिच्छदाः
verses.transliteration: grāmaghāte hitābhaṅge pathi moṣābhidarśane | śaktito nābhidhāvanto nirvāsyāḥ saparicchadāḥ
verses.translation: Those who do not give assistance according to their ability when a village is being plundered, a dyke is being destroyed, or a highway robbery committed, shall be banished with their goods and chattels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who do not give assistance according to their ability when a village is being plundered, a dyke is being destroyed, or a highway robbery committed, shall be banished with their goods and chattels.

verses.translation: But a person in urgent necessity, an aged man, a pregnant woman, or a child, shall be reprimanded and clean the (place); that is a settled rule.

verses.translation: All physicians who treat (their patients) wrongly (shall pay) a fine; in the case of animals, the first (or lowest); in the case of human beings, the middlemost (amercement).

verses.sanskrit: समैर्हि विषमं यस्तु चरेद्वै मूल्यतोऽपि वा । समाप्नुयाद्दमं पूर्वं नरो मध्यममेव वा
verses.transliteration: samairhi viṣamaṃ yastu caredvai mūlyato'pi vā | samāpnuyāddamaṃ pūrvaṃ naro madhyamameva vā
verses.translation: But that man who behaves dishonestly to honest (customers) or cheats in his prices, shall be fined in the first or in the middlemost amercement.
verses.commentary: Sense: But that man who behaves dishonestly to honest (customers) or cheats in his prices, shall be fined in the first or in the middlemost amercement.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग

verses.sanskrit: बन्धनानि च सर्वाणि राजा मार्गे निवेशयेत् । राजमार्गे दुःखिता यत्र दृश्येरन् विकृताः पापकारिणः
verses.transliteration: bandhanāni ca sarvāṇi rājā mārge niveśayet | rājamārge duḥkhitā yatra dṛśyeran vikṛtāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Let him place all prisons near a high-road, where the suffering and disfigured offenders can be seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him place all prisons near a high-road, where the suffering and disfigured offenders can be seen.

verses.sanskrit: प्राकारस्य च भेत्तारं परिखाणां च पूरकम् । द्वाराणां चैव भङ्क्तारं क्षिप्रमेव प्रवासयेत्
verses.transliteration: prākārasya ca bhettāraṃ parikhāṇāṃ ca pūrakam | dvārāṇāṃ caiva bhaṅktāraṃ kṣiprameva pravāsayet
verses.translation: Him who destroys the wall (of a town), or fills up the ditch (round a town), or breaks a (town)- gate, he shall instantly banish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Him who destroys the wall (of a town), or fills up the ditch (round a town), or breaks a (town)- gate, he shall instantly banish.

verses.sanskrit: अभिचारेषु सर्वेषु कर्तव्यो द्विशतो दमः । मूलकर्मणि चानाप्तेः कृत्यासु विविधासु च
verses.transliteration: abhicāreṣu sarveṣu kartavyo dviśato damaḥ | mūlakarmaṇi cānāpteḥ kṛtyāsu vividhāsu ca
verses.translation: For all incantations intended to destroy life, for magic rites with roots (practised by persons) not related (to him against whom they are directed), and for various kinds of sorcery, a fine of two hundred (panas) shall be inflicted.
verses.commentary: Sense: For all incantations intended to destroy life, for magic rites with roots (practised by persons) not related (to him against whom they are directed), and for various kinds of sorcery, a fine of two hundred (panas) shall be inflicted.

verses.sanskrit: चानाप्तैः अबीजविक्रयी चैव बीजोत्कृष्टा तथैव च । मर्यादाभेदकश्चैव विकृतं प्राप्नुयाद्वधम्
verses.transliteration: cānāptaiḥ abījavikrayī caiva bījotkṛṣṭā tathaiva ca | maryādābhedakaścaiva vikṛtaṃ prāpnuyādvadham
verses.translation: He who sells (for seed-corn that which is) not seed-corn, he who takes up seed (already sown), and he who destroys a boundary (-mark), shall be punished by mutilation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sells (for seed-corn that which is) not seed-corn, he who takes up seed (already sown), and he who destroys a boundary (-mark), shall be punished by mutilation.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकण्टकपापिष्ठं हेमकारं तु पार्थिवः । प्रवर्तमानमन्याये छेदयेत्लवशः क्षुरैः
verses.transliteration: sarvakaṇṭakapāpiṣṭhaṃ hemakāraṃ tu pārthivaḥ | pravartamānamanyāye chedayetlavaśaḥ kṣuraiḥ
verses.translation: But the king shall cause a goldsmith who behaves dishonestly, the most nocuous of all the thorns, to be cut to pieces with razors.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the king shall cause a goldsmith who behaves dishonestly, the most nocuous of all the thorns, to be cut to pieces with razors.

verses.sanskrit: छेदयेत्खण्डशः क्षुरैः सीताद्रव्यापहरणे शस्त्राणामौषधस्य च । कालमासाद्य कार्यं च राजा दण्डं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: chedayetkhaṇḍaśaḥ kṣuraiḥ sītādravyāpaharaṇe śastrāṇāmauṣadhasya ca | kālamāsādya kāryaṃ ca rājā daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet
verses.translation: For the theft of agricultural implements, of arms and of medicines, let the king award punishment, taking into account the time (of the offence) and the use (of the object).
verses.commentary: Sense: For the theft of agricultural implements, of arms and of medicines, let the king award punishment, taking into account the time (of the offence) and the use (of the object).

verses.sanskrit: स्वाम्य्ऽमात्यौ पुरं राष्ट्रं कोशदण्डौ सुहृत्तथा । सप्त प्रकृतयो ह्येताः सप्ताङ्गं राज्यमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: svāmy'mātyau puraṃ rāṣṭraṃ kośadaṇḍau suhṛttathā | sapta prakṛtayo hyetāḥ saptāṅgaṃ rājyamucyate
verses.translation: The king and his minister, his capital, his realm, his treasury, his army, and his ally are the seven constituent parts (of a kingdom); (hence) a kingdom is said to have seven limbs (anga).
verses.commentary: Sense: The king and his minister, his capital, his realm, his treasury, his army, and his ally are the seven constituent parts (of a kingdom); (hence) a kingdom is said to have seven limbs (anga).

verses.sanskrit: सप्तानां प्रकृतीनां तु राज्यस्यासां यथाक्रमम् । पूर्वं पूर्वं गुरुतरं जानीयाद्व्यसनं महत्
verses.transliteration: saptānāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ tu rājyasyāsāṃ yathākramam | pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurutaraṃ jānīyādvyasanaṃ mahat
verses.translation: But let him know (that) among these seven constituent parts of a kingdom (which have been enumerated) in due order, each earlier (named) is more important and (its destruction) the greater calamity.
verses.commentary: Sense: But let him know (that) among these seven constituent parts of a kingdom (which have been enumerated) in due order, each earlier (named) is more important and (its destruction) the greater calamity.

verses.sanskrit: सप्ताङ्गस्यैह राज्यस्य विष्टब्धस्य त्रिदण्डवत् । अन्योन्यगुणवैशेष्यात्न किं चिदतिरिच्यते
verses.transliteration: saptāṅgasyaiha rājyasya viṣṭabdhasya tridaṇḍavat | anyonyaguṇavaiśeṣyātna kiṃ cidatiricyate
verses.translation: Yet in a kingdom containing seven constituent parts, which is upheld like the triple staff (of an ascetic), there is no (single part) more important (than the others), by reason of the importance of the qualities of each for the others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yet in a kingdom containing seven constituent parts, which is upheld like the triple staff (of an ascetic), there is no (single part) more important (than the others), by reason of the importance of the qualities of each for the others.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु तेषु तु कृत्येषु तत्तदङ्गं विशिष्यते । येन यत्साध्यते कार्यं तत्तस्मिंश्रेष्ठमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: teṣu teṣu tu kṛtyeṣu tattadaṅgaṃ viśiṣyate | yena yatsādhyate kāryaṃ tattasmiṃśreṣṭhamucyate
verses.translation: For each part is particularly qualified for (the accomplishment of) certain objects, (and thus) each is declared to be the most important for that particular purpose which is effected by its means.
verses.commentary: Sense: For each part is particularly qualified for (the accomplishment of) certain objects, (and thus) each is declared to be the most important for that particular purpose which is effected by its means.

verses.sanskrit: चारेणोत्साहयोगेन क्रिययैव च कर्मणाम् । स्वशक्तिं परशक्तिं च नित्यं विद्यान्महीपतिः
verses.transliteration: cāreṇotsāhayogena kriyayaiva ca karmaṇām | svaśaktiṃ paraśaktiṃ ca nityaṃ vidyānmahīpatiḥ
verses.translation: By spies, by a (pretended) display of energy, and by carrying out (various) undertakings, let the king constantly ascertain his own and his enemy's strength;
verses.commentary: Sense: By spies, by a (pretended) display of energy, and by carrying out (various) undertakings, let the king constantly ascertain his own and his enemy's strength;

verses.sanskrit: विद्यात्परात्मनोः पीडनानि च सर्वाणि व्यसनानि तथैव च । आरभेत ततः कार्यं सञ्चिन्त्य गुरुलाघवम्
verses.transliteration: vidyātparātmanoḥ pīḍanāni ca sarvāṇi vyasanāni tathaiva ca | ārabheta tataḥ kāryaṃ sañcintya gurulāghavam
verses.translation: Moreover, all calamities and vices; afterwards, when he has fully considered their relative importance, let him begin his operations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, all calamities and vices; afterwards, when he has fully considered their relative importance, let him begin his operations.

verses.sanskrit: आरभेतैव कर्माणि श्रान्तः श्रान्तः पुनः पुनः । कर्माण्यारभमाणं हि पुरुषं श्रीर्निषेवते
verses.transliteration: ārabhetaiva karmāṇi śrāntaḥ śrāntaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | karmāṇyārabhamāṇaṃ hi puruṣaṃ śrīrniṣevate
verses.translation: (Though he be) ever so much tired (by repeated failures), let him begin his operations again and again; for fortune greatly favours the man who (strenuously) exerts himself in his undertakings.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Though he be) ever so much tired (by repeated failures), let him begin his operations again and again; for fortune greatly favours the man who (strenuously) exerts himself in his undertakings.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं त्रेतायुगं चैव द्वापरं कलिरेव च । राज्ञो वृत्तानि सर्वाणि राजा हि युगमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ tretāyugaṃ caiva dvāparaṃ kalireva ca | rājño vṛttāni sarvāṇi rājā hi yugamucyate
verses.translation: The various ways in which a king behaves (resemble) the Krita, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali ages; hence the king is identified with the ages (of the world).
verses.commentary: Sense: The various ways in which a king behaves (resemble) the Krita, Treta, Dvapara, and Kali ages; hence the king is identified with the ages (of the world).
