verses.sanskrit: कलिः प्रसुप्तो भवति स जाग्रद्द्वापरं युगम् । कर्मस्वभ्युद्यतस्त्रेता विचरंस्तु कृतं युगम्
verses.transliteration: kaliḥ prasupto bhavati sa jāgraddvāparaṃ yugam | karmasvabhyudyatastretā vicaraṃstu kṛtaṃ yugam
verses.translation: Sleeping he represents the Kali (or iron age), waking the Dvapara (or brazen) age, ready to act the Treta (or silver age), but moving (actively) the Krita (or golden) age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sleeping he represents the Kali (or iron age), waking the Dvapara (or brazen) age, ready to act the Treta (or silver age), but moving (actively) the Krita (or golden) age.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्यार्कस्य वायोश्च यमस्य वरुणस्य च । चन्द्रस्याग्नेः पृथिव्याश्च तेजोवृत्तं नृपश्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: indrasyārkasya vāyośca yamasya varuṇasya ca | candrasyāgneḥ pṛthivyāśca tejovṛttaṃ nṛpaścaret
verses.translation: Let the king emulate the energetic action of Indra, of the Sun, of the Wind, of Yama, of Varuna, of the Moon, of the Fire, and of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the king emulate the energetic action of Indra, of the Sun, of the Wind, of Yama, of Varuna, of the Moon, of the Fire, and of the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: वार्षिकांश्चतुरो मासान् यथेन्द्रोऽभिप्रवर्षति । तथाऽभिवर्षेत्स्वं राष्ट्रं कामैरिन्द्रव्रतं चरन्
verses.transliteration: vārṣikāṃścaturo māsān yathendro'bhipravarṣati | tathā'bhivarṣetsvaṃ rāṣṭraṃ kāmairindravrataṃ caran
verses.translation: As Indra sends copious rain during the four months of the rainy season, even so let the king, taking upon himself the office of Indra, shower benefits on his kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Indra sends copious rain during the four months of the rainy season, even so let the king, taking upon himself the office of Indra, shower benefits on his kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ मासान् यथाऽदित्यस्तोयं हरति रश्मिभिः । तथा हरेत्करं राष्ट्रात्नित्यमर्कव्रतं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau māsān yathā'dityastoyaṃ harati raśmibhiḥ | tathā haretkaraṃ rāṣṭrātnityamarkavrataṃ hi tat
verses.translation: As the Sun during eight months (imperceptibly) draws up the water with his rays, even so let him gradually draw his taxes from his kingdom; for that is the office in which he resembles the Sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the Sun during eight months (imperceptibly) draws up the water with his rays, even so let him gradually draw his taxes from his kingdom; for that is the office in which he resembles the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य सर्वभूतानि यथा चरति मारुतः । तथा चारैः प्रवेष्टव्यं व्रतमेतधि मारुतम्
verses.transliteration: praviśya sarvabhūtāni yathā carati mārutaḥ | tathā cāraiḥ praveṣṭavyaṃ vratametadhi mārutam
verses.translation: As the Wind moves (everywhere), entering (in the shape of the vital air) all created beings, even so let him penetrate (everywhere) through his spies; that is the office in which he resembles the Wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the Wind moves (everywhere), entering (in the shape of the vital air) all created beings, even so let him penetrate (everywhere) through his spies; that is the office in which he resembles the Wind.

verses.sanskrit: यथा यमः प्रियद्वेष्यौ प्राप्ते काले नियच्छति । तथा राज्ञा नियन्तव्याः प्रजास्तधि यमव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: yathā yamaḥ priyadveṣyau prāpte kāle niyacchati | tathā rājñā niyantavyāḥ prajāstadhi yamavratam
verses.translation: As Yama at the appointed time subjects to his rule both friends and foes, even so all subjects must be controlled by the king; that is the office in which he resembles Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: As Yama at the appointed time subjects to his rule both friends and foes, even so all subjects must be controlled by the king; that is the office in which he resembles Yama.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणेन यथा पाशैर्बद्ध एवाभिदृश्यते । तथा पापान्निगृह्णीयाद्व्रतमेतधि वारुणम्
verses.transliteration: varuṇena yathā pāśairbaddha evābhidṛśyate | tathā pāpānnigṛhṇīyādvratametadhi vāruṇam
verses.translation: As (a sinner) is seen bound with ropes by Varuna, even so let him punish the wicked; that is his office in which he resembles Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: As (a sinner) is seen bound with ropes by Varuna, even so let him punish the wicked; that is his office in which he resembles Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: परिपूर्णं यथा चन्द्रं दृष्ट्वा हृष्यन्ति मानवाः । तथा प्रकृतयो यस्मिन् स चान्द्रव्रतिको नृपः
verses.transliteration: paripūrṇaṃ yathā candraṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyanti mānavāḥ | tathā prakṛtayo yasmin sa cāndravratiko nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: He is a king, taking upon himself the office of the Moon, whose (appearance) his subjects (greet with as great joy) as men feel on seeing the full moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is a king, taking upon himself the office of the Moon, whose (appearance) his subjects (greet with as great joy) as men feel on seeing the full moon.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतापयुक्तस्तेजस्वी नित्यं स्यात्पापकर्मसु । दुष्टसामन्तहिंस्रश्च तदाग्नेयं व्रतं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: pratāpayuktastejasvī nityaṃ syātpāpakarmasu | duṣṭasāmantahiṃsraśca tadāgneyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: (If) he is ardent in wrath against criminals and endowed with brilliant energy, and destroys wicked vassals, then his character is said (to resemble) that of Fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: (If) he is ardent in wrath against criminals and endowed with brilliant energy, and destroys wicked vassals, then his character is said (to resemble) that of Fire.

verses.sanskrit: यथा सर्वाणि भूतानि धरा धारयते समम् । तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि बिभ्रतः पार्थिवं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: yathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni dharā dhārayate samam | tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni bibhrataḥ pārthivaṃ vratam
verses.translation: As the Earth supports all created beings equally, thus (a king) who supports all his subjects, (takes upon himself) the office of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: As the Earth supports all created beings equally, thus (a king) who supports all his subjects, (takes upon himself) the office of the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: एतैरुपायैरन्यैश्च युक्तो नित्यमतन्द्रितः । स्तेनान् राजा निगृह्णीयात्स्वराष्ट्रे पर एव च
verses.transliteration: etairupāyairanyaiśca yukto nityamatandritaḥ | stenān rājā nigṛhṇīyātsvarāṣṭre para eva ca
verses.translation: Employing these and other means, the king shall, ever untired, restrain thieves both in his own dominions and in (those of) others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Employing these and other means, the king shall, ever untired, restrain thieves both in his own dominions and in (those of) others.

verses.sanskrit: परामप्यापदं प्राप्तो ब्राह्मणान्न प्रकोपयेत् । ते ह्येनं कुपिता हन्युः सद्यः सबलवाहनम्
verses.transliteration: parāmapyāpadaṃ prāpto brāhmaṇānna prakopayet | te hyenaṃ kupitā hanyuḥ sadyaḥ sabalavāhanam
verses.translation: Let him not, though fallen into the deepest distress, provoke Brahmanas to anger; for they, when angered, could instantly destroy him together with his army and his vehicles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him not, though fallen into the deepest distress, provoke Brahmanas to anger; for they, when angered, could instantly destroy him together with his army and his vehicles.

verses.sanskrit: यैः कृतः सर्वभक्ष्योऽग्निरपेयश्च महोदधिः । सर्वभक्षो क्षयी चाप्यायितः सोमः को न नश्येत्प्रकोप्य तान्
verses.transliteration: yaiḥ kṛtaḥ sarvabhakṣyo'gnirapeyaśca mahodadhiḥ | sarvabhakṣo kṣayī cāpyāyitaḥ somaḥ ko na naśyetprakopya tān
verses.translation: Who could escape destruction, when he provokes to anger those (men), by whom the fire was made to consume all things, by whom the (water of the) ocean was made undrinkable, and by whom the moon was made to wane and to increase again?

verses.sanskrit: लोकानन्यान् सृजेयुर्ये लोकपालांश्च कोपिताः । देवान् कुर्युरदेवांश्च कः क्षिण्वंस्तान् समृध्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: lokānanyān sṛjeyurye lokapālāṃśca kopitāḥ | devān kuryuradevāṃśca kaḥ kṣiṇvaṃstān samṛdhnuyāt
verses.translation: Who could prosper, while he injures those (men) who provoked to anger, could create other worlds and other guardians of the world, and deprive the gods of their divine station?
verses.commentary: Sense: Who could prosper, while he injures those (men) who provoked to anger, could create other worlds and other guardians of the world, and deprive the gods of their divine station?

verses.sanskrit: यानुपाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्ति लोका देवाश्च सर्वदा । ब्रह्म चैव धनं येषां को हिंस्यात्ताञ्जिजीविषुः
verses.transliteration: yānupāśritya tiṣṭhanti lokā devāśca sarvadā | brahma caiva dhanaṃ yeṣāṃ ko hiṃsyāttāñjijīviṣuḥ
verses.translation: What man, desirous of life, would injure them to whose support the (three) worlds and the gods ever owe their existence, and whose wealth is the Veda?
verses.commentary: Sense: What man, desirous of life, would injure them to whose support the (three) worlds and the gods ever owe their existence, and whose wealth is the Veda?

verses.sanskrit: अविद्वांश्चैव विद्वांश्च ब्राह्मणो दैवतं महत् । प्रणीतश्चाप्रणीतश्च यथाऽग्निर्दैवतं महत्
verses.transliteration: avidvāṃścaiva vidvāṃśca brāhmaṇo daivataṃ mahat | praṇītaścāpraṇītaśca yathā'gnirdaivataṃ mahat
verses.translation: A Brahmana, be he ignorant or learned, is a great divinity, just as the fire, whether carried forth (for the performance of a burnt-oblation) or not carried forth, is a great divinity.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana, be he ignorant or learned, is a great divinity, just as the fire, whether carried forth (for the performance of a burnt-oblation) or not carried forth, is a great divinity.

verses.sanskrit: श्मशानेष्वपि तेजस्वी पावको नैव दुष्यति । हूयमानश्च यज्ञेषु भूय एवाभिवर्धते
verses.transliteration: śmaśāneṣvapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati | hūyamānaśca yajñeṣu bhūya evābhivardhate
verses.translation: The brilliant fire is not contaminated even in burial-places, and, when presented with oblations (of butter) at sacrifices, it again increases mightily.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brilliant fire is not contaminated even in burial-places, and, when presented with oblations (of butter) at sacrifices, it again increases mightily.

verses.sanskrit: एवं यद्यप्यनिष्टेषु वर्तन्ते सर्वकर्मसु । सर्वथा ब्राह्मणाः पूज्याः परमं दैवतं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ yadyapyaniṣṭeṣu vartante sarvakarmasu | sarvathā brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ paramaṃ daivataṃ hi tat
verses.translation: Thus, though Brahmanas employ themselves in all (sorts of) mean occupations, they must be honoured in every way; for (each of) them is a very great deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, though Brahmanas employ themselves in all (sorts of) mean occupations, they must be honoured in every way; for (each of) them is a very great deity.

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रस्यातिप्रवृद्धस्य ब्राह्मणान् प्रति सर्वशः । ब्रह्मैव संनियन्तृ स्यात्क्षत्रं हि ब्रह्मसम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: kṣatrasyātipravṛddhasya brāhmaṇān prati sarvaśaḥ | brahmaiva saṃniyantṛ syātkṣatraṃ hi brahmasambhavam
verses.translation: When the Kshatriyas become in any way overbearing towards the Brahmanas, the Brahmanas themselves shall duly restrain them; for the Kshatriyas sprang from the Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Kshatriyas become in any way overbearing towards the Brahmanas, the Brahmanas themselves shall duly restrain them; for the Kshatriyas sprang from the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: अद्भ्योऽग्निर्ब्रह्मतः क्षत्रमश्मनो लोहमुत्थितम् । तेषां सर्वत्रगं तेजः स्वासु योनिषु शाम्यति
verses.transliteration: adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥ kṣatramaśmano lohamutthitam | teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati
verses.translation: Fire sprang from water, Kshatriyas from Brahmanas, iron from stone; the all-penetrating force of those (three) has no effect on that whence they were produced.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fire sprang from water, Kshatriyas from Brahmanas, iron from stone; the all-penetrating force of those (three) has no effect on that whence they were produced.

verses.sanskrit: नाब्रह्म क्षत्रं ऋध्नोति नाक्षत्रं ब्रह्म वर्धते । ब्रह्म क्षत्रं च सम्पृक्तमिह चामुत्र वर्धते
verses.transliteration: nābrahma kṣatraṃ ṛdhnoti nākṣatraṃ brahma vardhate | brahma kṣatraṃ ca sampṛktamiha cāmutra vardhate
verses.translation: Kshatriyas prosper not without Brahmanas, Brahmanas prosper not without Kshatriyas; Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, being closely united, prosper in this (world) and in the next.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kshatriyas prosper not without Brahmanas, Brahmanas prosper not without Kshatriyas; Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, being closely united, prosper in this (world) and in the next.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा धनं तु विप्रेभ्यः सर्वदण्डसमुत्थितम् । पुत्रे राज्यं समासृज्य कुर्वीत प्रायणं रणे
verses.transliteration: dattvā dhanaṃ tu viprebhyaḥ sarvadaṇḍasamutthitam | putre rājyaṃ samāsṛjya kurvīta prāyaṇaṃ raṇe
verses.translation: But (a king who feels his end drawing nigh) shall bestow all his wealth, accumulated from fines, on Brahmanas, make over his kingdom to his son, and then seek death in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: But (a king who feels his end drawing nigh) shall bestow all his wealth, accumulated from fines, on Brahmanas, make over his kingdom to his son, and then seek death in battle.

verses.sanskrit: समासाद्य एवं चरन् सदा युक्तो राजधर्मेषु पार्थिवः । हितेषु चैव लोकस्य सर्वान् भृत्यान्नियोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: samāsādya evaṃ caran sadā yukto rājadharmeṣu pārthivaḥ | hiteṣu caiva lokasya sarvān bhṛtyānniyojayet
verses.translation: Thus conducting himself (and) ever intent on (discharging) his royal duties, a king shall order all his servants (to work) for the good of his people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus conducting himself (and) ever intent on (discharging) his royal duties, a king shall order all his servants (to work) for the good of his people.

verses.sanskrit: हितेषु चैव लोकेभ्यः एषोऽखिलः कर्मविधिरुक्तो राज्ञः सनातनः । इमं कर्मविधिं विद्यात्क्रमशो वैश्यशूद्रयोः
verses.transliteration: hiteṣu caiva lokebhyaḥ eṣo'khilaḥ karmavidhirukto rājñaḥ sanātanaḥ | imaṃ karmavidhiṃ vidyātkramaśo vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ
verses.translation: Thus the eternal law concerning the duties of a king has been fully declared; know that the following rules apply in (due) order to the duties of Vaisyas and Sudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the eternal law concerning the duties of a king has been fully declared; know that the following rules apply in (due) order to the duties of Vaisyas and Sudras.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यस्तु कृतसंस्कारः कृत्वा दारपरिग्रहम् । वार्तायां नित्ययुक्तः स्यात्पशूनां चैव रक्षणे
verses.transliteration: vaiśyastu kṛtasaṃskāraḥ kṛtvā dāraparigraham | vārtāyāṃ nityayuktaḥ syātpaśūnāṃ caiva rakṣaṇe
verses.translation: After a Vaisya has received the sacraments and has taken a wife, he shall be always attentive to the business whereby he may subsist and to (that of) tending cattle.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a Vaisya has received the sacraments and has taken a wife, he shall be always attentive to the business whereby he may subsist and to (that of) tending cattle.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिर्हि वैश्याय सृष्ट्वा परिददे पशून् । ब्राह्मणाय च राज्ञे च सर्वाः परिददे प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatirhi vaiśyāya sṛṣṭvā paridade paśūn | brāhmaṇāya ca rājñe ca sarvāḥ paridade prajāḥ
verses.translation: For when the Lord of creatures (Pragapati) created cattle, he made them over to the Vaisya; to the Brahmana, and to the king he entrusted all created beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: For when the Lord of creatures (Pragapati) created cattle, he made them over to the Vaisya; to the Brahmana, and to the king he entrusted all created beings.

verses.sanskrit: न च वैश्यस्य कामः स्यान्न रक्षेयं पशूनिति । वैश्ये चेच्छति नान्येन रक्षितव्याः कथं चन
verses.transliteration: na ca vaiśyasya kāmaḥ syānna rakṣeyaṃ paśūniti | vaiśye cecchati nānyena rakṣitavyāḥ kathaṃ cana
verses.translation: A Vaisya must never (conceive this) wish, I will not keep cattle; and if a Vaisya is willing (to keep them), they must never be kept by (men of) other (castes).
verses.commentary: Sense: A Vaisya must never (conceive this) wish, I will not keep cattle; and if a Vaisya is willing (to keep them), they must never be kept by (men of) other (castes).

verses.sanskrit: मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां लोहानां तान्तवस्य च । गन्धानां च रसानां च विद्यादर्घबलाबलम्
verses.transliteration: maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ lohānāṃ tāntavasya ca | gandhānāṃ ca rasānāṃ ca vidyādarghabalābalam
verses.translation: (A Vaisya) must know the respective value of gems, of pearls, of coral, of metals, of (cloth) made of thread, of perfumes, and of condiments.
verses.commentary: Sense: (A Vaisya) must know the respective value of gems, of pearls, of coral, of metals, of (cloth) made of thread, of perfumes, and of condiments.

verses.sanskrit: बीजानामुप्तिविद्च स्यात्क्षेत्रदोषगुणस्य च । मानयोगं च जानीयात्तुलायोगांश्च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: bījānāmuptividca syātkṣetradoṣaguṇasya ca | mānayogaṃ ca jānīyāttulāyogāṃśca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: He must be acquainted with the (manner of) sowing of seeds, and of the good and bad qualities of fields, and he must perfectly know all measures and weights.
verses.commentary: Sense: He must be acquainted with the (manner of) sowing of seeds, and of the good and bad qualities of fields, and he must perfectly know all measures and weights.

verses.sanskrit: सारासारं च भाण्डानां देशानां च गुणागुणान् । लाभालाभं च पण्यानां पशूनां परिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: sārāsāraṃ ca bhāṇḍānāṃ deśānāṃ ca guṇāguṇān | lābhālābhaṃ ca paṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ parivardhanam
verses.translation: Moreover, the excellence and defects of commodities, the advantages and disadvantages of (different) countries, the (probable) profit and loss on merchandise, and the means of properly rearing cattle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, the excellence and defects of commodities, the advantages and disadvantages of (different) countries, the (probable) profit and loss on merchandise, and the means of properly rearing cattle.

verses.sanskrit: भृत्यानां च भृतिं विद्याद्भाषाश्च विविधा नृणाम् । द्रव्याणां स्थानयोगांश्च क्रयविक्रयमेव च
verses.transliteration: bhṛtyānāṃ ca bhṛtiṃ vidyādbhāṣāśca vividhā nṛṇām | dravyāṇāṃ sthānayogāṃśca krayavikrayameva ca
verses.translation: He must be acquainted with the (proper), wages of servants, with the various languages of men, with the manner of keeping goods, and (the rules of) purchase and sale.
verses.commentary: Sense: He must be acquainted with the (proper), wages of servants, with the various languages of men, with the manner of keeping goods, and (the rules of) purchase and sale.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मेण च द्रव्यवृद्धावातिष्ठेद्यत्नमुत्तमम् । दद्याच्च सर्वभूतानामन्नमेव प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: dharmeṇa ca dravyavṛddhāvātiṣṭhedyatnamuttamam | dadyācca sarvabhūtānāmannameva prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Let him exert himself to the utmost in order to increase his property in a righteous manner, and let him zealously give food to all created beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let him exert himself to the utmost in order to increase his property in a righteous manner, and let him zealously give food to all created beings.

verses.sanskrit: विप्राणां वेदविदुषां गृहस्थानां यशस्विनाम् । शुश्रूषैव तु शूद्रस्य धर्मो नैश्रेयसः परः
verses.transliteration: viprāṇāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ yaśasvinām | śuśrūṣaiva tu śūdrasya dharmo naiśreyasaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: But to serve Brahmanas (who are) learned in the Vedas, householders, and famous (for virtue) is the highest duty of a Sudra, which leads to beatitude.
verses.commentary: Sense: But to serve Brahmanas (who are) learned in the Vedas, householders, and famous (for virtue) is the highest duty of a Sudra, which leads to beatitude.

verses.sanskrit: परम् शुचिरुत्कृष्टशुश्रूषुर्मृदुवागनहङ्कृतः । ब्राह्मणाद्याश्रयो नित्यमुत्कृष्टां जातिमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: param śucirutkṛṣṭaśuśrūṣurmṛduvāganahaṅkṛtaḥ | brāhmaṇādyāśrayo nityamutkṛṣṭāṃ jātimaśnute
verses.translation: (A Sudra who is) pure, the servant of his betters, gentle in his speech, and free from pride, and always seeks a refuge with Brahmanas, attains (in his next life) a higher caste.
verses.commentary: Sense: (A Sudra who is) pure, the servant of his betters, gentle in his speech, and free from pride, and always seeks a refuge with Brahmanas, attains (in his next life) a higher caste.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणापाश्रयो एषोऽनापदि वर्णानामुक्तः कर्मविधिः शुभः । आपद्यपि हि यस्तेषां क्रमशस्तन्निबोधत
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāpāśrayo eṣo'nāpadi varṇānāmuktaḥ karmavidhiḥ śubhaḥ | āpadyapi hi yasteṣāṃ kramaśastannibodhata
verses.translation: The excellent law for the conduct of the (four) castes (varna), (when they are) not in distress, has been thus promulgated; now hear in order their (several duties) in times of distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent law for the conduct of the (four) castes (varna), (when they are) not in distress, has been thus promulgated; now hear in order their (several duties) in times of distress.
verses.hindi: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि । समय मे खरीद, बेचने मै मुनाफा आदि और पशुओं के चढ्ने की, रीति वैश्य जाना करे । नौकरोंकी नौकरी का परिमाण; अनेक भाषा, माल ठीक, रहने की विधि, खरीदते, बेचने का ढंग
verses.science: गले के अच्छे-युरे .का हाल, देशों में पदार्थो का भाव, गुण आदि। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अधीयीरंस्त्रयो वर्णाः स्वकर्मस्था द्विजातयः । प्रब्रूयाद्ब्राह्मणस्त्वेषां नेतराविति निश्चयः
verses.transliteration: adhīyīraṃstrayo varṇāḥ svakarmasthā dvijātayaḥ | prabrūyādbrāhmaṇastveṣāṃ netarāviti niścayaḥ
verses.translation: Let the three twice-born castes (varna), discharging their (prescribed) duties, study (the Veda); but among them the Brahmana (alone) shall teach it, not the other two; that is an established rule.
verses.hindi: अनन्तरासु जातानां विधिरेष सनातन; .. ....
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the three twice-born castes (varna), discharging their (prescribed) duties, study (the Veda); but among them the Brahmana (alone) shall teach it, not the other two; that is an established rule.
verses.science: अनन्तरासु जातानां विधिरेष सनातन; .. ....। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां ब्राह्मणो विद्याद्वृत्त्युपायान् यथाविधि । प्रब्रूयादितरेभ्यश्च स्वयं चैव तथा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇo vidyādvṛttyupāyān yathāvidhi | prabrūyāditarebhyaśca svayaṃ caiva tathā bhavet
verses.translation: The Brahmana must know the means of subsistence (prescribed) by law for all, instruct the others, and himself live according to (the law)
verses.hindi: ससवित्तागमा धर्म्या दायो लाभः कयो जयः।
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmana must know the means of subsistence (prescribed) by law for all, instruct the others, and himself live according to (the law)
verses.science: ससवित्तागमा धर्म्या दायो लाभः कयो जयः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वैशेष्यात्प्रकृतिश्रैष्ठ्यान्नियमस्य च धारणात् । संस्कारस्य विशेषाच्च वर्णानां ब्राह्मणः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: vaiśeṣyātprakṛtiśraiṣṭhyānniyamasya ca dhāraṇāt | saṃskārasya viśeṣācca varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: On account of his pre-eminence, on account of the superiority of his origin, on account of his observance of (particular) restrictive rules, and on account of his particular sanctification the Brahmana is the lord of (all) castes (varna).
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his pre-eminence, on account of the superiority of his origin, on account of his observance of (particular) restrictive rules, and on account of his particular sanctification the Brahmana is the lord of (all) castes (varna).
verses.hindi: या कन्या मे अम्ब जाति का पुष होता है और शदुफन्या म निपाद  ओर पारसव कहा जाता है। क्षत्रिय से पुत्र जाति से सून होता है। वेशय से ब्राह्मणी में वैदेह जाति का कहलाते हैं ॥ ८-१२॥
verses.science: या कन्या मे अम्ब जाति का पुष होता है और शदुफन्या म निपाद ओर पारसव कहा जाता है। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यस्त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः । चतुर्थ एकजातिस्तु शूद्रो नास्ति तु पञ्चमः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyastrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ | caturtha ekajātistu śūdro nāsti tu pañcamaḥ
verses.translation: Brahmana, the Kshatriya, and the Vaisya castes (varna) are the twice-born ones, but the fourth, the Sudra, has one birth only; there is no fifth (caste).
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmana, the Kshatriya, and the Vaisya castes (varna) are the twice-born ones, but the fourth, the Sudra, has one birth only; there is no fifth (caste).
verses.hindi: निपाद संकर जाति का नोषक है  निरुक्त में “निषादः पमः” सेल है। यहां पर जो वैश्य और शरक का महण है उसको विवाहिता समझोता स ५ क्योंकि याशपत्तय का वचन है मिल्क विधिः सतः । आति का पुत्र कहलाता हैं ॥ १३-१४ ॥
verses.science: निपाद संकर जाति का नोषक है निरुक्त में “निषादः पमः” सेल है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववर्णेषु तुल्यासु पत्नीष्वक्षतयोनिषु । आनुलोम्येन सम्भूता जात्या ज्ञेयास्त एव ते
verses.transliteration: sarvavarṇeṣu tulyāsu patnīṣvakṣatayoniṣu | ānulomyena sambhūtā jātyā jñeyāsta eva te
verses.translation: In all castes (varna) those (children) only which are begotten in the direct order on wedded wives, equal (in caste and married as) virgins, are to be considered as belonging to the same caste (as their fathers)
verses.commentary: Sense: In all castes (varna) those (children) only which are begotten in the direct order on wedded wives, equal (in caste and married as) virgins, are to be considered as belonging to the same caste (as their fathers)
verses.hindi: आयोगब, .श्वषक्ता आर चारडाल ये शद्ग से घतिलोमभाब से पैदा तीन मनुष्यों में अधमहे अपसदं । चेश्व से मानच और वेदेह और क्षत्रिय से सूत, ये लीच भी मरतिलोमसाव से पैदा होते है दसे नवादा में कट जाति का पुन होता दे । और
verses.science: आयोगब, .श्वषक्ता आर चारडाल ये शद्ग से घतिलोमभाब से पैदा तीन मनुष्यों में अधमहे अपसदं। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीष्वनन्तरजातासु द्विजैरुत्पादितान् सुतान् । सदृशानेव तानाहुर्मातृदोषविगर्हितान्
verses.transliteration: strīṣvanantarajātāsu dvijairutpāditān sutān | sadṛśāneva tānāhurmātṛdoṣavigarhitān
verses.translation: Sons, begotten by twice-born man on wives of the next lower castes, they declare to be similar (to their fathers, but) blamed on account of the fault (inherent) in their mothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sons, begotten by twice-born man on wives of the next lower castes, they declare to be similar (to their fathers, but) blamed on account of the fault (inherent) in their mothers.
verses.hindi: संकीर्णयोनयो ये तु भ्रतिलोसानुलोमजाः ।
verses.science: संकीर्णयोनयो ये तु भ्रतिलोसानुलोमजाः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तरासु जातानां विधिरेष सनातनः । द्व्येकान्तरासु जातानां धर्म्यं विद्यादिमं विधिम्
verses.transliteration: anantarāsu jātānāṃ vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ | dvyekāntarāsu jātānāṃ dharmyaṃ vidyādimaṃ vidhim
verses.translation: Such is the eternal law concerning (children) born of wives one degree lower (than their husbands); know (that) the following rule (is applicable) to those born of women two or three degrees lower.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such is the eternal law concerning (children) born of wives one degree lower (than their husbands); know (that) the following rule (is applicable) to those born of women two or three degrees lower.
verses.hindi: "सूतो वेदेहकरपेव घण्डालश्च नराधमः ।
verses.science: "सूतो वेदेहकरपेव घण्डालश्च नराधमः। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाद्वैश्यकन्यायामम्बष्ठो नाम जायते । निषादः शूद्रकन्यायां यः पारशव उच्यते
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇādvaiśyakanyāyāmambaṣṭho nāma jāyate | niṣādaḥ śūdrakanyāyāṃ yaḥ pāraśava ucyate
verses.translation: From a Brahmana a with the daughter of a Vaisya is born (a son) called an Ambashtha, with the daughter of a sudra a Nishada, who is also called Parasava.
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Brahmana a with the daughter of a Vaisya is born (a son) called an Ambashtha, with the daughter of a sudra a Nishada, who is also called Parasava.
verses.hindi: साथ दिवाह न करने से और अपने वणौअम धमा को छोड़ने से कहते हैं;-सूत १ वैदेह, चाएडाल, मागध क्षत्ता श आयायवर्य छुः पुरष अफ माता को जाति नै और अपने ले ऊंची जाति मे जो घे अपनी जाति की होती है । आर जले ब्राह्मण
verses.science: साथ दिवाह न करने से और अपने वणौअम धमा को छोड़ने से कहते हैं;-सूत १ वैदेह, चाएडाल, मागध क्षत्ता श आयायवर्य छुः पुरष अफ माता को जाति नै और अपने ले ऊंची जाति मे…। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियात्शूद्रकन्यायां क्रूराचारविहारवान् । क्षत्रशूद्रवपुर्जन्तुरुग्रो नाम प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyātśūdrakanyāyāṃ krūrācāravihāravān | kṣatraśūdravapurjanturugro nāma prajāyate
verses.translation: From a Kshatriya and the daughter of a Sudra springs a being, called Ugra, resembling both a Kshatriya and a Sudra, ferocious in his manners, and delighting in cruelty.
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Kshatriya and the daughter of a Sudra springs a being, called Ugra, resembling both a Kshatriya and a Sudra, ferocious in his manners, and delighting in cruelty.
verses.hindi: आयोगच आदि छः ्रतिलोम पुत्र परस्पर म अपने से अधम हे चाण्डाल वसैरह अपनी दूसरी पाँच घतिलोम जातियों में घर्ना के तान तान पुत्र बारह हुए और उनके पिता तोच अधम मिलकर १४ छुए ॥ ६-३१ ॥
verses.science: आयोगच आदि छः ्रतिलोम पुत्र परस्पर म अपने से अधम हे चाण्डाल वसैरह अपनी दूसरी पाँच घतिलोम जातियों में घर्ना के तान तान पुत्र बारह हुए और उनके पिता तोच अधम मिलक…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: विप्रस्य त्रिषु वर्णेषु नृपतेर्वर्णयोर्द्वयोः । वैश्यस्य वर्णे चैकस्मिन् षडेतेऽपसदाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: viprasya triṣu varṇeṣu nṛpatervarṇayordvayoḥ | vaiśyasya varṇe caikasmin ṣaḍete'pasadāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Children of a Brahmana by (women of) the three (lower) castes, of a Kshatriya by (wives of) the two (lower) castes, and of a Vaisya by (a wife of) the one caste (below him) are all six called base-born (apasada).
verses.hindi: हो, उनको उसी, जाति का जातना चाहिए। प्राह्मणादि के अपने . से एक श्रेणी नीचे जाति की खी मे पैदा हुए पुत्र पिता के समानं; जाति के गिने जाते हँ--क््योंकि चे माता के दोष से निन्दित हें। सनातन विधि है और अपने.से दो दो. जाति नीचे की ख्ियों मे:
verses.commentary: Sense: Children of a Brahmana by (women of) the three (lower) castes, of a Kshatriya by (wives of) the two (lower) castes, and of a Vaisya by (a wife of) the one caste (below him) are all six called base-born (apasada).
verses.science: हो, उनको उसी, जाति का जातना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रियाद्विप्रकन्यायां सूतो भवति जातितः । वैश्यान् मागधवैदेहौ राजविप्राङ्गनासुतौ
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyādviprakanyāyāṃ sūto bhavati jātitaḥ | vaiśyān māgadhavaidehau rājaviprāṅganāsutau
verses.translation: From a Kshatriya by the daughter of a Brahmana is born (a son called) according to his caste (gati) a Suta; from a Vaisya by females of the royal and the Brahmana (castes) spring a Magadha and a Vaideha.
verses.hindi: आहिण्डिको निषादेन वेदेद्यामेव जायते
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Kshatriya by the daughter of a Brahmana is born (a son called) according to his caste (gati) a Suta; from a Vaisya by females of the royal and the Brahmana (castes) spring a Magadha and a Vaideha.
verses.science: आहिण्डिको निषादेन वेदेद्यामेव जायते। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रादायोगवः क्षत्ता चण्डालश्चाधमो नृणाम् । वैश्यराजन्यविप्रासु जायन्ते वर्णसङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: śūdrādāyogavaḥ kṣattā caṇḍālaścādhamo nṛṇām | vaiśyarājanyaviprāsu jāyante varṇasaṅkarāḥ
verses.translation: From a Sudra are born an Ayogava, a Kshattri, and a Kandala, the lowest of men, by Vaisya, Kshatriya, and Brahmana) females, (sons who owe their origin to) a confusion of the castes.
verses.hindi: जिनको राजाशा से फाँसी का दरड इश्च हो उनको शास्त्राच- सार मारे और उनके घर, शय्या, ,आभूपणा को लेवे । ,जातिम्रष्ट, वर्णेसङ्र, अपरिचित और आर्ये मालूम होनेवाला ऐसे अनाया को उनके कर्मा से पहचाने । श्रसस्वता, कठोरपत, करता ऑर अना-
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Sudra are born an Ayogava, a Kshattri, and a Kandala, the lowest of men, by Vaisya, Kshatriya, and Brahmana) females, (sons who owe their origin to) a confusion of the castes.
verses.science: जिनको राजाशा से फाँसी का दरड इश्च हो उनको शास्त्राच- सार मारे और उनके घर, शय्या, ,आभूपणा को लेवे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: एकान्तरे त्वानुलोम्यादम्बष्ठोग्रौ यथा स्मृतौ । क्षत्तृवैदेहकौ तद्वत्प्रातिलोम्येऽपि जन्मनि
verses.transliteration: ekāntare tvānulomyādambaṣṭhograu yathā smṛtau | kṣattṛvaidehakau tadvatprātilomye'pi janmani
verses.translation: As an Ambashtha and an Ugra, (begotten) in the direct order on (women) one degree lower (than their husbands) are declared (to be), even so are a Kshattri and a Vaidehaka, though they were born in the inverse order of the castes (from mothers one degree higher than the fathers).
verses.hindi: इतरेषां तु पण्यानां विक्रयादिह कासतः ।
verses.commentary: Sense: As an Ambashtha and an Ugra, (begotten) in the direct order on (women) one degree lower (than their husbands) are declared (to be), even so are a Kshattri and a Vaidehaka, though they were born in the inverse order of the castes (from mothers one degree higher than the fathers).
verses.science: इतरेषां तु पण्यानां विक्रयादिह कासतः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रा येऽनन्तरस्त्रीजाः क्रमेणोक्ता द्विजन्मनाम् । ताननन्तरनाम्नस्तु मातृदोषात्प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: putrā ye'nantarastrījāḥ krameṇoktā dvijanmanām | tānanantaranāmnastu mātṛdoṣātpracakṣate
verses.translation: Those sons of the twice-born, begotten on wives of the next lower castes, who have been enumerated in due order, they call by the name Anantaras (belonging to the next lower caste), on account of the blemish (inherent) in their mothers.
verses.hindi: परधर्मेण जीवन् हि सद्यः पतति जातितः
verses.commentary: Sense: Those sons of the twice-born, begotten on wives of the next lower castes, who have been enumerated in due order, they call by the name Anantaras (belonging to the next lower caste), on account of the blemish (inherent) in their mothers.
verses.science: परधर्मेण जीवन् हि सद्यः पतति जातितः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणादुग्रकन्यायामावृतो नाम जायते । आभीरोऽम्बष्ठकन्यायामायोगव्यां तु धिग्वणः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇādugrakanyāyāmāvṛto nāma jāyate | ābhīro'mbaṣṭhakanyāyāmāyogavyāṃ tu dhigvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana begets on the daughter of an Ugra an Avrita, on the daughter of an Ambashtha an Abhira, but on a female of the Ayogava (caste) a Dhigvana.
verses.hindi: तानि काइककमाणि शिल्पानि विविधानि च
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana begets on the daughter of an Ugra an Avrita, on the daughter of an Ambashtha an Abhira, but on a female of the Ayogava (caste) a Dhigvana.
verses.science: तानि काइककमाणि शिल्पानि विविधानि च। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आयोगवश्च क्षत्ता च चण्डालश्चाधमो नृणाम् । प्रातिलोम्येन जायन्ते शूद्रादपसदास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: āyogavaśca kṣattā ca caṇḍālaścādhamo nṛṇām | prātilomyena jāyante śūdrādapasadāstrayaḥ
verses.translation: From a Sudra spring in the inverse order (by females of the higher castes) three base-born (sons, apasada), an Ayogava, a Kshattri, and a Kandala, the lowest of men;
verses.hindi: जो चीचजाति का पुरुप लोभ से, उत्तम जाति के कर्म से जी- बिका करे; डलका धन छीनकर राज्य देश से निकाल दे । अपना घर्मे किसी अंश में न्यून हो तो भी अच्छा है । पर दूसरे का रमे सबीय पूणे भी अच्छा नहीं । क्योंकि दूसरे के धर्मे ले जीविका
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Sudra spring in the inverse order (by females of the higher castes) three base-born (sons, apasada), an Ayogava, a Kshattri, and a Kandala, the lowest of men;
verses.science: जो चीचजाति का पुरुप लोभ से, उत्तम जाति के कर्म से जी- बिका करे; डलका धन छीनकर राज्य देश से निकाल दे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यान् मागधवैदेहौ क्षत्रियात्सूत एव तु । प्रतीपमेते जायन्ते परेऽप्यपसदास्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: vaiśyān māgadhavaidehau kṣatriyātsūta eva tu | pratīpamete jāyante pare'pyapasadāstrayaḥ
verses.translation: From a Vaisya are born in the inverse order of the castes a Magadha and a Vaideha, but from a Kshatriya a Suta only; these are three other base-born ones (apasada).
verses.hindi: घाणान्त दुःख न पड़कर, जो पुरुष मनमाना श्रश्न खाता है, चद फीच से आकाश के समान, पाप से लिप्त नहीं होता। भूखसे दुःखो अजीगते ऋषि (सौ गो फे लोम से) पुत्र मारने को तैयार मित्र भूख से दुःखी होकर, चाएडाल के हाथ से कुत्ता की जॉघ
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Vaisya are born in the inverse order of the castes a Magadha and a Vaideha, but from a Kshatriya a Suta only; these are three other base-born ones (apasada).
verses.science: घाणान्त दुःख न पड़कर, जो पुरुष मनमाना श्रश्न खाता है, चद फीच से आकाश के समान, पाप से लिप्त नहीं होता। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जातो निषादात्शूद्रायां जात्या भवति पुक्कसः । शूद्राज्जातो निषाद्यां तु स वै कुक्कुटकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: jāto niṣādātśūdrāyāṃ jātyā bhavati pukkasaḥ | śūdrājjāto niṣādyāṃ tu sa vai kukkuṭakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The son of a Nishada by a Sudra female becomes a Pukkasa by caste (gati), but the son of a Sudra by a Nishada female is declared to be a Kukkutaka.
verses.hindi: प्रतियहनिमित्त तु त्यागेन तपसेव च
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of a Nishada by a Sudra female becomes a Pukkasa by caste (gati), but the son of a Sudra by a Nishada female is declared to be a Kukkutaka.
verses.science: प्रतियहनिमित्त तु त्यागेन तपसेव च। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्तुर्जातस्तथोग्रायां श्वपाक इति कीर्त्यते । वैदेहकेन त्वम्बष्ठ्यामुत्पन्नो वेण उच्यते
verses.transliteration: kṣatturjātastathogrāyāṃ śvapāka iti kīrtyate | vaidehakena tvambaṣṭhyāmutpanno veṇa ucyate
verses.translation: Moreover, the son of by Kshattri by an Ugra female is called a Svapaka; but one begotten by a Vaidehaka on an Ambashtha female is named a Vena.
verses.hindi: दान लेचा, यज्ञ कराना और चेद पढ़ाना इनमें दान लेना. अधम है और आर्ण को सुत्यु के वाद् परलोक में इःख देता दे! क्योंकि याजन और अध्यापन संस्कार चाल को कराये जाते हैं। और प्रतिग्रह द्र से सी लिया जाता है . अडचित-याजन और
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, the son of by Kshattri by an Ugra female is called a Svapaka; but one begotten by a Vaidehaka on an Ambashtha female is named a Vena.
verses.science: दान लेचा, यज्ञ कराना और चेद पढ़ाना इनमें दान लेना. अधम है और आर्ण को सुत्यु के वाद् परलोक में इःख देता दे! क्योंकि याजन और अध्यापन संस्कार चाल को कराये जाते हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: द्विजातयः सवर्णासु जनयन्त्यव्रतांस्तु यान् । तान् सावित्रीपरिभ्रष्टान् व्रात्यानिति विनिर्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: dvijātayaḥ savarṇāsu janayantyavratāṃstu yān | tān sāvitrīparibhraṣṭān vrātyāniti vinirdiśet
verses.translation: Those (sons) whom the twice-born beget on wives of equal caste, but who, not fulfilling their sacred duties, are excluded from the Savitri, one must designate by the appellation Vratyas.
verses.hindi: किसी उपाय से, जीविका व कर सके, तो आझण, शिल, उन्छुको. घद्द राजा से अम, घरा या धन मांगे यदि न दे तो उसको त्यागदे । चिना जोता खेत, गौ, चकरा; मेढा, सोना, कध्या और पक्षा अनन इनमें अगले अगले से पहले पहले निर्दोष माने जाते
verses.commentary: Sense: Those (sons) whom the twice-born beget on wives of equal caste, but who, not fulfilling their sacred duties, are excluded from the Savitri, one must designate by the appellation Vratyas.
verses.science: किसी उपाय से, जीविका व कर सके, तो आझण, शिल, उन्छुको. घद्द राजा से अम, घरा या धन मांगे यदि न दे तो उसको त्यागदे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: व्रात्यात्तु जायते विप्रात्पापात्मा भूर्जकण्टकः । भृज्जकण्टकः आवन्त्यवाटधानौ च पुष्पधः शैख एव च
verses.transliteration: vrātyāttu jāyate viprātpāpātmā bhūrjakaṇṭakaḥ | bhṛjjakaṇṭakaḥ āvantyavāṭadhānau ca puṣpadhaḥ śaikha eva ca
verses.translation: But from a Vratya (of the) Brahmana (caste) spring the wicked Bhriggakantaka, the Avantya, the Vatadhana, the Pushpadha, and the Saikha.
verses.hindi: .,राजा वेश्या से शन्का आठवां भाग लेय और कार्पापण तक सराफ़ी के लाभ पर बीसवां भाग ले और शुत्र मजदूर," कारी" 'गरोस काम कराले! ब्राह्मण की सेवाखे शद्र जीविका न करसके तो परलोक दोनों में सुख चाइनेचाला शुद्र ब्राह्मण: की सवा करे!
verses.commentary: Sense: But from a Vratya (of the) Brahmana (caste) spring the wicked Bhriggakantaka, the Avantya, the Vatadhana, the Pushpadha, and the Saikha.
verses.science: .,राजा वेश्या से शन्का आठवां भाग लेय और कार्पापण तक सराफ़ी के लाभ पर बीसवां भाग ले और शुत्र मजदूर," कारी" 'गरोस काम कराले! ब्राह्मण की सेवाखे शद्र जीविका न क…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: झल्लो मल्लश्च राजन्याद्व्रात्यात्निच्छिविरेव च । व्रात्यात्लिच्छविरेव च नटश्च करणश्चैव खसो द्रविड एव च
verses.transliteration: jhallo mallaśca rājanyādvrātyātnicchivireva ca | vrātyātlicchavireva ca naṭaśca karaṇaścaiva khaso draviḍa eva ca
verses.translation: From a Vratya (of the) Kshatriya (caste), the Ghalla, the Malla, the Likkhivi, the Nata, the Karana, the Khasa, and the Dravida.
verses.hindi: शुक्केनापि हि शूद्रेण न कार्यों धनसंचय:। . ,
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Vratya (of the) Kshatriya (caste), the Ghalla, the Malla, the Likkhivi, the Nata, the Karana, the Khasa, and the Dravida.
verses.science: शुक्केनापि हि शूद्रेण न कार्यों धनसंचय:। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यात्तु जायते व्रात्यात्सुधन्वाऽचार्य एव च । कारुषश्च विजन्मा च मैत्रः सात्वत एव च
verses.transliteration: vaiśyāttu jāyate vrātyātsudhanvā'cārya eva ca | kāruṣaśca vijanmā ca maitraḥ sātvata eva ca
verses.translation: From a Vratya (of the) Vaisya (caste) are born a Sudhanvan, an Akarya, a Karusha, a Viganman, a Maitra, and a Satvata.
verses.hindi: फे आचरण करते हुए दोप नहाँ किन्तु प्रशंसा को प्रात होते हैं। श्र जले जैसे सदाचार का पालन करता है वैसे वैसे लोक मे प्रशंसा पाता है भोर मरकर उत्तम लोक का भागी होता है। को दुःख देता है! इसप्रकार ये सव चारों पणौ के आपत्काल
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Vratya (of the) Vaisya (caste) are born a Sudhanvan, an Akarya, a Karusha, a Viganman, a Maitra, and a Satvata.
verses.science: फे आचरण करते हुए दोप नहाँ किन्तु प्रशंसा को प्रात होते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: व्यभिचारेण वर्णानामवेद्यावेदनेन च । स्वकर्मणां च त्यागेन जायन्ते वर्णसङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: vyabhicāreṇa varṇānāmavedyāvedanena ca | svakarmaṇāṃ ca tyāgena jāyante varṇasaṅkarāḥ
verses.translation: By adultery (committed by persons) of (different) castes, by marriages with women who ought not to be married, and by the neglect of the duties and occupations (prescribed) to each, are produced (sons who owe their origin) to a confusion the castes.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को
verses.commentary: Sense: By adultery (committed by persons) of (different) castes, by marriages with women who ought not to be married, and by the neglect of the duties and occupations (prescribed) to each, are produced (sons who owe their origin) to a confusion the castes.
verses.science: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कीर्णयोनयो ये तु प्रतिलोमानुलोमजाः । अन्योन्यव्यतिषक्ताश्च तान् प्रवक्ष्याम्यशेषतः
verses.transliteration: saṅkīrṇayonayo ye tu pratilomānulomajāḥ | anyonyavyatiṣaktāśca tān pravakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: I will (now) fully enumerate those (sons) of mixed origin, who are born of Anulomas and of Pratilomas, and (thus) are mutually connected.
verses.commentary: Sense: I will (now) fully enumerate those (sons) of mixed origin, who are born of Anulomas and of Pratilomas, and (thus) are mutually connected.
verses.hindi: चारों वर्षौं के घभे-कमे-जीविका आदि।
verses.science: चारों वर्षौं के घभे-कमे-जीविका आदि। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूतो वैदेहकश्चैव चण्डालश्च नराधमः । मागधः तथाऽयोगव एव च क्षत्रजातिश्च
verses.transliteration: sūto vaidehakaścaiva caṇḍālaśca narādhamaḥ | māgadhaḥ tathā'yogava eva ca kṣatrajātiśca
verses.translation: The Suta, the Vaidehaka, the Kandala, that lowest of mortals, the Magadha, he of the Kshattri caste (gati), and the Ayogava,
verses.commentary: Sense: The Suta, the Vaidehaka, the Kandala, that lowest of mortals, the Magadha, he of the Kshattri caste (gati), and the Ayogava,
verses.hindi: . हो, उसके भो कत्या हो और बह भी ब्राह्मण.को दी-जाय; यो. सा--.. : भी बह पुरुष ब्राह्मण माना. जाता. है । शद जैसे आह्मण॒ता को पाता . कहलाता हैं। और शुद्र से आहाणी में उत्पन्न हुआ, ' अनाय ' कह'- लाता है । पहला नीच जाति में होने से और दूसरा प्रतिलोम होने
verses.science: . हो, उसके भो कत्या हो और बह भी ब्राह्मण.को दी-जाय; यो. सा--.. : भी बह पुरुष ब्राह्मण माना. जाता. है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्तृजातिश्च एते षट् सदृशान् वर्णाञ्जनयन्ति स्वयोनिषु । मातृजात्यां प्रसूयन्ते प्रवारासु च योनिषु
verses.transliteration: kṣattṛjātiśca ete ṣaṭ sadṛśān varṇāñjanayanti svayoniṣu | mātṛjātyāṃ prasūyante pravārāsu ca yoniṣu
verses.translation: These six (Pratilomas) beget similar races (varna) on women of their own (caste), they (also) produce (the like) with females of their mother's caste (gati), and with females (of) higher ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: These six (Pratilomas) beget similar races (varna) on women of their own (caste), they (also) produce (the like) with females of their mother's caste (gati), and with females (of) higher ones.
verses.hindi: से आया में पैदाहुआ पुत्र सब संस्कार के योग्य होतादे । कोई बि- ऊसर मै चोया बीज वीचही में नर दोजाताहै और विना बीज फे खेत कोरा-सपाट पड़ा रहताहे ॥ ६६-७१ ॥
verses.science: से आया में पैदाहुआ पुत्र सब संस्कार के योग्य होतादे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मातृजात्याः यथा त्रयाणां वर्णानां द्वयोरात्माऽस्य जायते । आनन्तर्यात्स्वयोन्यां तु तथा बाह्येष्वपि क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: mātṛjātyāḥ yathā trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ dvayorātmā'sya jāyate | ānantaryātsvayonyāṃ tu tathā bāhyeṣvapi kramāt
verses.translation: As a (Brahmana) begets on (females of) two out of the three (twice-born castes a son similar to) himself, (but inferior) on account of the lower degree (of the mother), and (one equal to himself) on a female of his own race, even so is the order in the case of the excluded (races, vahya).
verses.wordMeaning: As a (Brahmana) begets on (females of) two out of the three (twice-born castes a son similar to) himself, (but inferior) on account of the lower degree (of the mother), and (one equal to himself) on a female of his own race,…
verses.commentary: Sense: As a (Brahmana) begets on (females of) two out of the three (twice-born castes a son similar to) himself, (but inferior) on account of the lower degree (of the mother), and (one equal to himself) on a female of his own race,…
verses.hindi: षएणां तु कर्मणामस्य त्रीणि कमणि जीविका ।
verses.science: षएणां तु कर्मणामस्य त्रीणि कमणि जीविका। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रमः ते चापि बाह्यान् सुबहूंस्ततोऽप्यधिकदूषितान् । परस्परस्य दारेषु जनयन्ति विगर्हितान्
verses.transliteration: kramaḥ te cāpi bāhyān subahūṃstato'pyadhikadūṣitān | parasparasya dāreṣu janayanti vigarhitān
verses.translation: Those (six mentioned above) also beget, the one on the females of the other, a great many (kinds of) despicable (sons), even more sinful than their (fathers), and excluded (from the Aryan community, vahya).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those (six mentioned above) also beget, the one on the females of the other, a great many (kinds of) despicable (sons), even more sinful than their (fathers), and excluded (from the Aryan community, vahya).
verses.hindi: अध्यापनं याजनं च तृतीयश्च प्रतियहः
verses.science: अध्यापनं याजनं च तृतीयश्च प्रतियहः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथैव शूद्रो ब्राह्मण्यां बाह्यं जन्तुं प्रसूयते । तथा बाह्यतरं बाह्यश्चातुर्वर्ण्ये प्रसूयते
verses.transliteration: yathaiva śūdro brāhmaṇyāṃ bāhyaṃ jantuṃ prasūyate | tathā bāhyataraṃ bāhyaścāturvarṇye prasūyate
verses.translation: Just as a Sudra begets on a Brahmana female a being excluded (from the Aryan community), even so (a person himself) excluded pro creates with (females of) the four castes (varna, sons) more (worthy of being) excluded (than he himself).
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as a Sudra begets on a Brahmana female a being excluded (from the Aryan community), even so (a person himself) excluded pro creates with (females of) the four castes (varna, sons) more (worthy of being) excluded (than he himself).
verses.hindi: स्वभाव के विना केवल कर्म से अनार्य, आये नहीं होखकते । जो पढ़ना, पढ़ना, यक्ष करता, यज्ञ कराना, दान देना और दान लेना आझण के ये छः कसे हैं । इसमें यज्ञ कराना, पढ़ाना और झुद्धदा लेना ये तीन कमे जीविका हैं । बाह्मण के घो से क्षत्रिय के तीन
verses.science: स्वभाव के विना केवल कर्म से अनार्य, आये नहीं होखकते। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिकूलं वर्तमाना बाह्या बाह्यतरान् पुनः । हीना हीनान् प्रसूयन्ते वर्णान् पञ्चदशैव तु
verses.transliteration: pratikūlaṃ vartamānā bāhyā bāhyatarān punaḥ | hīnā hīnān prasūyante varṇān pañcadaśaiva tu
verses.translation: But men excluded (by the Aryans, vahya), who approach females of higher rank, beget races (varna) still more worthy to be excluded, low men (hina) still lower races, even fifteen (in number).
verses.commentary: Sense: But men excluded (by the Aryans, vahya), who approach females of higher rank, beget races (varna) still more worthy to be excluded, low men (hina) still lower races, even fifteen (in number).
verses.hindi: भूमि भूमिशयांश्वेव हन्ति काऽमयोसुखम्
verses.science: भूमि भूमिशयांश्वेव हन्ति काऽमयोसुखम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसाधनोपचारज्ञमदासं दासजीवनम् । दास्यजीविनं सैरिन्ध्रं वागुरावृत्तिं सूते दस्युरयोगवे
verses.transliteration: prasādhanopacārajñamadāsaṃ dāsajīvanam | dāsyajīvinaṃ sairindhraṃ vāgurāvṛttiṃ sūte dasyurayogave
verses.translation: A Dasyu begets on an Ayogava (woman) a Sairandhra, who is skilled in adorning and attending (his master), who, (though) not a slave, lives like a slave, (or) subsists by snaring (animals).
verses.commentary: Sense: A Dasyu begets on an Ayogava (woman) a Sairandhra, who is skilled in adorning and attending (his master), who, (though) not a slave, lives like a slave, (or) subsists by snaring (animals).
verses.hindi: आए चेल्युररक्काने झलमूते तथोषधीः
verses.science: आए चेल्युररक्काने झलमूते तथोषधीः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सैरन्ध्रं मैत्रेयकं तु वैदेहो माधूकं सम्प्रसूयते । नॄन् प्रशंसत्यजस्रं यो घण्टाताडोऽरुणोदये
verses.transliteration: sairandhraṃ maitreyakaṃ tu vaideho mādhūkaṃ samprasūyate | nṝn praśaṃsatyajasraṃ yo ghaṇṭātāḍo'ruṇodaye
verses.translation: A Vaideha produces (with the same) a sweet-voiced Maitreyaka, who, ringing a bell at the appearance of dawn, continually. praises (great) men.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Vaideha produces (with the same) a sweet-voiced Maitreyaka, who, ringing a bell at the appearance of dawn, continually. praises (great) men.
verses.hindi: यदि वेद पढ़ाकर अपनी जीविका न करसके तो क्षत्रिय के कमे से जीविका केरे । यदि गहाण, क्षत्रिय दोनो फे कमा से जाचका चे फरसके तो खेती, गोरक्षा आदि वेश्यजीबिका से निर्वाह करे! खेती को कसी न करे । कोई खेती को अच्छी मानते हैं, पर यह
verses.science: यदि वेद पढ़ाकर अपनी जीविका न करसके तो क्षत्रिय के कमे से जीविका केरे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: निषादो मार्गवं सूते दासं नौकर्मजीविनम् । कैवर्तमिति यं प्राहुरार्यावर्तनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: niṣādo mārgavaṃ sūte dāsaṃ naukarmajīvinam | kaivartamiti yaṃ prāhurāryāvartanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: A Nishada begets (on the same) a Margava (or) Dasa, who subsists by working as a boatman, (and) whom the inhabitants of Aryavarta call a Kaivarta.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Nishada begets (on the same) a Margava (or) Dasa, who subsists by working as a boatman, (and) whom the inhabitants of Aryavarta call a Kaivarta.
verses.hindi: स्यः पताति. मांसेन लाक्षया सवशेन्र च। .
verses.science: स्यः पताति. मांसेन लाक्षया सवशेन्र च। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मृतवस्त्रभृत्स्वनारीषु गर्हितान्नाशनासु च । अनार्याषु भवन्त्यायोगवीष्वेते जातिहीनाः पृथक्त्रयः
verses.transliteration: mṛtavastrabhṛtsvanārīṣu garhitānnāśanāsu ca | anāryāṣu bhavantyāyogavīṣvete jātihīnāḥ pṛthaktrayaḥ
verses.translation: Those three base-born ones are severally begot on Ayogava women, who wear the clothes of the dead, are wicked, and eat reprehensible food.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those three base-born ones are severally begot on Ayogava women, who wear the clothes of the dead, are wicked, and eat reprehensible food.
verses.hindi: इतरेषां तु पण्यानां विक्रयादिह कासतः ।
verses.science: इतरेषां तु पण्यानां विक्रयादिह कासतः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कारावरो निषादात्तु चर्मकारः प्रसूयते । चर्मकारं वैदेहिकादन्ध्रमेदौ बहिर्ग्रामप्रतिश्रयौ
verses.transliteration: kārāvaro niṣādāttu carmakāraḥ prasūyate | carmakāraṃ vaidehikādandhramedau bahirgrāmapratiśrayau
verses.translation: From a Nishada springs (by a woman of the Vaideha caste) a Karavara, who works in leather; and from a Vaidehaka (by women of the Karavara and Nishada castes), an Andhra and a Meda, who dwell outside the village.
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Nishada springs (by a woman of the Vaideha caste) a Karavara, who works in leather; and from a Vaidehaka (by women of the Karavara and Nishada castes), an Andhra and a Meda, who dwell outside the village.
verses.hindi: जल, हथियार, चिप, मास, सोमरस, सब तरहकी सुगन्धि, इध, पक्षी, भाग; गांजा, नांल, लाख और एक खुरके पशु, इन सबका व्यापार न करे । ब्राह्मण किसान खेती करके ति २५५ व्यापार न । बहास किसान खेती करके तिज पैदा किये हो तो
verses.science: जल, हथियार, चिप, मास, सोमरस, सब तरहकी सुगन्धि, इध, पक्षी, भाग; गांजा, नांल, लाख और एक खुरके पशु, इन सबका व्यापार न करे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: चण्डालात्पाण्डुसोपाकस्त्वक्सारव्यवहारवान् । आहिण्डिको निषादेन वैदेह्यामेव जायते
verses.transliteration: caṇḍālātpāṇḍusopākastvaksāravyavahāravān | āhiṇḍiko niṣādena vaidehyāmeva jāyate
verses.translation: From a Kandala by a Vaideha woman is born a Pandusopaka, who deals in cane; from a Nishada (by the same) an Ahindika.
verses.commentary: Sense: From a Kandala by a Vaideha woman is born a Pandusopaka, who deals in cane; from a Nishada (by the same) an Ahindika.
verses.hindi: अपर गिनाये पदार्था को छोड़कर, दुसरे शाखा में निषिद्ध पदार्थो फो यदि प्राश इच्छा से वंचता है, तो चह सात राधि के बाद, चैप्यपने को पाता है । गुइ आदि रसोका घी आदि रसोसे चदला फरे, किन्तु लोन का रसों से वदला न करे। पका अन्न, का अन्न
verses.science: अपर गिनाये पदार्था को छोड़कर, दुसरे शाखा में निषिद्ध पदार्थो फो यदि प्राश इच्छा से वंचता है, तो चह सात राधि के बाद, चैप्यपने को पाता है। आहार, निद्रा और इंद्रिय-भार शरीर की स्थिति को सीधे बदलते हैं। यह पंक्ति उस शारीरिक आधार को छोड़कर नहीं चलती।

verses.sanskrit: चण्डालेन तु सोपाको मूलव्यसनवृत्तिमान् । पुक्कस्यां जायते पापः सदा सज्जनगर्हितः
verses.transliteration: caṇḍālena tu sopāko mūlavyasanavṛttimān | pukkasyāṃ jāyate pāpaḥ sadā sajjanagarhitaḥ
verses.translation: But from a Kandala by a Pukkasa woman is born the sinful Sopaka, who lives by the occupations of his sire, and is ever despised by good men.
verses.commentary: Sense: But from a Kandala by a Pukkasa woman is born the sinful Sopaka, who lives by the occupations of his sire, and is ever despised by good men.
verses.hindi: परधर्मेण जीवन् हि सद्यः पतति जातितः
verses.science: परधर्मेण जीवन् हि सद्यः पतति जातितः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: पुल्कस्यां निषादस्त्री तु चण्डालात्पुत्रमन्त्यावसायिनम् । श्मशानगोचरं सूते बाह्यानामपि गर्हितम्
verses.transliteration: pulkasyāṃ niṣādastrī tu caṇḍālātputramantyāvasāyinam | śmaśānagocaraṃ sūte bāhyānāmapi garhitam
verses.translation: A Nishada woman bears to a Kandala a son (called) Antyavasayin, employed in burial-grounds, and despised even by those excluded (from the Aryan community).
verses.commentary: Sense: A Nishada woman bears to a Kandala a son (called) Antyavasayin, employed in burial-grounds, and despised even by those excluded (from the Aryan community).
verses.hindi: तानि काइककमाणि शिल्पानि विविधानि च
verses.science: तानि काइककमाणि शिल्पानि विविधानि च। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सङ्करे जातयस्त्वेताः पितृमातृप्रदर्शिताः । प्रच्छन्ना वा प्रकाशा वा वेदितव्याः स्वकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: saṅkare jātayastvetāḥ pitṛmātṛpradarśitāḥ | pracchannā vā prakāśā vā veditavyāḥ svakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: These races, (which originate) in a confusion (of the castes and) have been described according to their fathers and mothers, may be known by their occupations, whether they conceal or openly show themselves.
verses.commentary: Sense: These races, (which originate) in a confusion (of the castes and) have been described according to their fathers and mothers, may be known by their occupations, whether they conceal or openly show themselves.
verses.hindi: जो चीचजाति का पुरुप लोभ से, उत्तम जाति के कर्म से जी- बिका करे; डलका धन छीनकर राज्य देश से निकाल दे । अपना घर्मे किसी अंश में न्यून हो तो भी अच्छा है । पर दूसरे का रमे सबीय पूणे भी अच्छा नहीं । क्योंकि दूसरे के धर्मे ले जीविका
verses.science: जो चीचजाति का पुरुप लोभ से, उत्तम जाति के कर्म से जी- बिका करे; डलका धन छीनकर राज्य देश से निकाल दे। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वजातिजानन्तरजाः षट् सुता द्विजधर्मिणः । शूद्राणां तु सधर्माणः सर्वेऽपध्वंसजाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: svajātijānantarajāḥ ṣaṭ sutā dvijadharmiṇaḥ | śūdrāṇāṃ tu sadharmāṇaḥ sarve'padhvaṃsajāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Six sons, begotten (by Aryans) on women of equal and the next lower castes (Anantara), have the duties of twice-born men; but all those born in consequence of a violation (of the law) are, as regards their duties, equal to Sudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Six sons, begotten (by Aryans) on women of equal and the next lower castes (Anantara), have the duties of twice-born men; but all those born in consequence of a violation (of the law) are, as regards their duties, equal to Sudras.
verses.hindi: घाणान्त दुःख न पड़कर, जो पुरुष मनमाना श्रश्न खाता है, चद फीच से आकाश के समान, पाप से लिप्त नहीं होता। भूखसे दुःखो अजीगते ऋषि (सौ गो फे लोम से) पुत्र मारने को तैयार मित्र भूख से दुःखी होकर, चाएडाल के हाथ से कुत्ता की जॉघ
verses.science: घाणान्त दुःख न पड़कर, जो पुरुष मनमाना श्रश्न खाता है, चद फीच से आकाश के समान, पाप से लिप्त नहीं होता। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तपोबीजप्रभावैस्तु ते गच्छन्ति युगे युगे । उत्कर्षं चापकर्षं च मनुष्येष्विह जन्मतः
verses.transliteration: tapobījaprabhāvaistu te gacchanti yuge yuge | utkarṣaṃ cāpakarṣaṃ ca manuṣyeṣviha janmataḥ
verses.translation: By the power of austerities and of the seed (from which they sprang), these (races) obtain here among men more exalted or lower rank in successive births.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the power of austerities and of the seed (from which they sprang), these (races) obtain here among men more exalted or lower rank in successive births.
verses.hindi: प्रतियहनिमित्त तु त्यागेन तपसेव च
verses.science: प्रतियहनिमित्त तु त्यागेन तपसेव च। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शनकैस्तु क्रियालोपादिमाः क्षत्रियजातयः । वृषलत्वं गता लोके ब्राह्मणादर्शनेन च
verses.transliteration: śanakaistu kriyālopādimāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ | vṛṣalatvaṃ gatā loke brāhmaṇādarśanena ca
verses.translation: But in consequence of the omission of the sacred rites, and of their not consulting Brahmanas, the following tribes of Kshatriyas have gradually sunk in this world to the condition of Sudras;
verses.commentary: Sense: But in consequence of the omission of the sacred rites, and of their not consulting Brahmanas, the following tribes of Kshatriyas have gradually sunk in this world to the condition of Sudras;
verses.hindi: दान लेचा, यज्ञ कराना और चेद पढ़ाना इनमें दान लेना. अधम है और आर्ण को सुत्यु के वाद् परलोक में इःख देता दे! क्योंकि याजन और अध्यापन संस्कार चाल को कराये जाते हैं। और प्रतिग्रह द्र से सी लिया जाता है . अडचित-याजन और
verses.science: दान लेचा, यज्ञ कराना और चेद पढ़ाना इनमें दान लेना. अधम है और आर्ण को सुत्यु के वाद् परलोक में इःख देता दे! क्योंकि याजन और अध्यापन संस्कार चाल को कराये जाते हैं। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणातिक्रमेण च पौण्ड्रकाश्चौड्रद्रविडाः काम्बोजा यवनाः शकाः । पुण्ड्रकाश्चोडद्रविडाः पारदापह्लवाश्चीनाः किराता दरदाः खशाः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇātikrameṇa ca pauṇḍrakāścauḍradraviḍāḥ kāmbojā yavanāḥ śakāḥ | puṇḍrakāścoḍadraviḍāḥ pāradāpahlavāścīnāḥ kirātā daradāḥ khaśāḥ
verses.translation: (Viz.) the Paundrakas, the Kodas, the Dravidas, the Kambogas, the Yavanas, the Sakas, the Paradas, the Pahlavas, the Kinas, the Kiratas, and the Daradas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Viz.) the Paundrakas, the Kodas, the Dravidas, the Kambogas, the Yavanas, the Sakas, the Paradas, the Pahlavas, the Kinas, the Kiratas, and the Daradas.
verses.hindi: ससवित्तागमा धर्म्या दायो लाभः कयो जयः।
verses.science: ससवित्तागमा धर्म्या दायो लाभः कयो जयः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: मुखबाहूरुपद्जानां या लोके जातयो बहिः । म्लेच्छवाचश्चार्यवाचः सर्वे ते दस्यवः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: mukhabāhūrupadjānāṃ yā loke jātayo bahiḥ | mlecchavācaścāryavācaḥ sarve te dasyavaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: All those tribes in this world, which are excluded from (the community of) those born from the mouth, the arms, the thighs, and the feet (of Brahman), are called Dasyus, whether they speak the language of the Mlekkhas (barbarians) or that of the Aryans.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those tribes in this world, which are excluded from (the community of) those born from the mouth, the arms, the thighs, and the feet (of Brahman), are called Dasyus, whether they speak the language of the Mlekkhas (barbarians) or that of the Aryans.
verses.hindi: किसी उपाय से, जीविका व कर सके, तो आझण, शिल, उन्छुको. घद्द राजा से अम, घरा या धन मांगे यदि न दे तो उसको त्यागदे । चिना जोता खेत, गौ, चकरा; मेढा, सोना, कध्या और पक्षा अनन इनमें अगले अगले से पहले पहले निर्दोष माने जाते
verses.science: किसी उपाय से, जीविका व कर सके, तो आझण, शिल, उन्छुको. घद्द राजा से अम, घरा या धन मांगे यदि न दे तो उसको त्यागदे। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ये द्विजानामपसदा ये चापध्वंसजाः स्मृताः । ते निन्दितैर्वर्तयेयुर्द्विजानामेव कर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: ye dvijānāmapasadā ye cāpadhvaṃsajāḥ smṛtāḥ | te ninditairvartayeyurdvijānāmeva karmabhiḥ
verses.translation: Those who have been mentioned as the base-born (offspring, apasada) of Aryans, or as produced in consequence of a violation (of the law, apadhvamsaga), shall subsist by occupations reprehended by the twice-born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have been mentioned as the base-born (offspring, apasada) of Aryans, or as produced in consequence of a violation (of the law, apadhvamsaga), shall subsist by occupations reprehended by the twice-born.
verses.hindi: .,राजा वेश्या से शन्का आठवां भाग लेय और कार्पापण तक सराफ़ी के लाभ पर बीसवां भाग ले और शुत्र मजदूर," कारी" 'गरोस काम कराले! ब्राह्मण की सेवाखे शद्र जीविका न करसके तो परलोक दोनों में सुख चाइनेचाला शुद्र ब्राह्मण: की सवा करे!
verses.science: .,राजा वेश्या से शन्का आठवां भाग लेय और कार्पापण तक सराफ़ी के लाभ पर बीसवां भाग ले और शुत्र मजदूर," कारी" 'गरोस काम कराले! ब्राह्मण की सेवाखे शद्र जीविका न क…। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सूतानामश्वसारथ्यमम्बष्ठानां चिकित्सनम् । वैदेहकानां स्त्रीकार्यं मागधानां वणिक्पथः
verses.transliteration: sūtānāmaśvasārathyamambaṣṭhānāṃ cikitsanam | vaidehakānāṃ strīkāryaṃ māgadhānāṃ vaṇikpathaḥ
verses.translation: To Sutas (belongs) the management of horses and of chariots; to Ambashthas, the art of healing; to Vaidehakas, the service of women; to Magadhas, trade;
verses.commentary: Sense: To Sutas (belongs) the management of horses and of chariots; to Ambashthas, the art of healing; to Vaidehakas, the service of women; to Magadhas, trade;
verses.hindi: शुक्केनापि हि शूद्रेण न कार्यों धनसंचय:। . ,
verses.science: शुक्केनापि हि शूद्रेण न कार्यों धनसंचय:। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यघातो निषादानां त्वष्टिस्त्वायोगवस्य च । मेदान्ध्रचुञ्चुमद्गूनामारण्यपशुहिंसनम्
verses.transliteration: matsyaghāto niṣādānāṃ tvaṣṭistvāyogavasya ca | medāndhracuñcumadgūnāmāraṇyapaśuhiṃsanam
verses.translation: Killing fish to Nishadas; carpenters' work to the Ayogava; to Medas, Andhras, Kunkus, and Madgus, the slaughter of wild animals;
verses.commentary: Sense: Killing fish to Nishadas; carpenters' work to the Ayogava; to Medas, Andhras, Kunkus, and Madgus, the slaughter of wild animals;
verses.hindi: फे आचरण करते हुए दोप नहाँ किन्तु प्रशंसा को प्रात होते हैं। श्र जले जैसे सदाचार का पालन करता है वैसे वैसे लोक मे प्रशंसा पाता है भोर मरकर उत्तम लोक का भागी होता है। को दुःख देता है! इसप्रकार ये सव चारों पणौ के आपत्काल
verses.science: फे आचरण करते हुए दोप नहाँ किन्तु प्रशंसा को प्रात होते हैं। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्त्र्युग्रपुक्कसानां तु बिलौकोवधबन्धनम् । धिग्वणानां चर्मकार्यं वेणानां भाण्डवादनम्
verses.transliteration: kṣattryugrapukkasānāṃ tu bilaukovadhabandhanam | dhigvaṇānāṃ carmakāryaṃ veṇānāṃ bhāṇḍavādanam
verses.translation: To Kshattris, Ugras, and Pukkasas, catching and killing (animals) living in holes; to Dhigvanas, working in leather; to Venas, playing drums.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Kshattris, Ugras, and Pukkasas, catching and killing (animals) living in holes; to Dhigvanas, working in leather; to Venas, playing drums.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को
verses.science: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चैत्यद्रुमश्मशानेषु शैलेषूपवनेषु च । वसेयुरेते विज्ञाता वर्तयन्तः स्वकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: caityadrumaśmaśāneṣu śaileṣūpavaneṣu ca | vaseyurete vijñātā vartayantaḥ svakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: Near well-known trees and burial-grounds, on mountains and in groves, let these (tribes) dwell, known (by certain marks), and subsisting by their peculiar occupations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near well-known trees and burial-grounds, on mountains and in groves, let these (tribes) dwell, known (by certain marks), and subsisting by their peculiar occupations.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को
verses.science: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: चण्डालश्वपचानां तु बहिर्ग्रामात्प्रतिश्रयः । अपपात्राश्च कर्तव्या धनमेषां श्वगर्दभम्
verses.transliteration: caṇḍālaśvapacānāṃ tu bahirgrāmātpratiśrayaḥ | apapātrāśca kartavyā dhanameṣāṃ śvagardabham
verses.translation: But the dwellings of Kandalas and Svapakas shall be outside the village, they must be made Apapatras, and their wealth (shall be) dogs and donkeys.
verses.commentary: Sense: But the dwellings of Kandalas and Svapakas shall be outside the village, they must be made Apapatras, and their wealth (shall be) dogs and donkeys.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को
verses.science: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: वासांसि मृतचैलानि भिन्नभाण्डेषु भोजनम् । कार्ष्णायसमलङ्कारः परिव्रज्या च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: vāsāṃsi mṛtacailāni bhinnabhāṇḍeṣu bhojanam | kārṣṇāyasamalaṅkāraḥ parivrajyā ca nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Their dress (shall be) the garments of the dead, (they shall eat) their food from broken dishes, black iron (shall be) their ornaments, and they must always wander from place to place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their dress (shall be) the garments of the dead, (they shall eat) their food from broken dishes, black iron (shall be) their ornaments, and they must always wander from place to place.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को
verses.science: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: न तैः समयमन्विच्छेत्पुरुषो धर्ममाचरन् । व्यवहारो मिथस्तेषां विवाहः सदृशैः सह
verses.transliteration: na taiḥ samayamanvicchetpuruṣo dharmamācaran | vyavahāro mithasteṣāṃ vivāhaḥ sadṛśaiḥ saha
verses.translation: A man who fulfils a religious duty, shall not seek intercourse with them; their transactions (shall be) among themselves, and their marriages with their equals.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who fulfils a religious duty, shall not seek intercourse with them; their transactions (shall be) among themselves, and their marriages with their equals.
verses.hindi: चलनेवाला, यश में सवस्त दक्षिणा देनेवाला, शुरु, माता और चिद्या के अनुसार इनको दान देना चाहिए । इन. ब्राह्मणा को
