verses.translation: Let him pass the time standing (during the day) and sitting (during the night), or if he is unable (to do that) let him lie on the (bare) ground; let him be chaste and observe the vows (of a student) and worship his Gurus, the gods, and Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सावित्रीं च जपेन्नित्यं पवित्राणि च शक्तितः । सर्वेष्वेव व्रतेष्वेवं प्रायश्चित्तार्थमादृतः
verses.transliteration: sāvitrīṃ ca japennityaṃ pavitrāṇi ca śaktitaḥ | sarveṣveva vrateṣvevaṃ prāyaścittārthamādṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Let him constantly mutter the Savitri and (other) purificatory texts according to his ability; (let him) carefully (act thus) on (the occasion of) all (other) vows (performed) by way of penance.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एतैर्द्विजातयः शोध्या व्रतैराविष्कृतेनसः । अनाविष्कृतपापांस्तु मन्त्रैर्होमैश्च शोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: etairdvijātayaḥ śodhyā vratairāviṣkṛtenasaḥ | anāviṣkṛtapāpāṃstu mantrairhomaiśca śodhayet
verses.translation: By these expiations twice-born men must be purified whose sins are known, but let him purify those whose sins are not known by (the recitation of) sacred texts and by (the performance of) burnt oblations.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ख्यापनेनानुतापेन तपसाऽध्ययनेन च । पापकृत्मुच्यते पापात्तथा दानेन चापदि
verses.transliteration: khyāpanenānutāpena tapasā'dhyayanena ca | pāpakṛtmucyate pāpāttathā dānena cāpadi
verses.translation: By confession, by repentance, by austerity, and by reciting (the Veda) a sinner is freed from guilt, and in case no other course is possible, by liberality.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा नरोऽधर्मं स्वयं कृत्वाऽनुभाषते । तथा तथा त्वचैवाहिस्तेनाधर्मेण मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yathā yathā naro'dharmaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā'nubhāṣate | tathā tathā tvacaivāhistenādharmeṇa mucyate
verses.translation: In proportion as a man who has done wrong, himself confesses it, even so far he is freed from guilt, as a snake from its slough.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा मनस्तस्य दुष्कृतं कर्म गर्हति । तथा तथा शरीरं तत्तेनाधर्मेण मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yathā yathā manastasya duṣkṛtaṃ karma garhati | tathā tathā śarīraṃ tattenādharmeṇa mucyate
verses.translation: In proportion as his heart loathes his evil deed, even so far is his body freed from that guilt.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पापं हि संतप्य तस्मात्पापात्प्रमुच्यते । नैवं कुर्यां पुनरिति निवृत्त्या पूयते तु सः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pāpaṃ hi saṃtapya tasmātpāpātpramucyate | naivaṃ kuryāṃ punariti nivṛttyā pūyate tu saḥ
verses.translation: He who has committed a sin and has repented, is freed from that sin, but he is purified only by (the resolution of) ceasing (to sin and thinking) 'I will do so no more.'
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एवं सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा प्रेत्य कर्मफलोदयम् । मनोवाङ्मूर्तिभिर्नित्यं शुभं कर्म समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sañcintya manasā pretya karmaphalodayam | manovāṅmūrtibhirnityaṃ śubhaṃ karma samācaret
verses.translation: Having thus considered in his mind what results will arise from his deeds after death, let him always be good in thoughts, speech, and actions.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानाद्यदि वा ज्ञानात्कृत्वा कर्म विगर्हितम् । तस्माद्विमुक्तिमन्विच्छन् द्वितीयं न समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: ajñānādyadi vā jñānātkṛtvā karma vigarhitam | tasmādvimuktimanvicchan dvitīyaṃ na samācaret
verses.translation: He who, having either unintentionally or intentionally committed a reprehensible deed, desires to be freed from (the guilt on it, must not commit it a second time.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्य कृते मनसः स्यादलाघवम् । तस्मिंस्तावत्तपः कुर्याद्यावत्तुष्टिकरं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: yasmin karmaṇyasya kṛte manasaḥ syādalāghavam | tasmiṃstāvattapaḥ kuryādyāvattuṣṭikaraṃ bhavet
verses.translation: If his mind be uneasy with respect to any act, let him repeat the austerities (prescribed as a penance) for it until they fully satisfy (his conscience).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपोमूलमिदं सर्वं दैवमानुषकं सुखम् । तपोमध्यं बुधैः प्रोक्तं तपोऽन्तं वेददर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: tapomūlamidaṃ sarvaṃ daivamānuṣakaṃ sukham | tapomadhyaṃ budhaiḥ proktaṃ tapo'ntaṃ vedadarśibhiḥ
verses.translation: All the bliss of gods and men is declared by the sages to whom the Veda was revealed, to have austerity for its root, austerity for its middle, and austerity for its end.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्य तपो ज्ञानं तपः क्षत्रस्य रक्षणम् । वैश्यस्य तु तपो वार्ता तपः शूद्रस्य सेवनम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇasya tapo jñānaṃ tapaḥ kṣatrasya rakṣaṇam | vaiśyasya tu tapo vārtā tapaḥ śūdrasya sevanam
verses.translation: (The pursuit of sacred) knowledge is the austerity of a Brahmana, protecting (the people) is the austerity of a Kshatriya, (the pursuit of) his daily business is the austerity of a Vaisya, and service the austerity of a Sudra.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयः संयतात्मानः फलमूलानिलाशनाः । तपसैव प्रपश्यन्ति त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ saṃyatātmānaḥ phalamūlānilāśanāḥ | tapasaiva prapaśyanti trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: The sages who control themselves and subsist on fruit, roots, and air, survey the three worlds together with their moving and immovable (creatures) through their austerities alone.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: औषधान्यगदो विद्या दैवी च विविधा स्थितिः । तपसैव प्रसिध्यन्ति तपस्तेषां हि साधनम्
verses.transliteration: auṣadhānyagado vidyā daivī ca vividhā sthitiḥ | tapasaiva prasidhyanti tapasteṣāṃ hi sādhanam
verses.translation: Medicines, good health, learning, and the various divine stations are attained by austerities alone; for austerity is the means of gaining them.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्दुस्तरं यद्दुरापं यद्दुर्गं यच्च दुष्करम् । सर्वं तु तपसा साध्यं तपो हि दुरतिक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: yaddustaraṃ yaddurāpaṃ yaddurgaṃ yacca duṣkaram | sarvaṃ tu tapasā sādhyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam
verses.translation: Whatever is hard to be traversed, whatever is hard to be attained, whatever is hard to be reached, whatever is hard to be performed, all (this) may be accomplished by austerities; for austerity (possesses a power) which it is difficult to surpass.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं तत्तपसा महापातकिनश्चैव शेषाश्चाकार्यकारिणः । तपसैव सुतप्तेन मुच्यन्ते किल्बिषात्ततः
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ tattapasā mahāpātakinaścaiva śeṣāścākāryakāriṇaḥ | tapasaiva sutaptena mucyante kilbiṣāttataḥ
verses.translation: Both those who have committed mortal sin (Mahapataka) and all other offenders are severally freed from their guilt by means of well-performed austerities.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कीटाश्चाहिपतङ्गाश्च पशवश्च वयांसि च । स्थावराणि च भूतानि दिवं यान्ति तपोबलात्
verses.transliteration: kīṭāścāhipataṅgāśca paśavaśca vayāṃsi ca | sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni divaṃ yānti tapobalāt
verses.translation: Insects, snakes, moths, bees, birds and beings, bereft of motion, reach heaven by the power of austerities.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्किं चिदेनः कुर्वन्ति मनोवाङ्मूर्तिभिर्जनाः । मनोवाच्।कर्मभिर् तत्सर्वं निर्दहन्त्याशु तपसैव तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: yatkiṃ cidenaḥ kurvanti manovāṅmūrtibhirjanāḥ | manovāc|karmabhir tatsarvaṃ nirdahantyāśu tapasaiva tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: Whatever sin men commit by thoughts, words, or deeds, that they speedily burn away by penance, if they keep penance as their only riches.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तपसैव विशुद्धस्य ब्राह्मणस्य दिवौकसः । इज्याश्च प्रतिगृह्णन्ति कामान् संवर्धयन्ति च
verses.transliteration: tapasaiva viśuddhasya brāhmaṇasya divaukasaḥ | ijyāśca pratigṛhṇanti kāmān saṃvardhayanti ca
verses.translation: The gods accept the offerings of that Brahmana alone who has purified himself by austerities, and grant to him all he desires.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिरिदं शास्त्रं तपसैवासृजत्प्रभुः । तथैव वेदान् ऋषयस्तपसा प्रतिपेदिरे
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiridaṃ śāstraṃ tapasaivāsṛjatprabhuḥ | tathaiva vedān ṛṣayastapasā pratipedire
verses.translation: The lord, Pragapati, created these Institutes (of the sacred law) by his austerities alone; the sages likewise obtained (the revelation of) the Vedas through their austerities.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत्तपसो देवा महाभाग्यं प्रचक्षते । यदेतत्तपसो सर्वस्यास्य प्रपश्यन्तस्तपसः पुण्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ityetattapaso devā mahābhāgyaṃ pracakṣate | yadetattapaso sarvasyāsya prapaśyantastapasaḥ puṇyamuttamam
verses.translation: The gods, discerning that the holy origin of this whole (world) is from austerity, have thus proclaimed the incomparable power of austerity.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यमुद्भवं वेदाभ्यासोऽन्वहं शक्त्या महायज्ञक्रिया क्षमा । नाशयन्त्याशु पापानि महापातकजान्यपि
verses.transliteration: puṇyamudbhavaṃ vedābhyāso'nvahaṃ śaktyā mahāyajñakriyā kṣamā | nāśayantyāśu pāpāni mahāpātakajānyapi
verses.translation: The daily study of the Veda, the performance of the great sacrifices according to one's ability, (and) patience (in suffering) quickly destroy all guilt, even that caused by mortal sins.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथैधस्तेजसा वह्निः प्राप्तं निर्दहति क्षणात् । तथा ज्ञानाग्निना पापं सर्वं दहति वेदवित्
verses.transliteration: yathaidhastejasā vahniḥ prāptaṃ nirdahati kṣaṇāt | tathā jñānāgninā pāpaṃ sarvaṃ dahati vedavit
verses.translation: As a fire in one moment consumes with its bright flame the fuel that has been placed on it, even so he who knows the Veda destroys all guilt by the fire of knowledge.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतदेनसामुक्तं प्रायश्चित्तं यथाविधि । अत ऊर्ध्वं रहस्यानां प्रायश्चित्तं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: ityetadenasāmuktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhi | ata ūrdhvaṃ rahasyānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: The penances for sins (made public) have been thus declared according to the law; learn next the penances for secret (sins).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सव्याहृतिप्रणवकाः प्राणायामास्तु षोडश । अपि भ्रूणहनं मासात्पुनन्त्यहरहः कृताः
verses.transliteration: savyāhṛtipraṇavakāḥ prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa | api bhrūṇahanaṃ māsātpunantyaharahaḥ kṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Sixteen suppressions of the breath (Pranayama) accompanied by (the recitation of) the Vyahritis and of the syllable Om, purify, if they are repeated daily, after a month even the murderer of a learned Brahmana.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कौत्सं जप्त्वाऽप इत्येतद्वसिष्ठं च प्रतीत्यृचम् । माहित्रं शुद्धवत्यश्च सुरापोऽपि विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: kautsaṃ japtvā'pa ityetadvasiṣṭhaṃ ca pratītyṛcam | māhitraṃ śuddhavatyaśca surāpo'pi viśudhyati
verses.translation: Even a drinker of (the spirituous liquor called) Sura becomes pure, if he mutters the hymn (seen) by Kutsa, 'Removing by thy splendour our guilt, O Agni,' &c., (that seen) by Vasishtha, 'With their hymns the Vasishthas woke the Dawn,' &c., the Mahitra (hymn) and (the verses called) Suddhavatis.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सकृत्जप्त्वाऽस्यवामीयं शिवसङ्कल्पमेव च । अपहृत्य सुवर्णं तु क्षणाद्भवति निर्मलः
verses.transliteration: sakṛtjaptvā'syavāmīyaṃ śivasaṅkalpameva ca | apahṛtya suvarṇaṃ tu kṣaṇādbhavati nirmalaḥ
verses.translation: Even he who has stolen gold, instantly becomes free from guilt, if he once mutters (the hymn beginning with the words) 'The middlemost brother of this beautiful, ancient Hotri-priest' and the Sivasamkalpa.
verses.wordMeaning: Even a drinker of (the spirituous liquor called) Sura becomes pure, if he mutters the hymn (seen) by Kutsa, 'Removing by thy splendour our guilt, O Agni,' &c., (that seen) by Vasishtha, 'With their hymns the Vasishthas woke the Dawn,' &c.,…
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हविष्पान्तीयमभ्यस्य न तमं ह इतीति च । जपित्वा पौरुषं सूक्तं मुच्यते गुरुतल्पगः
verses.transliteration: haviṣpāntīyamabhyasya na tamaṃ ha itīti ca | japitvā pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ mucyate gurutalpagaḥ
verses.translation: The violator of a Guru's bed is freed (from sin), if he repeatedly recites the Havishpantiya (hymn), (that beginning) 'Neither anxiety nor misfortune,' (and that beginning) 'Thus, verily, thus,' and mutters the hymn addressed to Purusha.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एनसां स्थूलसूक्ष्माणां चिकीर्षन्नपनोदनम् । अवेत्यृचं जपेदब्दं यत्किञ्चेदमितीति वा
verses.transliteration: enasāṃ sthūlasūkṣmāṇāṃ cikīrṣannapanodanam | avetyṛcaṃ japedabdaṃ yatkiñcedamitīti vā
verses.translation: He who desires to expiate sins great or small, must mutter during a year the Rit-verse 'May we remove thy anger, O Varuna,' &c., or 'Whatever offence here, O Varuna,' &c.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्याप्रतिग्राह्यं भुक्त्वा चान्नं विगर्हितम् । जपंस्तरत्समन्दीयं पूयते मानवस्त्र्यहात्
verses.transliteration: pratigṛhyāpratigrāhyaṃ bhuktvā cānnaṃ vigarhitam | japaṃstaratsamandīyaṃ pūyate mānavastryahāt
verses.translation: That man who, having accepted presents which ought not to be accepted, or having eaten forbidden food, mutters the Taratsamandiya (Rikas), becomes pure after three days.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोमारौद्रं तु बह्वेनाः मासमभ्यस्य शुध्यति । समामभ्यस्य) स्रवन्त्यामाचरन् स्नानमर्यम्णामिति च तृचम्
verses.transliteration: somāraudraṃ tu bahvenāḥ māsamabhyasya śudhyati | samāmabhyasya) sravantyāmācaran snānamaryamṇāmiti ca tṛcam
verses.translation: But he who has committed many sins, becomes pure, if he recites during a month the (four verses) addressed to Soma and Rudra, and the three verses (beginning) 'Aryaman, Varuna, and Mitra,' while he bathes in a river.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अब्दार्धमिन्द्रमित्येतदेनस्वी सप्तकं जपेत् । अप्रशस्तं तु कृत्वाऽप्सु मासमासीत भैक्षभुक्
verses.transliteration: abdārdhamindramityetadenasvī saptakaṃ japet | apraśastaṃ tu kṛtvā'psu māsamāsīta bhaikṣabhuk
verses.translation: A grievous offender shall mutter the seven verses (beginning with) 'Indra,' for half a year; but he who has committed any blamable act in water, shall subsist during a month on food obtained by begging.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रैः शाकलहोमीयैरब्दं हुत्वा घृतं द्विजः । सुगुर्वप्यपहन्त्येनो जप्त्वा वा नम इत्यृचम्
verses.transliteration: mantraiḥ śākalahomīyairabdaṃ hutvā ghṛtaṃ dvijaḥ | sugurvapyapahantyeno japtvā vā nama ityṛcam
verses.translation: A twice-born man removes even very great guilt by offering clarified butter with the sacred texts belonging to the Sakala-homas, or by muttering the Rik, (beginning) 'Adoration.'
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: महापातकसंयुक्तोऽनुगच्छेद्गाः समाहितः । अभ्यस्याब्दं पावमानीर्भैक्षाहारो विशुध्यति
verses.transliteration: mahāpātakasaṃyukto'nugacchedgāḥ samāhitaḥ | abhyasyābdaṃ pāvamānīrbhaikṣāhāro viśudhyati
verses.translation: He who is stained by mortal sin, becomes pure, if, with a concentrated mind, he attends cows for a year, reciting the Pavamani (hymns) and subsisting on alms.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अरण्ये वा त्रिरभ्यस्य प्रयतो वेदसंहिताम् । मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैः पराकैः शोधितस्त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: araṇye vā trirabhyasya prayato vedasaṃhitām | mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ parākaiḥ śodhitastribhiḥ
verses.translation: Or if, pure (in mind and in body), he thrice repeats the Samhita of the Veda in a forest, sanctified by three Paraka (penances), he is freed from all crimes causing loss of caste (pataka).
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यहं तूपवसेद्युक्तस्त्रिरह्नोऽभ्युपयन्नपः । मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैस्त्रिर्जपित्वाऽघमर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tryahaṃ tūpavasedyuktastrirahno'bhyupayannapaḥ | mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaistrirjapitvā'ghamarṣaṇam
verses.translation: But if (a man) fasts during three days, bathing thrice a day, and muttering (in the water the hymn seen by) Aghamarshana, he is (likewise) freed from all sins causing loss of caste.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथाऽश्वमेधः क्रतुराट् सर्वपापापनोदनः । तथाऽघमर्षणं सूक्तं सर्वपापापनोदनम्
verses.transliteration: yathā'śvamedhaḥ kraturāṭ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ | tathā'ghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam
verses.translation: As the horse-sacrifice, the king of sacrifices, removes all sin, even so the Aghamarshana hymn effaces all guilt.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा लोकानपीमांस्त्रीनश्नन्नपि यतस्ततः । ऋग्वेदं धारयन् विप्रो नैनः प्राप्नोति किं चन
verses.transliteration: hatvā lokānapīmāṃstrīnaśnannapi yatastataḥ | ṛgvedaṃ dhārayan vipro nainaḥ prāpnoti kiṃ cana
verses.translation: A Brahmana who retains in his memory the Rig-veda is not stained by guilt, though he may have destroyed these three worlds, though he may eat the food of anybody.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्संहितां त्रिरभ्यस्य यजुषां वा समाहितः । साम्नां वा सरहस्यानां सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ṛksaṃhitāṃ trirabhyasya yajuṣāṃ vā samāhitaḥ | sāmnāṃ vā sarahasyānāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: He who, with a concentrated mind, thrice recites the Riksamhita, or (that of the) Yagur-veda; or (that of the) Sama-veda together with the secret (texts, the Upanishads), is completely freed from all sins.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यथा महाह्रदं प्राप्य क्षिप्तं लोष्टं विनश्यति । तथा दुश्चरितं सर्वं वेदे त्रिवृति मज्जति
verses.transliteration: yathā mahāhradaṃ prāpya kṣiptaṃ loṣṭaṃ vinaśyati | tathā duścaritaṃ sarvaṃ vede trivṛti majjati
verses.translation: As a clod of earth, falling into a great lake, is quickly dissolved, even so every sinful act is engulfed in the threefold Veda.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: ऋचो यजूंषि चान्यानि सामानि विविधानि च । एष ज्ञेयस्त्रिवृद्वेदो यो वेदैनं स वेदवित्
verses.transliteration: ṛco yajūṃṣi cānyāni sāmāni vividhāni ca | eṣa jñeyastrivṛdvedo yo vedainaṃ sa vedavit
verses.translation: The Rikas, the Yagus (-formulas) which differ (from the former), the manifold Saman (-songs), must be known (to form) the triple Veda; he who knows them, (is called) learned in the Veda.
verses.hindi: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: आद्यं यत्त्र्यक्षरं ब्रह्म त्रयी यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठिता । स गुह्योऽन्यस्त्रिवृद्वेदो यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्
verses.transliteration: ādyaṃ yattryakṣaraṃ brahma trayī yasmin pratiṣṭhitā | sa guhyo'nyastrivṛdvedo yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
verses.hindi: जो आदि में स्थित तीन अक्षरों वाला ब्रह्म (ॐ) है, जिसमें तीनों वेद प्रतिष्ठित हैं, वह दूसरा, गुप्त त्रिविध वेद है; जो उसे जानता है वही वेद का ज्ञाता है।
verses.science: परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्थतम। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।
verses.translation: The primal syllable of three sounds, Om, in which the triple Veda is founded, is another, secret triple Veda; he who knows it truly knows the Veda.

verses.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य कृत्स्नोऽयमुक्तो धर्मस्त्वयाऽनघः । कर्मणां फलनिर्वृत्तिं शंस नस्तत्त्वतः पराम्
verses.transliteration: cāturvarṇyasya kṛtsno'yamukto dharmastvayā'naghaḥ | karmaṇāṃ phalanirvṛttiṃ śaṃsa nastattvataḥ parām
verses.translation: 'O sinless One, the whole sacred law, (applicable) to the four castes, has been declared by thee; communicate to us (now), according to the truth, the ultimate retribution for (their) deeds.'
verses.hindi: करोति तु कमाणि स झतास्मोच्यते वेः ॥' १२ ॥
verses.commentary: Sense: 'O sinless One, the whole sacred law, (applicable) to the four castes, has been declared by thee; communicate to us (now), according to the truth, the ultimate retribution for (their) deeds.'
verses.science: करोति तु कमाणि स झतास्मोच्यते वेः ॥' १२ ॥। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: स तानुवाच धर्मात्मा महर्षीन् मानवो भृगुः । अस्य सर्वस्य शृणुत कर्मयोगस्य निर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: sa tānuvāca dharmātmā maharṣīn mānavo bhṛguḥ | asya sarvasya śṛṇuta karmayogasya nirṇayam
verses.translation: To the great sages (who addressed him thus) righteous Bhrigu, sprung from Manu, answered, 'Hear the decision concerning this whole connexion with actions.'
verses.commentary: Sense: To the great sages (who addressed him thus) righteous Bhrigu, sprung from Manu, answered, 'Hear the decision concerning this whole connexion with actions.'
verses.hindi: तावुभौ भतसंएको सहान क्षेत्रज्ञ एव च। ...  मजुप्य मन से किए शुमाछभ कर्मफल को मत से ही; वांशी से किये, वाशी ही और शरोर से किण कर्म का. शरीर सही फ़ल-भो- गता है। मनुष्य शारीरक कर्मदोषां: से वृक्षादियोनि, घाणी के
verses.science: तावुभौ भतसंएको सहान क्षेत्रज्ञ एव च। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शुभाशुभफलं कर्म मनोवाग्देहसम्भवम् । कर्मजा गतयो नॄणामुत्तमाधममध्यमः
verses.transliteration: śubhāśubhaphalaṃ karma manovāgdehasambhavam | karmajā gatayo nṝṇāmuttamādhamamadhyamaḥ
verses.translation: Action, which springs from the mind, from speech, and from the body, produces either good or evil results; by action are caused the (various) conditions of men, the highest, the middling, and the lowest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Action, which springs from the mind, from speech, and from the body, produces either good or evil results; by action are caused the (various) conditions of men, the highest, the middling, and the lowest.
verses.hindi: यादेः तु:आयशो धर्म सेवते घमेसल्पशःव-- . £5: 47 यामीस्ता-यातना आंप्य से जीवो -वीतकल्संषः.।.. .. - होते हैँ। जो. उत्तमःअधम, भाणियो से निरन्तर-कमे. कते (हि... पापीमडणको का-शरीर- यमयातना क्षे लिए, "दूसरा ..सझ्म-पञ्चतः ,
verses.science: यादेः तु:आयशो धर्म सेवते घमेसल्पशःव-- . £5: 47 यामीस्ता-यातना आंप्य से जीवो -वीतकल्संषः.। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैह त्रिविधस्यापि त्र्यधिष्ठानस्य देहिनः । दशलक्षणयुक्तस्य मनो विद्यात्प्रवर्तकम्
verses.transliteration: tasyaiha trividhasyāpi tryadhiṣṭhānasya dehinaḥ | daśalakṣaṇayuktasya mano vidyātpravartakam
verses.translation: Know that the mind is the instigator here below, even to that (action) which is connected with the body, (and) which is of three kinds, has three locations, and falls under ten heads.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know that the mind is the instigator here below, even to that (action) which is connected with the body, (and) which is of three kinds, has three locations, and falls under ten heads.
verses.hindi: यत्तु हुःखसमायुक्गमप्रीतिकरमा्मनः।
verses.science: यत्तु हुःखसमायुक्गमप्रीतिकरमा्मनः। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: परद्रव्येष्वभिध्यानं मनसाऽनिष्टचिन्तनम् । वितथाभिनिवेशश्च त्रिविधं कर्म मानसम्
verses.transliteration: paradravyeṣvabhidhyānaṃ manasā'niṣṭacintanam | vitathābhiniveśaśca trividhaṃ karma mānasam
verses.translation: Coveting the property of others, thinking in one's heart of what is undesirable, and adherence to false (doctrines), are the three kinds of (sinful) mental action.
verses.commentary: Sense: Coveting the property of others, thinking in one's heart of what is undesirable, and adherence to false (doctrines), are the three kinds of (sinful) mental action.
verses.hindi: मन से विचार करके पुरुष की सदा धर्म में मर टिकांना चा हिप। सत्य, :रज आरे तम ये तीनों आत्मा: प्रकति के गुणे हि : में जो गुण जव देह मै अधिक होता है तव, उस माजा को. पने भाव का कर डालवा हे। वस्ठे कोःघार्स्तविके झन सल
verses.science: मन से विचार करके पुरुष की सदा धर्म में मर टिकांना चा हिप। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: पारुष्यमनृतं चैव पैशुन्यं चापि सर्वशः । असम्बद्धप्रलापश्च वाङ्मयं स्याच्चतुर्विधम्
verses.transliteration: pāruṣyamanṛtaṃ caiva paiśunyaṃ cāpi sarvaśaḥ | asambaddhapralāpaśca vāṅmayaṃ syāccaturvidham
verses.translation: Abusing (others, speaking) untruth, detracting from the merits of all men, and talking idly, shall be the four kinds of (evil) verbal action.
verses.commentary: Sense: Abusing (others, speaking) untruth, detracting from the merits of all men, and talking idly, shall be the four kinds of (evil) verbal action.
verses.hindi: में रुचि होना, दि बै सुण के काम हैं। आरम्भ में रुचि होना, फिर धेय, बुरे कासा में फॅसना और विषयः भाग ये रजोगुण के काम हैं । लोभ, नींद, अधीरता, करता, नास्तिकता, अनाचार, मांगने को आदत और भमाद ये तमो-
verses.science: में रुचि होना, दि बै सुण के काम हैं। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: अदत्तानामुपादानं हिंसा चैवाविधानतः । परदारोपसेवा च शारीरं त्रिविधं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: adattānāmupādānaṃ hiṃsā caivāvidhānataḥ | paradāropasevā ca śārīraṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Taking what has not been given, injuring (creatures) without the sanction of the law, and holding criminal intercourse with another man's wife, are declared to be the three kinds of (wicked) bodily action.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking what has not been given, injuring (creatures) without the sanction of the law, and holding criminal intercourse with another man's wife, are declared to be the three kinds of (wicked) bodily action.
verses.hindi: त्रिविधा त्रिविधैषा तु विज्ञेया गोणिकी गातः।
verses.science: त्रिविधा त्रिविधैषा तु विज्ञेया गोणिकी गातः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: मानसं मनसेवायमुपभुङ्क्ते शुभाशुभम् । वाचा वाचा कृतं कर्म कायेनेव च कायिकम्
verses.transliteration: mānasaṃ manasevāyamupabhuṅkte śubhāśubham | vācā vācā kṛtaṃ karma kāyeneva ca kāyikam
verses.translation: (A man) obtains (the result of) a good or evil mental (act) in his mind, (that of) a verbal (act) in his speech, (that of) a bodily (act) in his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: (A man) obtains (the result of) a good or evil mental (act) in his mind, (that of) a verbal (act) in his speech, (that of) a bodily (act) in his body.
verses.hindi: इन-गुणों में जिस शुण से जीव जिन जिन गरियो कोपाहा ' साव, रजोगुणी मचुष्यत्व और तमोगुणी पक्षीपनको पाते है“ ० यह तीस प्रकार की गति है । सत्त्व, रज और .तम इन तीन यणो" " खे होनेवाली मति, कम और विद्या के अनुसार; उत्तम-मध्यम-्झ-. .
verses.science: इन-गुणों में जिस शुण से जीव जिन जिन गरियो कोपाहा ' साव, रजोगुणी मचुष्यत्व और तमोगुणी पक्षीपनको पाते है“ ० यह तीस प्रकार की गति है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: शरीरजैः कर्मदोषैर्याति स्थावरतां नरः । वाचिकैः पक्षिमृगतां मानसैरन्त्यजातिताम्
verses.transliteration: śarīrajaiḥ karmadoṣairyāti sthāvaratāṃ naraḥ | vācikaiḥ pakṣimṛgatāṃ mānasairantyajātitām
verses.translation: In consequence of (many) sinful acts committed with his body, a man becomes (in the next birth) something inanimate, in consequence (of sins) committed by speech, a bird, or a beast, and in consequence of mental (sins he is re-born in) a low caste.
verses.commentary: Sense: In consequence of (many) sinful acts committed with his body, a man becomes (in the next birth) something inanimate, in consequence (of sins) committed by speech, a bird, or a beast, and in consequence of mental (sins he is re-born in) a low caste.
verses.hindi: पायान् संयान्ति संसारानविद्वांसो नराधमाः ॥ ५२.॥ यां यां योनिं तु जीवोऽयं येन येनेह कर्मणा ।
verses.science: पायान् संयान्ति संसारानविद्वांसो नराधमाः ॥ ५२.॥ यां यां योनिं तु जीवोऽयं येन येनेह कर्मणा। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: वाग्दण्डोऽथ मनोदण्डः कायदण्डस्तथैव च । यस्यैते निहिता बुद्धौ त्रिदण्डीति स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: vāgdaṇḍo'tha manodaṇḍaḥ kāyadaṇḍastathaiva ca | yasyaite nihitā buddhau tridaṇḍīti sa ucyate
verses.translation: That man is called a (true) tridandin in whose mind these three, the control over his speech (vagdanda), the control over his thoughts (manodanda), and the control over his body (kayadanda), are firmly fixed.
verses.hindi: तावुभौ भतसंएको सहान क्षेत्रज्ञ एव च। ...  मजुप्य मन से किए शुमाछभ कर्मफल को मत से ही; वांशी से किये, वाशी ही और शरोर से किण कर्म का. शरीर सही फ़ल-भो- गता है। मनुष्य शारीरक कर्मदोषां: से वृक्षादियोनि, घाणी के
verses.commentary: Sense: That man is called a (true) tridandin in whose mind these three, the control over his speech (vagdanda), the control over his thoughts (manodanda), and the control over his body (kayadanda), are firmly fixed.
verses.science: तावुभौ भतसंएको सहान क्षेत्रज्ञ एव च। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रिदण्डमेतन्निक्षिप्य सर्वभूतेषु मानवः । कामक्रोधौ तु संयम्य ततः सिद्धिं नियच्छति
verses.transliteration: tridaṇḍametannikṣipya sarvabhūteṣu mānavaḥ | kāmakrodhau tu saṃyamya tataḥ siddhiṃ niyacchati
verses.translation: That man who keeps this threefold control (over himself) with respect to all created beings and wholly subdues desire and wrath, thereby assuredly gains complete success.
verses.hindi: वको सवति हलाग्नि एहकारी झुपस्करम्।  करानि हृत्वा वासांसि जायते जीवजीवकः
verses.commentary: Sense: That man who keeps this threefold control (over himself) with respect to all created beings and wholly subdues desire and wrath, thereby assuredly gains complete success.
verses.science: वको सवति हलाग्नि एहकारी झुपस्करम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: कामक्रोधौ सुसंयम्य ततः सिद्धिं निगच्छति योऽस्यात्मनः कारयिता तं क्षेत्रज्ञं प्रचक्षते । यः करोति तु कर्माणि स भूतात्मोच्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration: kāmakrodhau susaṃyamya tataḥ siddhiṃ nigacchati yo'syātmanaḥ kārayitā taṃ kṣetrajñaṃ pracakṣate | yaḥ karoti tu karmāṇi sa bhūtātmocyate budhaiḥ
verses.translation: Him who impels this (corporeal) Self to action, they call the Kshetragna (the knower of the field); but him who does the acts, the wise name the Bhutatman (the Self consisting of the elements).
verses.hindi: यथा जातवलो वहिदेहत्याद्रानापि हुमान्। तथा दहति वेदः कर्मजं दोषमात्मनः
verses.commentary: Sense: Him who impels this (corporeal) Self to action, they call the Kshetragna (the knower of the field); but him who does the acts, the wise name the Bhutatman (the Self consisting of the elements).
verses.science: यथा जातवलो वहिदेहत्याद्रानापि हुमान्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: जीवसंज्ञोऽन्तरात्माऽन्यः सहजः सर्वदेहिनाम् । येन वेदयते सर्वं सुखं दुःखं च जन्मसु
verses.transliteration: jīvasaṃjño'ntarātmā'nyaḥ sahajaḥ sarvadehinām | yena vedayate sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca janmasu
verses.translation: Another internal Self that is generated with all embodied (Kshetragnas) is called Giva, through which (the Kshetragna) becomes sensible of all pleasure and pain in (successive) births.
verses.hindi: शुभ फर्मों का फल देनेवाला है । ज्ञानी पुरुष बाहरी आकाश को में, सूर्य को नेत्र मे,- जल को -शरीर के चिकने पदार्थों मे, पृथिवी को शरीर में, चन्द्रमा को मन में, दिशाओं को ओज मे, विष्यु भगवान् को गति में; शिव को वल में, अग्नि को घाणी मै, मित्र
verses.commentary: Sense: Another internal Self that is generated with all embodied (Kshetragnas) is called Giva, through which (the Kshetragna) becomes sensible of all pleasure and pain in (successive) births.
verses.science: शुभ फर्मों का फल देनेवाला है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: तावुभौ भूतसम्पृक्तौ महान् क्षेत्रज्ञ एव च । उच्चावचेषु भूतेषु स्थितं तं व्याप्य तिष्ठतः
verses.transliteration: tāvubhau bhūtasampṛktau mahān kṣetrajña eva ca | uccāvaceṣu bhūteṣu sthitaṃ taṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: These two, the Great One and the Kshetragna, who are closely united with the elements, pervade him who resides in the multiform created beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: These two, the Great One and the Kshetragna, who are closely united with the elements, pervade him who resides in the multiform created beings.
verses.hindi: वृको शृगेसं व्याघ्ोऽरवं फलसूल तु लकर । है
verses.science: वृको शृगेसं व्याघ्ोऽरवं फलसूल तु लकर। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: असङ्ख्या मूर्तयस्तस्य निष्पतन्ति शरीरतः । उच्चावचानि भूतानि सततं चेष्टयन्ति याः
verses.transliteration: asaṅkhyā mūrtayastasya niṣpatanti śarīrataḥ | uccāvacāni bhūtāni satataṃ ceṣṭayanti yāḥ
verses.translation: From his body innumerable forms go forth, which constantly impel the multiform creatures to action.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his body innumerable forms go forth, which constantly impel the multiform creatures to action.
verses.hindi: माल चुराने से गीध, चरवी" चुराने से जलकाक, तेल की... चोरी से. तैलपक पक्षी, लोन चुराने से झौगुर और: दही की. चोरी से वलाका पक्षी होता हे। रेशम चुराने, से तीतर, अलसी: के कपड़ों की चोरी से मेंढक, कपास वसर: चुराने से सारख; ..
verses.science: माल चुराने से गीध, चरवी" चुराने से जलकाक, तेल की... चोरी से. तैलपक पक्षी, लोन चुराने से झौगुर और: दही की. चोरी से वलाका पक्षी होता हे। प्रकाश, जल और ताप एक ही प्राकृतिक चक्र के रूप हैं। यह पंक्ति उन रूपों को एक व्यवस्था के अंग की तरह पढ़ती है।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चभ्य एव मात्राभ्यः प्रेत्य दुष्कृतिनां नृणाम् । पञ्चभ्य एव भूतेभ्यः शरीरं यातनार्थीयमन्यदुत्पद्यते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: pañcabhya eva mātrābhyaḥ pretya duṣkṛtināṃ nṛṇām | pañcabhya eva bhūtebhyaḥ śarīraṃ yātanārthīyamanyadutpadyate dhruvam
verses.translation: Another strong body, formed of particles (of the) five (elements and) destined to suffer the torments (in hell), is produced after death (in the case) of wicked men.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another strong body, formed of particles (of the) five (elements and) destined to suffer the torments (in hell), is produced after death (in the case) of wicked men.
verses.hindi: तासिल्लादिपु चोग्रेषु नरकेषु विवतेनम् ।..
verses.science: तासिल्लादिपु चोग्रेषु नरकेषु विवतेनम्। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: तेनानुभूय ता यामीः शरीरेणैह यातनाः । तास्वेव भूतमात्रासु प्रलीयन्ते विभागशः
verses.transliteration: tenānubhūya tā yāmīḥ śarīreṇaiha yātanāḥ | tāsveva bhūtamātrāsu pralīyante vibhāgaśaḥ
verses.translation: When (the evil-doers) by means of that body have suffered there the torments imposed by Yama, (its constituent parts) are united, each according to its class, with those very elements (from which they were taken).
verses.commentary: Sense: When (the evil-doers) by means of that body have suffered there the torments imposed by Yama, (its constituent parts) are united, each according to its class, with those very elements (from which they were taken).
verses.hindi: ' है और शद चेलाशक मेत होकर, कपड़े की जूँ खाता है । वि- , चयासक्क पुरुप जैसे जैसे विषयों का सेवन करते है, पैसे पैसे . उनमें उनकी कुशलता हो जाती है वे निर्दमुेद्धि उन पाप कमों के यार यार करने से यहां अनेक योनियो में जन्म लेकर दुःख
verses.science: ' है और शद चेलाशक मेत होकर, कपड़े की जूँ खाता है। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सोऽनुभूयासुखोदर्कान् दोषान् विषयसङ्गजान् । व्यपेतकल्मषोऽभ्येति तावेवोभौ महौजसौ
verses.transliteration: so'nubhūyāsukhodarkān doṣān viṣayasaṅgajān | vyapetakalmaṣo'bhyeti tāvevobhau mahaujasau
verses.translation: He, having suffered for his faults, which are produced by attachment to sensual objects, and which result in misery, approaches, free from stains, those two mighty ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: He, having suffered for his faults, which are produced by attachment to sensual objects, and which result in misery, approaches, free from stains, those two mighty ones.
verses.hindi: यादृशेन त भावेन: यद्यत्कर्म निषेवते । नैश्वेयलकर कसे विन्रस्येदं  निवोघतं
verses.science: यादृशेन त भावेन: यद्यत्कर्म निषेवते। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तौ धर्मं पश्यतस्तस्य पापं चातन्द्रितौ सह । याभ्यां प्राप्नोति सम्पृक्तः प्रेत्येह च सुखासुखम्
verses.transliteration: tau dharmaṃ paśyatastasya pāpaṃ cātandritau saha | yābhyāṃ prāpnoti sampṛktaḥ pretyeha ca sukhāsukham
verses.translation: Those two together examine without tiring the merit and the guilt of that (individual soul), united with which it obtains bliss or misery both in this world and the next.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those two together examine without tiring the merit and the guilt of that (individual soul), united with which it obtains bliss or misery both in this world and the next.
verses.hindi: आहिँसा गुरुसेवा च नेशश्षेयसंकर परम् ॥ ८३-॥ किचिच्छेयस्करतरं कसो पुरुष प्रति
verses.science: आहिँसा गुरुसेवा च नेशश्षेयसंकर परम् ॥ ८३-॥ किचिच्छेयस्करतरं कसो पुरुष प्रति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: यद्याचरति धर्मं स प्रायशोऽधर्ममल्पशः । यथाचरति) तैरेव चावृतो भूतैः स्वर्गे सुखमुपाश्नुते
verses.transliteration: yadyācarati dharmaṃ sa prāyaśo'dharmamalpaśaḥ | yathācarati) taireva cāvṛto bhūtaiḥ svarge sukhamupāśnute
verses.translation: If (the soul) chiefly practises virtue and vice to a small degree, it obtains bliss in heaven, clothed with those very elements.
verses.commentary: Sense: If (the soul) chiefly practises virtue and vice to a small degree, it obtains bliss in heaven, clothed with those very elements.
verses.hindi: « वान्धवो का वियोग, छुजेनों का सहवास, दुःख से घन पाना;  घन का नाश, कठिनता से मित्र पांना ओर शत्रुओं ले वेर भाव... होता है  जिसका उपाय न हो सके ऐसा बुढ़ापा आता है, ' : व्यांधिया से कष्ट, चानामरंकार के हुःख और दुजेय मरण होता.
verses.science: « वान्धवो का वियोग, छुजेनों का सहवास, दुःख से घन पाना; घन का नाश, कठिनता से मित्र पांना ओर शत्रुओं ले वेर भाव... होता है जिसका उपाय न हो सके ऐसा बुढ़ापा आता…। दोहराया हुआ स्वर श्वास और अवधान को एक लय में लाता है। यहाँ शब्द केवल सूचना नहीं, साधना का साधन है।

verses.sanskrit: यदि तु प्रायशोऽधर्मं सेवते धर्ममल्पशः । तैर्भूतैः स परित्यक्तो यामीः प्राप्नोति यातनाः
verses.transliteration: yadi tu prāyaśo'dharmaṃ sevate dharmamalpaśaḥ | tairbhūtaiḥ sa parityakto yāmīḥ prāpnoti yātanāḥ
verses.translation: But if it chiefly cleaves to vice and to virtue in a small degree, it suffers, deserted by the elements, the torments inflicted by Yama.
verses.commentary: Sense: But if it chiefly cleaves to vice and to virtue in a small degree, it suffers, deserted by the elements, the torments inflicted by Yama.
verses.hindi: वैदिक कमो में अपर कही सब क्रियाओं का अन्तर्भाव होता देक कर्म होते हँ । इसलोक के आर परलोक के सुख की कामना नेचूक्त कहलाता है  प्रचुत्त कमे के करने से देवताओं की समता र निदृत्त कसे करने से पञ्चसूतो को उलांघ कर मोक्ष
verses.science: वैदिक कमो में अपर कही सब क्रियाओं का अन्तर्भाव होता देक कर्म होते हँ। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यामीस्ता यातनाः प्राप्य स जीवो वीतकल्मषः । तान्येव पञ्च भूतानि पुनरप्येति भागशः
verses.transliteration: yāmīstā yātanāḥ prāpya sa jīvo vītakalmaṣaḥ | tānyeva pañca bhūtāni punarapyeti bhāgaśaḥ
verses.translation: The individual soul, having endured those torments of Yama, again enters, free from taint, those very five elements, each in due proportion.
verses.commentary: Sense: The individual soul, having endured those torments of Yama, again enters, free from taint, those very five elements, each in due proportion.
verses.hindi: वेदादेद सूयन्ते प्रसूतिगुशकर्सतः
verses.science: वेदादेद सूयन्ते प्रसूतिगुशकर्सतः। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: एता दृष्ट्वाऽस्य जीवस्य गतीः स्वेनैव चेतसा । धर्मतोऽधर्मतश्चैव धर्मे दध्यात्सदा मनः
verses.transliteration: etā dṛṣṭvā'sya jīvasya gatīḥ svenaiva cetasā | dharmato'dharmataścaiva dharme dadhyātsadā manaḥ
verses.translation: Let (man), having recognised even by means of his intellect these transitions of the individual soul (which depend) on merit and demerit, always fix his heart on (the acquisition of) merit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let (man), having recognised even by means of his intellect these transitions of the individual soul (which depend) on merit and demerit, always fix his heart on (the acquisition of) merit.
verses.hindi: सर्वलोकाधिपत्यं च वेदशात्रविदहति
verses.science: सर्वलोकाधिपत्यं च वेदशात्रविदहति। इसे किसी एक घटना का संयोग न मानकर एक नियम की तरह पढ़ना इस पंक्ति का बल है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव त्रीन् विद्यादात्मनो गुणान् । यैर्व्याप्यैमान् स्थितो भावान् महान् सर्वानशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva trīn vidyādātmano guṇān | yairvyāpyaimān sthito bhāvān mahān sarvānaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Know Goodness (sattva), Activity (ragas), and Darkness (tamas) to be the three qualities of the Self, with which the Great One always completely pervades all existences.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know Goodness (sattva), Activity (ragas), and Darkness (tamas) to be the three qualities of the Self, with which the Great One always completely pervades all existences.
verses.hindi: यथा जातवलो वहिदेहत्याद्रानापि हुमान्। तथा दहति वेदः कर्मजं दोषमात्मनः
verses.science: यथा जातवलो वहिदेहत्याद्रानापि हुमान्। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यो यदेषां गुणो देहे साकल्येनातिरिच्यते । स तदा तद्गुणप्रायं तं करोति शरीरिणम्
verses.transliteration: yo yadeṣāṃ guṇo dehe sākalyenātiricyate | sa tadā tadguṇaprāyaṃ taṃ karoti śarīriṇam
verses.translation: When one of these qualities wholly predominates in a body, then it makes the embodied (soul) eminently distinguished for that quality.
verses.commentary: Sense: When one of these qualities wholly predominates in a body, then it makes the embodied (soul) eminently distinguished for that quality.
verses.hindi: सो सूति वेदमूलक नहीं हें, जो वेदिक देवन्यधादि को झूठा घतलानेवाले यन्य, उन सबको तिष्फल ओर नरकगति देनेवाले हैं और थोड़े समय मे नष्ट होजाते है । वे आधुनिक होनेसे निष्फल से हैं। सनातन वेद यज्ञादि से चराचर बिश्व का धारण और पाः
verses.science: सो सूति वेदमूलक नहीं हें, जो वेदिक देवन्यधादि को झूठा घतलानेवाले यन्य, उन सबको तिष्फल ओर नरकगति देनेवाले हैं और थोड़े समय मे नष्ट होजाते है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं ज्ञानं तमोऽज्ञानं रागद्वेषौ रजः स्मृतम् । एतद्व्याप्तिमदेतेषां सर्वभूताश्रितं वपुः
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ jñānaṃ tamo'jñānaṃ rāgadveṣau rajaḥ smṛtam | etadvyāptimadeteṣāṃ sarvabhūtāśritaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: Goodness is declared (to have the form of) knowledge, Darkness (of) ignorance, Activity (of) love and hatred; such is the nature of these (three) which is (all-) pervading and clings to everything created.
verses.commentary: Sense: Goodness is declared (to have the form of) knowledge, Darkness (of) ignorance, Activity (of) love and hatred; such is the nature of these (three) which is (all-) pervading and clings to everything created.
verses.hindi: आफ धर्मोपदेश च वेदशास्राऽविरोधिना ।  यस्तकेणानुसंधस्ते स धर्म वेद नेतरः
verses.science: आफ धर्मोपदेश च वेदशास्राऽविरोधिना। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यत्प्रीतिसंयुक्तं किं चिदात्मनि लक्षयेत् । प्रशान्तमिव शुद्धाभं सत्त्वं तदुपधारयेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kiṃ cidātmani lakṣayet | praśāntamiva śuddhābhaṃ sattvaṃ tadupadhārayet
verses.translation: When (man) experiences in his soul a (feeling) full of bliss, a deep calm, as it were, and a pure light, then let him know (that it is) among those three (the quality called) Goodness.
verses.commentary: Sense: When (man) experiences in his soul a (feeling) full of bliss, a deep calm, as it were, and a pure light, then let him know (that it is) among those three (the quality called) Goodness.
verses.hindi: नेःभ्रेयसमिदं कर्म यथोदितमशेषतः । .
verses.science: नेःभ्रेयसमिदं कर्म यथोदितमशेषतः। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्तु दुःखसमायुक्तमप्रीतिकरमात्मनः । तद्रजो प्रतीपं विद्यात्सततं हारि देहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: yattu duḥkhasamāyuktamaprītikaramātmanaḥ | tadrajo pratīpaṃ vidyātsatataṃ hāri dehinām
verses.translation: What is mixed with pain and does not give satisfaction to the soul one may know (to be the quality of) Activity, which is difficult to conquer, and which ever draws embodied (souls towards sensual objects).
verses.commentary: Sense: What is mixed with pain and does not give satisfaction to the soul one may know (to be the quality of) Activity, which is difficult to conquer, and which ever draws embodied (souls towards sensual objects).
verses.hindi: कारी है। घाण तप खे पाप नाश करता है और ब्रह्मविद्या भांति जाने। जो वेद और घर्मशासत्र का चेद् के अनुकूल तके से विचार करता है वह धर्म को जानता है, दूसरा नहीं जा- नता । इस प्रकार मोक्ष देनेवाले सघ कम कहे गये है  अब इस
verses.science: कारी है। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: हर्तृ यत्तु स्यान् मोहसंयुक्तमव्यक्तं विषयात्मकम् । अप्रतर्क्यमविज्ञेयं तमस्तदुपधारयेत्
verses.transliteration: hartṛ yattu syān mohasaṃyuktamavyaktaṃ viṣayātmakam | apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ tamastadupadhārayet
verses.translation: What is coupled with delusion, what has the character of an undiscernible mass, what cannot be fathomed by reasoning, what cannot be fully known, one must consider (as the quality of) Darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is coupled with delusion, what has the character of an undiscernible mass, what cannot be fathomed by reasoning, what cannot be fully known, one must consider (as the quality of) Darkness.
verses.hindi: उववरा परिषश्लेया धर्मसंशयानिर्णये
verses.science: उववरा परिषश्लेया धर्मसंशयानिर्णये। जो बार-बार किया जाता है, वह अगली प्रवृत्ति को मजबूत करता है। यह पंक्ति कर्म को उसी चक्र के रूप में देखती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणामपि चैतेषां गुणानां यः फलोदयः । अग्र्यो मध्यो जघन्यश्च तं प्रवक्ष्याम्यशेषतः
verses.transliteration: trayāṇāmapi caiteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ yaḥ phalodayaḥ | agryo madhyo jaghanyaśca taṃ pravakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: I will, moreover, fully describe the results which arise from these three qualities, the excellent ones, the middling ones, and the lowest.
verses.commentary: Sense: I will, moreover, fully describe the results which arise from these three qualities, the excellent ones, the middling ones, and the lowest.
verses.hindi: एतद्टोऽमिहितं सर्व निःभेयसकरं परम् एवं स भगवान् देवो लोकानां हितकाम्यया।
verses.science: एतद्टोऽमिहितं सर्व निःभेयसकरं परम् एवं स भगवान् देवो लोकानां हितकाम्यया। श्रद्धा और सुरक्षित लगाव तनाव-प्रतिक्रिया को घटाते हैं। यह पंक्ति उसी आश्रय को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: वेदाभ्यासस्तपो ज्ञानं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः । धर्मक्रियाऽत्मचिन्ता च सात्त्विकं गुणलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: vedābhyāsastapo jñānaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ | dharmakriyā'tmacintā ca sāttvikaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: The study of the Vedas, austerity, (the pursuit of) knowledge, purity, control over the organs, the performance of meritorious acts and meditation on the Soul, (are) the marks of the quality of Goodness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The study of the Vedas, austerity, (the pursuit of) knowledge, purity, control over the organs, the performance of meritorious acts and meditation on the Soul, (are) the marks of the quality of Goodness.
verses.hindi: ताना वेद का घाता वेदालुकूल शास्रेश) मौमांसादि तको का भै सन्देह पहने पर निर्रीय करने के लिए तीनों वेद के शाता, कम . से कम तीन ब्राह्मणों को अधिष्ठाचा करना चाहिए। एक भी वेद राह्मण जिसको शरम कहे उसको थमे जानि । पर दश हज्ञार मूर्खा
verses.science: ताना वेद का घाता वेदालुकूल शास्रेश) मौमांसादि तको का भै सन्देह पहने पर निर्रीय करने के लिए तीनों वेद के शाता, कम . से कम तीन ब्राह्मणों को अधिष्ठाचा करना चाहिए। देह के पदार्थ बदलते रहते हैं, पर जानने का बोध बना रहता है। यह पंक्ति उसी अंतर को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: आरम्भरुचिताऽधैर्यमसत्कार्यपरिग्रहः । विषयोपसेवा चाजस्रं राजसं गुणलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: ārambharucitā'dhairyamasatkāryaparigrahaḥ | viṣayopasevā cājasraṃ rājasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Delighting in undertakings, want of firmness, commission of sinful acts, and continual indulgence in sensual pleasures, (are) the marks of the quality of Activity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighting in undertakings, want of firmness, commission of sinful acts, and continual indulgence in sensual pleasures, (are) the marks of the quality of Activity.
verses.hindi: शुभ फर्मों का फल देनेवाला है । ज्ञानी पुरुष बाहरी आकाश को में, सूर्य को नेत्र मे,- जल को -शरीर के चिकने पदार्थों मे, पृथिवी को शरीर में, चन्द्रमा को मन में, दिशाओं को ओज मे, विष्यु भगवान् को गति में; शिव को वल में, अग्नि को घाणी मै, मित्र
verses.science: शुभ फर्मों का फल देनेवाला है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लोभः स्वप्नोऽधृतिः क्रौर्यं नास्तिक्यं भिन्नवृत्तिता । याचिष्णुता प्रमादश्च तामसं गुणलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: lobhaḥ svapno'dhṛtiḥ krauryaṃ nāstikyaṃ bhinnavṛttitā | yāciṣṇutā pramādaśca tāmasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Covetousness, sleepiness, pusillanimity, cruelty, atheism, leading an evil life, a habit of soliciting favours, and inattentiveness, are the marks of the quality of Darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Covetousness, sleepiness, pusillanimity, cruelty, atheism, leading an evil life, a habit of soliciting favours, and inattentiveness, are the marks of the quality of Darkness.
verses.hindi: शुभ फर्मों का फल देनेवाला है । ज्ञानी पुरुष बाहरी आकाश को में, सूर्य को नेत्र मे,- जल को -शरीर के चिकने पदार्थों मे, पृथिवी को शरीर में, चन्द्रमा को मन में, दिशाओं को ओज मे, विष्यु भगवान् को गति में; शिव को वल में, अग्नि को घाणी मै, मित्र
verses.science: शुभ फर्मों का फल देनेवाला है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणामपि चैतेषां गुणानां त्रिषु तिष्ठताम् । इदं सामासिकं ज्ञेयं क्रमशो गुणलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: trayāṇāmapi caiteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ triṣu tiṣṭhatām | idaṃ sāmāsikaṃ jñeyaṃ kramaśo guṇalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Know, moreover, the following to be a brief description of the three qualities, each in its order, as they appear in the three (times, the present, past, and future).
verses.commentary: Sense: Know, moreover, the following to be a brief description of the three qualities, each in its order, as they appear in the three (times, the present, past, and future).
verses.hindi: शुभ फर्मों का फल देनेवाला है । ज्ञानी पुरुष बाहरी आकाश को में, सूर्य को नेत्र मे,- जल को -शरीर के चिकने पदार्थों मे, पृथिवी को शरीर में, चन्द्रमा को मन में, दिशाओं को ओज मे, विष्यु भगवान् को गति में; शिव को वल में, अग्नि को घाणी मै, मित्र
verses.science: शुभ फर्मों का फल देनेवाला है। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: यत्कर्म कृत्वा कुर्वंश्च करिष्यंश्चैव लज्जति । तज्ज्ञेयं विदुषा सर्वं तामसं गुणलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: yatkarma kṛtvā kurvaṃśca kariṣyaṃścaiva lajjati | tajjñeyaṃ viduṣā sarvaṃ tāmasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: When a (man), having done, doing, or being about to do any act, feels ashamed, the learned may know that all (such acts bear) the mark of the quality of Darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: When a (man), having done, doing, or being about to do any act, feels ashamed, the learned may know that all (such acts bear) the mark of the quality of Darkness.

verses.sanskrit: येनास्मिन् कर्मणा लोके ख्यातिमिच्छति पुष्कलाम् । न च शोचत्यसम्पत्तौ तद्विज्ञेयं तु राजसम्
verses.transliteration: yenāsmin karmaṇā loke khyātimicchati puṣkalām | na ca śocatyasampattau tadvijñeyaṃ tu rājasam
verses.translation: But, when (a man) desires (to gain) by an act much fame in this world and feels no sorrow on failing, know that it (bears the mark of the quality of) Activity.
verses.commentary: Sense: But, when (a man) desires (to gain) by an act much fame in this world and feels no sorrow on failing, know that it (bears the mark of the quality of) Activity.

verses.sanskrit: यत्सर्वेणेच्छति ज्ञातुं यन्न लज्जति चाचरन् । येन तुष्यति चात्माऽस्य तत्सत्त्वगुणलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: yatsarveṇecchati jñātuṃ yanna lajjati cācaran | yena tuṣyati cātmā'sya tatsattvaguṇalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: But that (bears) the mark of the quality of Goodness which with his whole (heart) he desires to know, which he is not ashamed to perform, and at which his soul rejoices.
verses.commentary: Sense: But that (bears) the mark of the quality of Goodness which with his whole (heart) he desires to know, which he is not ashamed to perform, and at which his soul rejoices.

verses.sanskrit: तमसो लक्षणं कामो रजसस्त्वर्थ उच्यते । सत्त्वस्य लक्षणं धर्मः श्रैष्ठ्यमेषां यथोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tamaso lakṣaṇaṃ kāmo rajasastvartha ucyate | sattvasya lakṣaṇaṃ dharmaḥ śraiṣṭhyameṣāṃ yathottaram
verses.translation: The craving after sensual pleasures is declared to be the mark of Darkness, (the pursuit of) wealth (the mark) of Activity, (the desire to gain) spiritual merit the mark of Goodness; each later) named quality is) better than the preceding one.
verses.commentary: Sense: The craving after sensual pleasures is declared to be the mark of Darkness, (the pursuit of) wealth (the mark) of Activity, (the desire to gain) spiritual merit the mark of Goodness; each later) named quality is) better than the preceding one.

verses.sanskrit: येन यस्तु गुणेनैषां संसरान् प्रतिपद्यते । येन यांस्तु तान् समासेन वक्ष्यामि सर्वस्यास्य यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: yena yastu guṇenaiṣāṃ saṃsarān pratipadyate | yena yāṃstu tān samāsena vakṣyāmi sarvasyāsya yathākramam
verses.translation: I will briefly declare in due order what transmigrations in this whole (world a man) obtains through each of these qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: I will briefly declare in due order what transmigrations in this whole (world a man) obtains through each of these qualities.

verses.sanskrit: देवत्वं सात्त्विका यान्ति मनुष्यत्वं च राजसाः । तिर्यक्त्वं तामसा नित्यमित्येषा त्रिविधा गतिः
verses.transliteration: devatvaṃ sāttvikā yānti manuṣyatvaṃ ca rājasāḥ | tiryaktvaṃ tāmasā nityamityeṣā trividhā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Those endowed with Goodness reach the state of gods, those endowed with Activity the state of men, and those endowed with Darkness ever sink to the condition of beasts; that is the threefold course of transmigrations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those endowed with Goodness reach the state of gods, those endowed with Activity the state of men, and those endowed with Darkness ever sink to the condition of beasts; that is the threefold course of transmigrations.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविधा त्रिविधैषा तु विज्ञेया गौणिकी गतिः । अधमा मध्यमाग्र्या च कर्मविद्याविशेषतः
verses.transliteration: trividhā trividhaiṣā tu vijñeyā gauṇikī gatiḥ | adhamā madhyamāgryā ca karmavidyāviśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: But know this threefold course of transmigrations that depends on the (three) qualities (to be again) threefold, low, middling, and high, according to the particular nature of the acts and of the knowledge (of each man).
verses.commentary: Sense: But know this threefold course of transmigrations that depends on the (three) qualities (to be again) threefold, low, middling, and high, according to the particular nature of the acts and of the knowledge (of each man).

verses.sanskrit: स्थावराः कृमिकीटाश्च मत्स्याः सर्पाः सकच्छपाः । पशवश्च मृगाश्चैव जघन्या तामसी गतिः
verses.transliteration: sthāvarāḥ kṛmikīṭāśca matsyāḥ sarpāḥ sakacchapāḥ | paśavaśca mṛgāścaiva jaghanyā tāmasī gatiḥ
verses.translation: Immovable (beings), insects, both small and great, fishes, snakes, and tortoises, cattle and wild animals, are the lowest conditions to which (the quality of) Darkness leads.
verses.commentary: Sense: Immovable (beings), insects, both small and great, fishes, snakes, and tortoises, cattle and wild animals, are the lowest conditions to which (the quality of) Darkness leads.

verses.transliteration: hastinaśca turaṅgāśca śūdrā mlecchāśca garhitāḥ | siṃhā vyāghrā varāhāśca madhyamā tāmasī gatiḥ
verses.translation: Elephants, horses, Sudras, and despicable barbarians, lions, tigers, and boars (are) the middling states, caused by (the quality of) Darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Elephants, horses, Sudras, and despicable barbarians, lions, tigers, and boars (are) the middling states, caused by (the quality of) Darkness.

verses.sanskrit: चारणाश्च सुपर्णाश्च पुरुषाश्चैव दाम्भिकाः । रक्षांसि च पिशाचाश्च तामसीषूत्तमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: cāraṇāśca suparṇāśca puruṣāścaiva dāmbhikāḥ | rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāśca tāmasīṣūttamā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Karanas, Suparnas and hypocrites, Rakshasas and Pisakas (belong to) the highest (rank of) conditions among those produced by Darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Karanas, Suparnas and hypocrites, Rakshasas and Pisakas (belong to) the highest (rank of) conditions among those produced by Darkness.

verses.sanskrit: झल्ला मल्ला नटाश्चैव पुरुषाः शस्त्रवृत्तयः । द्यूतपानप्रसक्ताश्च जघन्या राजसी गतिः
verses.transliteration: jhallā mallā naṭāścaiva puruṣāḥ śastravṛttayaḥ | dyūtapānaprasaktāśca jaghanyā rājasī gatiḥ
verses.translation: Ghallas, Mallas, Natas, men who subsist by despicable occupations and those addicted to gambling and drinking (form) the lowest (order of) conditions caused by Activity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ghallas, Mallas, Natas, men who subsist by despicable occupations and those addicted to gambling and drinking (form) the lowest (order of) conditions caused by Activity.

verses.transliteration: rājānaḥ kṣatriyāścaiva rājñāṃ caiva purohitāḥ | vādayuddhapradhānāśca madhyamā rājasī gatiḥ
verses.translation: Kings and Kshatriyas, the domestic priests of kings, and those who delight in the warfare of disputations (constitute) the middling (rank of the) states caused by Activity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kings and Kshatriyas, the domestic priests of kings, and those who delight in the warfare of disputations (constitute) the middling (rank of the) states caused by Activity.

verses.transliteration: gandharvā guhyakā yakṣā vibudhānucarāśca ye | tathaivāpsarasaḥ sarvā rājasīṣūttamā gatiḥ
verses.translation: The Gandharvas, the Guhyakas, and the servants of the gods, likewise the Apsarases, (belong all to) the highest (rank of) conditions produced by Activity.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gandharvas, the Guhyakas, and the servants of the gods, likewise the Apsarases, (belong all to) the highest (rank of) conditions produced by Activity.

verses.translation: Hermits, ascetics, Brahmanas, the crowds of the Vaimanika deities, the lunar mansions, and the Daityas (form) the first (and lowest rank of the) existences caused by Goodness.

verses.transliteration: yajvāna ṛṣayo devā vedā jyotīṃṣi vatsarāḥ | pitaraścaiva sādhyāśca dvitīyā sāttvikī gatiḥ
verses.translation: Sacrificers, the sages, the gods, the Vedas, the heavenly lights, the years, the manes, and the Sadhyas (constitute) the second order of existences, caused by Goodness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sacrificers, the sages, the gods, the Vedas, the heavenly lights, the years, the manes, and the Sadhyas (constitute) the second order of existences, caused by Goodness.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विश्वसृजो धर्मो महानव्यक्तमेव च । उत्तमां सात्त्विकीमेतां गतिमाहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: brahmā viśvasṛjo dharmo mahānavyaktameva ca | uttamāṃ sāttvikīmetāṃ gatimāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The sages declare Brahma, the creators of the universe, the law, the Great One, and the Undiscernible One (to constitute) the highest order of beings produced by Goodness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages declare Brahma, the creators of the universe, the law, the Great One, and the Undiscernible One (to constitute) the highest order of beings produced by Goodness.

verses.sanskrit: एष सर्वः समुद्दिष्टस्त्रिप्रकारस्य कर्मणः । त्रिः।प्रकारस्य त्रिविधस्त्रिविधः कृत्स्नः संसारः सार्वभौतिकः
verses.transliteration: eṣa sarvaḥ samuddiṣṭastriprakārasya karmaṇaḥ | triḥ|prakārasya trividhastrividhaḥ kṛtsnaḥ saṃsāraḥ sārvabhautikaḥ
verses.translation: Thus (the result) of the threefold action, the whole system of transmigrations which (consists) of three classes, (each) with three subdivisions, and which includes all created beings, has been fully pointed out.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus (the result) of the threefold action, the whole system of transmigrations which (consists) of three classes, (each) with three subdivisions, and which includes all created beings, has been fully pointed out.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणां प्रसङ्गेन धर्मस्यासेवनेन च । पापान् संयान्ति संसारानविद्वांसो नराधमाः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇāṃ prasaṅgena dharmasyāsevanena ca | pāpān saṃyānti saṃsārānavidvāṃso narādhamāḥ
verses.translation: In consequence of attachment to (the objects of) the senses, and in consequence of the non-performance of their duties, fools, the lowest of men, reach the vilest births.
verses.commentary: Sense: In consequence of attachment to (the objects of) the senses, and in consequence of the non-performance of their duties, fools, the lowest of men, reach the vilest births.

verses.sanskrit: यां यां योनिं तु जीवोऽयं येन येनैह कर्मणा । क्रमशो याति लोकेऽस्मिंस्तत्तत्सर्वं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ tu jīvo'yaṃ yena yenaiha karmaṇā | kramaśo yāti loke'smiṃstattatsarvaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: What wombs this individual soul enters in this world and in consequence of what actions, learn the particulars of that at large and in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: What wombs this individual soul enters in this world and in consequence of what actions, learn the particulars of that at large and in due order.

verses.transliteration: bahūn varṣagaṇān ghorānnarakān prāpya tatkṣayāt | saṃsārān pratipadyante mahāpātakinastvimān
verses.translation: Those who committed mortal sins (mahapataka), having passed during large numbers of years through dreadful hells, obtain, after the expiration of (that term of punishment), the following births.

verses.translation: The slayer of a Brahmana enters the womb of a dog, a pig, an ass, a camel, a cow, a goat, a sheep, a deer, a bird, a Kandala, and a Pukkasa.

verses.transliteration: kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ viḍbhujāṃ caiva pakṣiṇām | hiṃsrāṇāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ surāpo brāhmaṇo vrajet
verses.translation: A Brahmana who drinks (the spirituous liquor called) Sura shall enter (the bodies) of small and large insects, of moths, of birds, feeding on ordure, and of destructive beasts.

verses.transliteration: lūtā'hisaraṭānāṃ ca tiraścāṃ cāmbucāriṇām | hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca piśācānāṃ steno vipraḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana who steals (the gold of a Brahmana shall pass) a thousand times (through the bodies) of spiders, snakes and lizards, of aquatic animals and of destructive Pisakas.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who steals (the gold of a Brahmana shall pass) a thousand times (through the bodies) of spiders, snakes and lizards, of aquatic animals and of destructive Pisakas.

verses.translation: The violator of a Guru's bed (enters) a hundred times (the forms) of grasses, shrubs, and creepers, likewise of carnivorous (animals) and of (beasts) with fangs and of those doing cruel deeds.

verses.transliteration: hiṃsrā bhavanti kravyādāḥ kṛmayo'medhyabhakṣiṇaḥ | parasparādinaḥ stenāḥ pretyāntyastrīniṣeviṇaḥ
verses.translation: Men who delight in doing hurt (become) carnivorous (animals); those who eat forbidden food, worms; thieves, creatures consuming their own kind; those who have intercourse with women of the lowest castes, Pretas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who delight in doing hurt (become) carnivorous (animals); those who eat forbidden food, worms; thieves, creatures consuming their own kind; those who have intercourse with women of the lowest castes, Pretas.

verses.translation: He who has associated with outcasts, he who has approached the wives of other men, and he who has stolen the property of a Brahmana become Brahmarakshasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who has associated with outcasts, he who has approached the wives of other men, and he who has stolen the property of a Brahmana become Brahmarakshasas.

verses.transliteration: maṇimuktāpravālāni hṛtvā lobhena mānavaḥ | vividhāṇi ca ratnāni jāyate hemakartṛṣu
verses.translation: A man who out of greed has stolen gems, pearls or coral, or any of the many other kinds of precious things, is born among the goldsmiths.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who out of greed has stolen gems, pearls or coral, or any of the many other kinds of precious things, is born among the goldsmiths.

verses.transliteration: dhānyaṃ hṛtvā bhavatyākhuḥ kāṃsyaṃ haṃso jalaṃ plavaḥ | madhu daṃśaḥ payaḥ kāko rasaṃ śvā nakulo ghṛtam

verses.sanskrit: मांसं गृध्रो वपां मद्गुस्तैलं तैलपकः खगः । चीरीवाकस्तु लवणं बलाका शकुनिर्दधि

verses.translation: For stealing meat a vulture, for stealing fat a cormorant, for stealing oil a winged animal (of the kind called) Tailapaka, for stealing salt a cricket, for stealing sour milk a bird (of the kind called) Balaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing meat a vulture, for stealing fat a cormorant, for stealing oil a winged animal (of the kind called) Tailapaka, for stealing salt a cricket, for stealing sour milk a bird (of the kind called) Balaka.

verses.transliteration: chucchundariḥ śubhān gandhān patraśākaṃ tu barhiṇaḥ | chucchundarīḥ śvāvitkṛtānnaṃ vividhamakṛtānnaṃ tu śalyakaḥ
verses.translation: For stealing fine perfumes a musk-rat, for stealing vegetables consisting of leaves a peacock, for stealing cooked food of various kinds a porcupine, for stealing uncooked food a hedgehog.
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing fine perfumes a musk-rat, for stealing vegetables consisting of leaves a peacock, for stealing cooked food of various kinds a porcupine, for stealing uncooked food a hedgehog.

verses.transliteration: bako bhavati hṛtvā'gniṃ gṛhakārī hyupaskaram | raktāni hṛtvā vāsāṃsi jāyate jīvajīvakaḥ
verses.translation: For stealing fire he becomes a heron, for stealing household-utensils a mason-wasp, for stealing dyed clothes a francolin-partridge;
verses.commentary: Sense: For stealing fire he becomes a heron, for stealing household-utensils a mason-wasp, for stealing dyed clothes a francolin-partridge;

verses.transliteration: vṛko mṛgaibhaṃ vyāghro'śvaṃ phalamūlaṃ tu markaṭaḥ | strīṃ ṛkṣaḥ stokako vāri yānānyuṣṭraḥ paśūnajaḥ
verses.translation: For stealing a deer or an elephant a wolf, for stealing a horse a tiger, for stealing fruit and roots a monkey, for stealing a woman a bear, for stealing water a black-white cuckoo, for stealing vehicles a camel, for stealing cattle a he-goat.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा तद्वा परद्रव्यमपहृत्य बलान्नरः । अवश्यं याति तिर्यक्त्वं जग्ध्वा चैवाहुतं हविः
verses.transliteration: yadvā tadvā paradravyamapahṛtya balānnaraḥ | avaśyaṃ yāti tiryaktvaṃ jagdhvā caivāhutaṃ haviḥ
verses.translation: That man who has forcibly taken away any kind of property belonging to another, or who has eaten sacrificial food (of) which (no portion) had been offered, inevitably becomes an animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: That man who has forcibly taken away any kind of property belonging to another, or who has eaten sacrificial food (of) which (no portion) had been offered, inevitably becomes an animal.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियोऽप्येतेन कल्पेन हृत्वा दोषमवाप्नुयुः । एतेषामेव जन्तूनां भार्यात्वमुपयान्ति ताः
verses.transliteration: striyo'pyetena kalpena hṛtvā doṣamavāpnuyuḥ | eteṣāmeva jantūnāṃ bhāryātvamupayānti tāḥ
verses.translation: Women, also, who in like manner have committed a theft, shall incur guilt; they will become the females of those same creatures (which have been enumerated above).
verses.commentary: Sense: Women, also, who in like manner have committed a theft, shall incur guilt; they will become the females of those same creatures (which have been enumerated above).

verses.sanskrit: स्वेभ्यः स्वेभ्यस्तु कर्मभ्यश्च्युता वर्णा ह्यनापदि । पापान् संसृत्य संसारान् प्रेष्यतां यान्ति शत्रुषु
verses.transliteration: svebhyaḥ svebhyastu karmabhyaścyutā varṇā hyanāpadi | pāpān saṃsṛtya saṃsārān preṣyatāṃ yānti śatruṣu
verses.translation: But (men of the four) castes who have relinquished without the pressure of necessity their proper occupations, will become the servants of Dasyus, after migrating into despicable bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: But (men of the four) castes who have relinquished without the pressure of necessity their proper occupations, will become the servants of Dasyus, after migrating into despicable bodies.

verses.sanskrit: यान्ति दस्युषु वान्ताश्युल्कामुखः प्रेतो विप्रो धर्मात्स्वकाच्च्युतः । अमेध्यकुणपाशी च क्षत्रियः कटपूतनः
verses.transliteration: yānti dasyuṣu vāntāśyulkāmukhaḥ preto vipro dharmātsvakāccyutaḥ | amedhyakuṇapāśī ca kṣatriyaḥ kaṭapūtanaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana who has fallen off from his duty (becomes) an Ulkamukha Preta, who feeds on what has been vomited; and a Kshatriya, a Kataputana (Preta), who eats impure substances and corpses.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who has fallen off from his duty (becomes) an Ulkamukha Preta, who feeds on what has been vomited; and a Kshatriya, a Kataputana (Preta), who eats impure substances and corpses.

verses.sanskrit: कूटपूतनः मैत्राक्षज्योतिकः प्रेतो वैश्यो भवति पूयभुक् । मैत्राक्षिज्योतिकः चैलाशकश्च भवति शूद्रो धर्मात्स्वकाच्च्युतः
verses.transliteration: kūṭapūtanaḥ maitrākṣajyotikaḥ preto vaiśyo bhavati pūyabhuk | maitrākṣijyotikaḥ cailāśakaśca bhavati śūdro dharmātsvakāccyutaḥ
verses.translation: A Vaisya who has fallen off from his duty becomes a Maitrakshagyotika Preta, who feeds on pus; and a Sudra, a Kailasaka (Preta, who feeds on moths).
verses.commentary: Sense: A Vaisya who has fallen off from his duty becomes a Maitrakshagyotika Preta, who feeds on pus; and a Sudra, a Kailasaka (Preta, who feeds on moths).

verses.sanskrit: यथा यथा निषेवन्ते विषयान् विषयात्मकाः । तथा तथा कुशलता तेषां तेषूपजायते
verses.transliteration: yathā yathā niṣevante viṣayān viṣayātmakāḥ | tathā tathā kuśalatā teṣāṃ teṣūpajāyate
verses.translation: In proportion as sensual men indulge in sensual pleasures, in that same proportion their taste for them grows.
verses.commentary: Sense: In proportion as sensual men indulge in sensual pleasures, in that same proportion their taste for them grows.

verses.sanskrit: तेऽभ्यासात्कर्मणां तेषां पापानामल्पबुद्धयः । सम्प्राप्नुवन्ति दुःखानि तासु तास्विह योनिषु
verses.transliteration: te'bhyāsātkarmaṇāṃ teṣāṃ pāpānāmalpabuddhayaḥ | samprāpnuvanti duḥkhāni tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu
verses.translation: By repeating their sinful acts those men of small understanding suffer pain here (below) in various births;
verses.commentary: Sense: By repeating their sinful acts those men of small understanding suffer pain here (below) in various births;

verses.sanskrit: तामिस्रादिषु चोग्रेषु नरकेषु विवर्तनम् । असिपत्रवनादीनि बन्धनछेदनानि च
verses.transliteration: tāmisrādiṣu cogreṣu narakeṣu vivartanam | asipatravanādīni bandhanachedanāni ca
verses.translation: (The torture of) being tossed about in dreadful hells, Tamisra and the rest, (that of) the Forest with sword-leaved trees and the like, and (that of) being bound and mangled;
verses.commentary: Sense: (The torture of) being tossed about in dreadful hells, Tamisra and the rest, (that of) the Forest with sword-leaved trees and the like, and (that of) being bound and mangled;

verses.sanskrit: विविधाश्चैव सम्पीडाः काकोलूकैश्च भक्षणम् । करम्भवालुकातापान् कुम्भीपाकांश्च दारुणान्
verses.transliteration: vividhāścaiva sampīḍāḥ kākolūkaiśca bhakṣaṇam | karambhavālukātāpān kumbhīpākāṃśca dāruṇān
verses.translation: And various torments, the (pain of) being devoured by ravens and owls, the heat of scorching sand, and the (torture of) being boiled in jars, which is hard to bear;
verses.commentary: Sense: And various torments, the (pain of) being devoured by ravens and owls, the heat of scorching sand, and the (torture of) being boiled in jars, which is hard to bear;

verses.transliteration: sambhavāṃśca viyonīṣu duḥkhaprāyāsu nityaśaḥ | śītātapābhighātāṃśca vividhāni bhayāni ca
verses.translation: And births in the wombs (of) despicable (beings) which cause constant misery, and afflictions from cold and heat and terrors of various kinds,
verses.commentary: Sense: And births in the wombs (of) despicable (beings) which cause constant misery, and afflictions from cold and heat and terrors of various kinds,

verses.sanskrit: असकृद्गर्भवासेषु वासं जन्म च दारुणम् । बन्धनानि च काष्ठानि परप्रेष्यत्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: asakṛdgarbhavāseṣu vāsaṃ janma ca dāruṇam | bandhanāni ca kāṣṭhāni parapreṣyatvameva ca
verses.translation: The (pain of) repeatedly lying in various wombs and agonizing births, imprisonment in fetters hard to bear, and the misery of being enslaved by others,
verses.commentary: Sense: The (pain of) repeatedly lying in various wombs and agonizing births, imprisonment in fetters hard to bear, and the misery of being enslaved by others,

verses.translation: And separations from their relatives and dear ones, and the (pain of) dwelling together with the wicked, (labour in) gaining wealth and its loss, (trouble in) making friends and (the appearance of) enemies,

verses.transliteration: jarāṃ caivāpratīkārāṃ vyādhibhiścopapīḍanam | kleśāṃśca vividhāṃstāṃstān mṛtyumeva ca durjayam
verses.translation: Old age against which there is no remedy, the pangs of diseases, afflictions of many various kinds, and (finally) unconquerable death.
